### Job Description

**The City of Avondale has an opportunity for a Senior Systems Engineer to join the Information Technology Department**

_**The first review of applications will begin on November 10, 2026, and weekly thereafter.**_

**_This recruitment will remain open until filled._**

The Senior Systems Engineer is responsible for the planning, design, implementation, administration, and support of the City’s server, storage, virtualization, cloud, and enterprise systems infrastructure. The position ensures the security, availability, performance, and reliability of assigned systems; performs advanced monitoring, maintenance, patching, backup, and recovery activities; and resolves complex technical issues in support of City operations and services.

### Essential Functions

**Strategy & Planning**

- Collaborate with executive management and department leaders to assess near- and long-term server, storage, and computing capacity needs.
- Create and maintain technical documentation, including system configurations, server and application dependencies, standard operating procedures, diagrams, service records, and inventories of servers, assets, and licenses.
- Develop, implement, and maintain policies, procedures, and related training plans for systems administration, system usage, backup, and disaster recovery; provides technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members. Contribute to IT infrastructure and roadmap planning, including on-premises, hybrid, and cloud hosting strategies.

**Acquisition & Deployment**

- Design and deploy server, storage, and virtualization infrastructure, including physical servers, hypervisors, storage arrays, backup systems, UPS, and other data center hardware.
- Plan and execute migrations, upgrades, and retirements of operating systems, enterprise applications, and cloud services such as Microsoft 365 and Azure. Identifies and addresses legacy and unsupported servers, in accordance with City policy.
- Research, evaluate, and maintain current knowledge of emerging technologies, products, services, cybersecurity practices, and industry standards to support the City’s IT systems, infrastructure, and operational needs.
- Interact and negotiate with external/third party providers to secure systems products and services.

**Operational Management**

- Configure and administer Windows and Linux servers, virtualization platforms (primarily VMware vSphere and VMware Cloud Foundation), and enterprise storage systems such as NetApp ONTAP to ensure their smooth and reliable operation for fulfilling business objectives and processes.
- Administer directory, identity, and certificate services, including Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and public key infrastructure (PKI) with automated certificate issuance and renewal. Manage email and collaboration platforms, including Microsoft Exchange Online and Microsoft 365.
- Monitor system performance, capacity, and health; troubleshoot problem areas as needed; automate routine administrative tasks using scripting tools such as PowerShell; and provide performance statistics and reports.
- Manage patching, updates, and vulnerability remediation for servers and enterprise systems. Participate in managing systems security controls, including access management, endpoint protection, and security audits, in coordination with network and cybersecurity personnel.
- Manage backup and recovery solutions, test restores, and support disaster recovery exercises in accordance with city policies.

**On-Call Availability**

- Provide 24x7x365 on-call support on a rotation basis with other team members.

**To view the full job description and learn more about the responsibilities and qualifications, please click to view the Class Specification** [**here**](https://www.governmentjobs.com/careers/avondale/classspecs/1503155?keywords=senior%20systems%20engineer&pagetype=class
Specifications) **.**

### Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology / Computer Science or a closely related field. An equivalent combination of education and job-related experience may be considered on a year-for-year basis.

Preferred: Microsoft role-based certification relevant to the position (for example, Azure Administrator Associate or Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert).

VMware Certified Professional (VCP) or NetApp Certified Data Administrator (NCDA).

A valid Arizona Operator’s Driver’s License is required.

Five (5) years of progressive experience configuring, installing, and managing server infrastructure, including Windows Operating Systems, Linux operating systems (Red Hat Enterprise Linux or Ubuntu preferred), and storage systems, and performing migrations, upgrades, or decommissioning of legacy and unsupported server platforms.

Proven experience administering Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and public key infrastructure (PKI) and certificate lifecycle management, including Active Directory Certificate Services and ACME-based automation; and administering Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, and Teams.

Advanced, hands-on technical knowledge of virtualization platforms, preferably VMware vSphere and VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF); Microsoft Hyper-V experience is also preferred. Familiarity with containers and Kubernetes is preferred.

Proven experience with enterprise backup and recovery, disaster recovery planning, system capacity planning, security hardening, patch management, and systems management best practices, including formal change, incident, and problem management processes (such as ITIL); and knowledge of applicable data privacy and security practices and laws.

jobs.description:
Scheduled hours per week: 40

Scheduled months per year: 12

Remote work eligibility: Hybrid

Hiring range: $79,500 to $99,400

#### Position purpose

Infrastructure Services builds and runs the compute, storage, identity, cloud, container, and high-performance computing platforms that support Dartmouth’s research, teaching, and administrative work. Engineers work in small cross-functional teams and own their platforms end to end, from design and automation through security, operations, and lifecycle.

The Infrastructure Engineer II is a hands-on engineer who builds, secures, and operates these platforms across on-premises and public cloud environments. Security is central to the role: platforms are designed to be secure by default, hardened, kept current, and closely integrated with Information Security monitoring and incident response. The role works independently, leads technical delivery on projects, and mentors less experienced engineers.

#### Key accountabilities

Infrastructure Operations

- Builds and maintains automation and configuration management for infrastructure platforms, including compute, storage, identity, cloud, container, and research computing platforms.
- Operates and supports research computing environments, including Slurm-based HPC clusters, GPU and AI compute, and research storage.
- Keeps platforms healthy and meeting service objectives through monitoring, capacity planning, patching, and lifecycle management.
- Implements, tests, and maintains backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities for supported platforms.
- Leads troubleshooting of complex incidents, performs root cause analysis, and drives lasting fixes.
- Maintains infrastructure networking, including VLANs, routing, VPN, and DNS.
- Maintains runbooks, standards, and configuration baselines in version control, and plans changes through change management to minimize disruption.
- Participates in an on-call rotation.

Infrastructure Security

- Implements and maintains infrastructure security controls, including host and network firewalls, network segmentation (e.g., Nutanix Flow), DNS security, and cloud security policies (e.g., AWS security groups and NACLs).
- Hardens systems to security baselines (e.g., CIS Benchmarks) and enforces least-privilege, privileged access, and identity controls on owned platforms.
- Drives vulnerability remediation across owned platforms, prioritized by severity and risk, in partnership with Information Security.
- Integrates platforms with security tooling for logging, monitoring, and endpoint protection (e.g., SIEM, EDR), and supports security incident response and investigation.
- Secures environments that host regulated research and institutional data (e.g., HIPAA, FERPA) and provides evidence for audits and compliance reviews.
- Builds security controls into automation and infrastructure-as-code so they are consistent, repeatable, and auditable.

Project Support

- Leads technical delivery on infrastructure projects, from design and prototyping through production rollout, with security requirements addressed from the start.
- Contributes to platform architecture and technology decisions as a member of a cross-functional platform team.
- Works with application, security, network, and research teams, including faculty and researchers, so solutions fit how services are actually used.
- Provides cost estimates and cost analysis for infrastructure work, helps evaluate vendor solutions, and manages vendor support and SLAs for owned platforms.
- Communicates status, technical decisions, and risks clearly to teammates and stakeholders.

Training and Development

- Builds deep expertise in one or more platform domains and shares it through documentation, code review, and pairing.
- Mentors Infrastructure Engineer I colleagues and supports their growth.
- Stays current on infrastructure and security tools, threats, and practices, and brings forward ideas worth adopting.

Team Culture and Collaboration

- Demonstrates commitment to inclusive practices through day-to-day interactions and team collaboration.
- Engages in opportunities to build awareness and understanding across diverse perspectives.

#### Required qualifications: education and experience

Bachelors or equivalent combination of education and experience

#### Required qualifications: skills, knowledge and abilities

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information security, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
- 4 or more years of experience supporting production infrastructure in enterprise or research computing environments
- Strong Linux and/or Windows systems administration and troubleshooting skills
- Experience automating infrastructure with scripting (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) and infrastructure-as-code tools
- Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: virtualization, public cloud, identity (e.g., Active Directory, Entra ID), containers, or HPC
- Working knowledge of infrastructure security, including system hardening, vulnerability management, access controls, and firewalls
- Working knowledge of networking, including VLANs, routing, and DNS
- Ability to work independently, prioritize, and resolve complex issues with minimal supervision
- Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical decisions to non-engineers

#### Preferred qualifications

- Experience with Ansible/AAP and Terraform or CloudFormation in Git-based workflows and CI/CD pipelines
- Experience with security tooling such as EDR, SIEM, vulnerability scanning, and cloud security posture management
- Familiarity with security frameworks such as NIST 800-53, NIST 800-171, or CIS Controls
- Experience running Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms in production
- Experience with AWS, Azure, OCI, or Google Cloud
- Experience with Nutanix or VMware virtualization
- Experience with HPC environments, including RHEL, Slurm, Open OnDemand, Apptainer, GPU clusters, and research storage (e.g., VAST, PowerScale, Kerberized NFS)
- Experience designing and testing backup and disaster recovery solutions
- Relevant certifications such as Security+, GIAC (e.g., GSEC, GCIH), RHCSA, AWS or Azure associate-level certifications, or CKA
- Experience in higher education or research environments

SEI is seeking a Desktop/Endpoint Engineer. Join a team responsible for delivering a secure, modern, and reliable endpoint experience across a global enterprise. As a Desktop Engineer, you will independently support core endpoint services while continuing to deepen your expertise in Microsoft Intune, MECM/SCCM, Windows 11, Autopilot, endpoint security, software deployment, and automation. This opportunity is designed for an endpoint or desktop professional with foundational experience who can support routine deployments and troubleshooting and is ready to grow their skills by contributing to smaller engineering initiatives with guidance from senior team members.

### What you will do:

**Endpoint Administration & Support**

- Support and maintain enterprise endpoint management platforms across a global environment.

- Manage device provisioning, software deployment, patch management, and compliance monitoring.

- Manage endpoint configurations using Microsoft Intune and MECM/SCCM.

- Monitor endpoint health and troubleshoot device management issues.

**Modern Workplace Technologies**

- Build and maintain Microsoft Intune configuration profiles, compliance policies, and device enrollment processes.

- Support Windows Autopilot provisioning and enrollment activities.

- Contribute to Windows 11 deployment and modernization initiatives.

- Identify opportunities to improve endpoint management, automation, and user experience.

**Application Deployment & Lifecycle Management**

- Package, test, deploy, and support enterprise applications.

- Monitor software deployment success and resolve installation issues.

- Prepare and support application change requests through established change management processes.

- Coordinate assigned application rollout activities.

**Security & Compliance**

- Administer endpoint security technologies including BitLocker, LAPS, Microsoft Defender, and device compliance policies.

- Support security initiatives designed to protect enterprise devices and data.

- Monitor compliance and coordinate remediation activities.

**Technical Troubleshooting**

- Provide Level 2/3 support for operating system, application, and endpoint management issues.

- Investigate and resolve device deployment, compliance, and configuration problems.

- Work closely with Service Desk, Infrastructure, Security, and Engineering teams.

- Participate in an after-hours support rotation as needed.

### What we need from you:

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, MIS, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

- 3 years of experience in endpoint support, desktop engineering, systems administration, or a related technology role.

- Experience supporting Windows desktop operating systems in an enterprise environment.

- Working experience with Microsoft Intune, MECM/SCCM, or comparable endpoint management platforms.

- Ability to independently manage routine deployments and troubleshoot complex endpoint issues.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

 SR. IT WINDOWS ENGINEER

SpaceX is looking for an experienced engineer with deep knowledge and broad experience across Microsoft-based technologies. This employee will be a member of the Information Technology Windows Infrastructure team and will support systems all across SpaceX. The ideal candidate will be flexible and flourish in a fast paced and challenging environment, and will exercise a high degree of responsibility for the processes, systems, and tools you create and manage; all supporting the goal of making humanity an interplanetary species.

 RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Work closely with other SpaceX engineers to gather requirements, research, evaluate, design, plan, deploy, and support Microsoft enterprise software platforms and related technologies in a world-class environment that meets the needs of the demanding SpaceX engineering teams.

- Build highly-resilient, high-performance, scalable, and flexible systems.

- Make recommendations, justify, and implement improvements using an accepted change control methodology.

- Work within diverse groups to design and deliver creative solutions and resolve problems in a timely and proactive manner by interacting with internal business units.

- Drive designs, implementations, and support in the following areas:

  - Architecture: making considerations for interoperability, scale, efficiency, and business continuity for users within and across environments.

  - Security: building PKI standards and ensuring access and data is protected. KMS, HSM, certificate management, encryption methods, etc.

  - Scripting and automation: developing solutions to address issues at scale.

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a STEM discipline and 5+ years of systems engineering experience; OR 7+ years of systems engineering experience in lieu of a degree.

- 7+ years of hands-on experience with Windows operating system engineering and architecture.

 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Experience with Active Directory, Kerberos, and multi-platform authentication and identification environments.

- Experience (including the ability to setup, configure, upgrade, manage, and troubleshoot) with Windows-based systems and services (i.e. Active Directory Certificate Services, Active Directory Federation Services in both physical and virtual environments).

- Experience with cryptography fundamentals: PKI standards, data encryption or key management.

- Expertise in creating repeatable, reliable, scalable systems architectures, with high availability, fault tolerance, performance tuning, monitoring, and statistics/metrics collection.

- Expert level PowerShell experience; beyond running cmdlets, experience with writing larger scripts and automation-driven processes.

- Experience in building robust monitoring and automated remediation services for critical systems (SCOM, Icinga, or equivalent).

- Experience with hybrid scenarios with EntraID and Active Directory.

- Experience with configuration management, provisioning, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and other DevOps and/or SRE best practices, concepts and tools.

- Ability to support deployment of HSMs and cryptographic solutions.

- Understanding of developing web and C#/. Net applications and build processes.

- Networking experience in IPv4, switching, routing, firewalls and high availability architecture.

- Comfortable working with mission critical and sensitive systems, with a sense of urgency appropriate to the responsibilities.

- Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate with internal/external customers, vendors, management etc. in both formal and informal situations.

- Willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed.

jobs.description:
### **Career Category**

Information Systems

### **Job Description**

Join our team at **AMGEN Capability Center Portugal**, consistently recognized among the top companies in the Best Workplaces™ ranking by Great Place to Work® in Portugal. In 2026, we were once again distinguished as one of the top Best Workplaces in the country (category 201–500 employees), reinforcing our commitment to an exceptional employee experience and workplace culture.

We are a team of over 500 talented individuals, spanning more than 30 functions and areas of expertise, and representing over 40 nationalities. Together, we bring diverse perspectives and professional backgrounds to help shape the future of healthcare through innovation and technology.

This is your opportunity to explore a world of possibilities across areas such as Data & Analytics, Digital, Technology & Innovation, Cybersecurity, R&D Operations, Global Distribution, Finance, Regulatory Affairs, General & Administrative, Human Resources, and many more.

Located in the heart of Lisbon, our AMGEN office fosters a culture of innovation, excellence, and purpose. Come thrive with us at AMGEN, supporting our mission To Serve Patients.

What we do at AMGEN matters in people’s lives.

**Senior Associate Endpoint Security Engineer**

At AMGEN, Technology isn’t just a support function—it’s a catalyst for discovery, transformation, and real-world impact. Here, your ideas fuel innovation that improves and saves lives of patients in dire need of our medicines. Are you ready to do meaningful work that matters?

**LIVE**

**What you will do**

As an Endpoint Security Senior Associate, you will be a technical engineer for a very diverse endpoint tools. This engineer will play a key role in designing, deploying, and maintaining solutions to build our evolving endpoint protection capabilities, as well as operate, lead, and improve multiple endpoint security technologies. This associate will protect Amgen from threats inside of the company's environment within both the global corporate network and manufacturing environments.

You will operate, manage, and improve Amgen’s endpoint security posture solutions. Within the team, you will identify emerging risks related to endpoint protection, advise management, and develop technical remediations to address those risks. This position will be responsible for the development of processes and procedures for multiple solutions Amgen utilizes to deliver to the promise of a secure digital workplace. They run multiple projects simultaneously to implement and improve the endpoint security protections and use advanced analytics to demonstrate success. This engineer will play a key role in educating technologists and business leaders about the security strategies.

- Works daily alongside the digital workforce experience team to specify, implement, and validate security controls for Amgen’s workstations, servers and mobile platforms.
- Experience with Windows (Workstation and Server) and Mac (macOS/iOS) operating systems.
- Designs, operates, maintains, and enhances capabilities for the technical systems that ensure protection of endpoints for Amgen’s global workforce.
- Identifies new risk areas for data and plans controls to mitigate those risks.
- Researches new technologies, processes, and approaches based on industry practices and recommends future plans for secure configurations.
- Authors procedures and guidelines and advises on policies related to workstation and mobile protection requirements and remediation or investigation of violations.
- Develops and conducts training on protection technologies for operations staff. Educates business leadership about data risk.
- Consults other technology groups on endpoint protection strategies and recommends appropriate points of both technical and process integration.
- Partners with the Manager of Endpoint Security to collaborate closely with legal and human resources leadership on violation remediations.
- Collaborates with architecture strategy leaders and business unit leadership to ensure that security by design configurations are incorporated into new business projects.
- Collaborates with Endpoint Security Engineers to integrate protection technology into the operations of traditional Endpoint Detection and Response operations.

**WIN**

**What we expect of you**

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The information security professional we seek is a self-starter with these qualifications:

- Master’s degree
- **Or** Bachelor’s degree and 2 years of experience in Information Systems, or Computer Science
- **Or** Associate degree and 4 years of experience in Information Systems, or Computer Science
- **Or** High school diploma / GED and 6 years of experience in Information Systems, or Computer Science

**Preferred Qualifications:**

- Skill with elements of MDM systems such as Intune, Workspace One, and JAMF on Windows, MacOS and iOS based operating systems.
- Experience with endpoint security solutions like Traditional Anti-Malware Technologies, Next Generation Anti-Malware, Application Allowlisting, and Endpoint Detection and Response.
- Experience implementing secure baselines such as DISA STIGs and CIS Benchmarks.
- Understanding of endpoint technologies from a security perspective including the security risks associated with misconfiguration.
- Experience with data analytics in building executive reports.
- Familiarity with one or more security frameworks, especially in regulated environments.
- Proficiency specifying requirements for technical systems, as well as designing, implementing, and operating those systems.
- Expertise in global IT operations, including an understanding of regulatory and cultural differences encountered when dealing with international peers and customers.
- Basic capabilities with programming or scripting languages.
- Experience with project management workstream leadership, preferably using Agile methodology.
- Deep knowledge of the principles of endpoint protection, including availability, integrity, and confidentiality of user devices.

**Preferred Certifications (Any):**

- SANS (GSEC, GCED)
- Systems Security Certified Practitioner (SSCP) or Security+
- Microsoft Certifications (MCSA, MCSD, MCSE)

**THRIVE**

**What you can expect of us**

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also care deeply for our teammates’ well-being and growth.

- **Work That Matters** – Build tech that accelerates scientific breakthroughs and helps patients worldwide.

- **Modern Tech Stack** – Cloud-first, automation-focused, AI-powered.

- **Global Scale, Agile Mindset** – Collaborate across continents while working in nimble, high-impact teams.

- **Continuous Learning** – Access to certifications, trainings, mentorship, and career mobility.

- **AMGEN Total Rewards Plan** – Comprehensive benefits in healthcare, finance, and well-being.

- **Flexibility** – Hybrid work model with time split between our Lisbon office and remote work.

**APPLY NOW**

Objects in your future are closer than they appear. Join us.

**CAREERS.AMGEN.COM**

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT**

AMGEN is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.

.

jobs.description:
WHAT IS BOX?

Box(NYSE: BOX)はインテリジェントコンテンツ管理（ICM）プラットフォームのリーディングカンパニーです。Boxのプラットフォームは、企業のコラボレーション促進や、コンテンツのライフサイクル全体の管理、重要なコンテンツの保護、そしてエンタープライズAIによるビジネスワークフローの変革を実現することを目指しています。2005年に米国で設立され、JLL、モルガン・スタンレーなどを含む大手グローバル企業や、日本では23,000超および日経225の86%の企業の業務効率化を支援しています。
Boxは、カリフォルニア州レッドウッドシティーに本社を置き、米国、ヨーロッパ、アジアに拠点を持っています。株式会社Box Japanは2013年に設立された日本法人です。

Boxでは、重要なコンテンツを扱うプラットフォームをさらに推進し、お客様の働き方に大きな変革を提供する、またとない機会があります。コンテンツは私達の業務の中心にあります。契約書、請求書、社員情報、財務情報、製品仕様、マーケティング資産などの部署間に跨る重要なビジネス・プロセスに含まれる数十億ものファイルや情報が日々流れています。私達のミッションは、コンテンツ管理にインテリジェンスをもたらし、お客様がデジタル・トランスフォーメーションを実現するお手伝いをさせていただくことです。このAIと膨大な業務コンテンツの融合による、大規模な働き方の変革期に、そのビジネスの最前線に貢献することが、Boxではできます。

 WHY BOX NEEDS YO

Box Japanは、日本企業のコンテンツ活用とAI活用を次のステージへ進めるフェーズにあります。Solutions Engineer, Public Sectorは、経営・IT・現場それぞれの課題を理解し、Boxのプラットフ
ォーム価値を業務成果に結びつける技術パートナーです。公共領域を担当するSolutions Engineerとして、営業、カスタマーサクセス、プロフェッショナルサービス、パートナーと連携し、構想策定から技術検証、導入、定着・拡張までお客様の変革を支援します。

 WHAT YOU'LL DO

- 経営／業務課題に紐づくデモ、ワークショップ、テクニカルディスカッション

- PoC、パイロット、アーキテクチャ設計、価値検証のリード

- RFP対応、セキュリティ・コンプライアンス監査、AI利用ガバナンスの支援

- お客様の声をプロダクトマネジメント／エンジニアリングへ届け、改善を推進

単なる製品説明ではなく、コンテンツを起点にAI・ワークフロー・セキュリティを組み合わせ、お客様の意思決定、業務効率、リスク低減をどう実現するかを描くポジションです。

Box ではコミュニティと対面でのコラボレーションを重要視していてます。Box の社員（Boxers）は、少なくとも毎週3日間以上はオフィスで勤務することが求められます。選考プロセスの中で、リクルーターが働き方や企業文化についてさらに詳しくご説明します。

 WHO YOU ARE

私たちは「AIファースト」の企業です。
すなわち、常に成長マインドセットを持ちながら仕事に取り組み、AIを活用し、より迅速かつ適切な意思決定を行い、インパクトを高める方法を見つけていくことが求められます。

- 中央省庁または地方自治体などのIT部門、業務部門、パートナーとの対話を通じて課題と成功指標を整理し、技術的な知見を交えた提案を行う

- Box AI、AIエージェント、AI Studio、検索／Deep Research、データ抽出、ワークフロー自動化を含むユースケースを設計し、デモ・ワークショップ・提案資料・プレゼンテーションに落とし込む

- Microsoft 365／Teams、Salesforce、Google Workspace、Slack、ServiceNow等の業務アプリや、お客様のカスタムアプリケーションとの連携を設計・支援する

- コンテンツの分類、アクセス制御、脅威対策、監査、データレジデンシーなど、Enterpriseのセキュリティ／ガバナンス要件に沿った提案を行う

- 担当営業、CSM、コンサルタント、パートナーとアカウントチームを組み、導入後の定着・利活用・拡張まで見据えた計画と実行をリードする

- API、SDK、MCP等の開発者向け機能やエコシステムを活用し、Boxをお客様の業務基盤・AI基盤に組み込むための技術支援を行う

 EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, and any other protected ground of discrimination under applicable human rights legislation.

jobs.description:
GES is seeking a highly skilled Senior Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) Engineer to support the Defense Enclave Services (DES) program-an enterprise-scale digital modernization initiative for the Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) and Department of Defense (DoD) Fourth Estate Agencies.

 In this role, you will lead the design, implementation, and optimization of modern endpoint management solutions, with a primary focus on Microsoft Intune and cloud-native device management. You will play a key role in migrating legacy environments (MECM and on-premises Active Directory) to Azure AD-joined, Intune-managed endpoints, helping drive secure, scalable, and user-centric solutions across the enterprise.

 This position requires both deep technical expertise and the ability to collaborate across engineering, security, and operations teams to deliver resilient and compliant endpoint solutions.

 Primary Responsibilities

Lead the design, architecture, and deployment of Microsoft Intune solutions aligned with enterprise security, compliance, and user experience requirements
Drive endpoint modernization efforts, including migration from MECM and traditional AD-joined devices to Azure AD-joined and Intune-managed environments
Develop and manage Intune policies and configurations, including compliance policies, configuration profiles, and application deployment strategies
Package, deploy, and lifecycle-manage applications in Intune, emphasizing automation, version control, and end-user experience
Architect and implement Windows 10/11 provisioning and deployment solutions using Intune, Autopilot, Enrollment Status Page (ESP), and modern provisioning techniques
Configure and optimize Windows Update for Business (WUfB) to ensure secure, reliable, and timely OS patching
Collaborate with infrastructure and identity teams to translate and modernize Group Policy Objects (GPOs) into Intune-based controls (Settings Catalog, ADMX-backed policies)
Partner with Active Directory and MECM/SCCM teams to ensure coexistence strategies and migration readiness
Integrate Intune with the broader Microsoft 365 ecosystem, including Defender for Endpoint, Conditional Access, and Zero Trust security models
Implement and enforce endpoint security best practices, including encryption, endpoint protection, compliance baselines, and data loss prevention
Support security operations by monitoring endpoint-related incidents and integrating telemetry with SIEM/SOC workflows
Identify opportunities to optimize endpoint management processes, recommending improvements and driving adoption of modern management capabilities
Develop and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, configuration standards, and migration strategies
 Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree with 4+ years of relevant experience, or Master's degree with 2+ years of experience (additional experience may be considered in lieu of degree)
Active DoD Secret clearance
Proven experience implementing and administering Microsoft Intune, including endpoint enrollment, configuration, and migration.Hands-on experience packaging, testing, and deploying Windows applications using Microsoft Intune.Strong proficiency in PowerShell scripting to automate administrative tasks, streamline deployments, and troubleshoot endpoint issues.Experience collaborating directly with customers, end users, and stakeholders to gather requirements, provide project updates, and deliver technical solutions.Excellent communication, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.Working knowledge of Atlassian tools, including Jira and Confluence, for project tracking, documentation, and team collaboration.Current DoD 8570 IAT Level II certification (e.g., Security+ CE, CISSP)
 Desired Qualifications
Microsoft certifications such as Microsoft Endpoint Administrator Associate or Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator ExpertExperience with large-scale enterprise migrations to cloud-native endpoint management
Familiarity with Zero Trust architecture and modern identity/security frameworks
Experience integrating endpoint management with SIEM/SOC platforms

Contract Remote

jobs.description:
Description

 The EUT Specialist-_SME provides senior technical leadership for endpoint management services supporting the SEC Infrastructure Support Services (ISS) contract. This role ensures secure, reliable lifecycle operations for SEC endpoint platforms, including Windows devices, virtual endpoints, and mobile assets, in alignment with PWS requirements for compliance, operational readiness, and service quality. The SME leads design and enforcement of endpoint baselines, patching, vulnerability remediation, and policy controls while supporting modernization initiatives such as Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint. The position also drives cross-functional resolution of complex endpoint issues, maintains SOPs and documentation for audit readiness, and mentors technical staff to improve service performance and consistency.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Endpoint Lifecycle and Platform Operations

- Lead operations and maintenance for SEC-issued endpoints, including laptops, desktops, virtual computers, and mobile devices.

- Direct provisioning, configuration, and decommissioning activities across the full endpoint lifecycle in accordance with SEC standards.

- Oversee enterprise application packaging, deployment, and maintenance for baseline and mission-specific software.

- Manage preproduction endpoint environments to validate new configurations, updates, and releases before production deployment.

Security, Compliance, and Policy Governance

- Establish and maintain endpoint configuration baselines, compliance policies, and security controls for Windows and supported mobile platforms.

- Lead patch and vulnerability management activities, including remediation planning and closure reporting.

- Develop, maintain, and version-control endpoint SOPs, architecture artifacts, and operational documentation to support FISMA and audit readiness.

- Ensure endpoint operations align with SEC policy, zero-trust objectives, and approved change control processes.

Intune Engineering and Automation

- Serve as the technical SME for Microsoft Intune in Windows environments, including device configuration profiles, compliance policies, and application delivery.

- Lead Autopilot and endpoint onboarding workflows to improve deployment speed, user readiness, and provisioning consistency.

- Design and implement PowerShell and automation solutions to reduce manual effort, improve reliability, and standardize endpoint operations.

- Integrate endpoint management workflows with enterprise tooling and reporting processes to improve visibility and service performance.

Incident Resolution, Collaboration, and Service Improvement

- Lead complex troubleshooting for Autopilot enrollment failures, policy conflicts, application packaging issues, and endpoint compliance anomalies.

- Coordinate with security, infrastructure, service desk, and vendor teams to resolve escalated incidents and prevent recurrence.

- Provide technical mentorship and quality oversight to endpoint engineers and support personnel.

- Support endpoint SLA/operational reporting, including metrics for patch compliance, incident trends, lifecycle status, and service outcomes.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

US Citizenship required: Must meet contract requirements.

Clearance: Ability to obtain and maintain SEC Public Trust (or higher if required).

Education: Bachelors in a relevant field (e.g., Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering).

Experience:

- 10+ years of experience in endpoint engineering and enterprise endpoint management within complex IT environments. A degree can be substituted for years of experience.

- Demonstrated subject matter expertise in Microsoft Intune for Windows endpoint administration and policy management.

- Demonstrated experience supporting multi-platform endpoint environments, including Windows and mobile/Apple ecosystems.

- Proven experience leading endpoint security, lifecycle management, troubleshooting, and documentation/SOP governance in regulated environments.

- Demonstrated experience leading endpoint modernization initiatives, including Windows Autopilot and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

Technical Skills:

- Microsoft Intune (Windows endpoint management, configuration profiles, compliance policies, and application delivery)

- Multi-platform endpoint administration across Windows and mobile/Apple ecosystem devices

- Windows lifecycle management and endpoint policy baselines

- Endpoint security controls and compliance policy governance

- Windows Autopilot

- Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

- PowerShell scripting and endpoint automation

- Enterprise application packaging and deployment

- Troubleshooting of enrollment failures, policy conflicts, and compliance anomalies

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience supporting U.S. federal IT environments with FISMA, NIST, and zero-trust control implementation.

- Hands-on experience with co-management or migration strategies across Intune and legacy endpoint management platforms.

- Demonstrated success building endpoint operational dashboards and reporting integrations for compliance and SLA tracking.

- Strong experience leading cross-functional endpoint modernization efforts in large, distributed user environments.

- Advanced troubleshooting experience across identity, policy, and security tooling integrations impacting endpoint compliance.

- Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102)

- Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200)

- ITIL 4 Foundation

WORK ENVIRONMENT / OTHER

Operational Support: May require participation in on-call or surge support activities depending on operational needs.

Location: On-site at SEC HQ, Washington, DC.

Travel: As required per contract direction.

Job Description

Only W2 resumes are accepted

Work Location: Role is 100% remote

Candidate location: Candidate must currently reside in Eastern Time Zone.

Key Responsibilities

 Execute the Active Directory, Group Policy, and permissions work backlog: GPO creation, modification, testing, and retirement, plus delegation and access changes. Implement CIS baselines through GPO and scripted remediation, working from the Senior Server Administrator's analysis and direction. The Senior reviews and orchestrates; this role implements. Design, write, and maintain PowerShell for administration, automating, auditing, remediation, and reporting across endpoints and AD. Identify repetitive operational tasks and automate them, replacing manual procedures with tested, documented scripts. Manage the Windows Server lifecycle at enterprise scale: build, configuration, patching, upgrading, troubleshooting, and decommissioning. Receive work as assigned and prioritized by the Server Operations Team Manager, including work routed through the Senior Server Administrator or the Server Administrator under the Manager's oversight. Log, update, and track all work items in Azure DevOps. Work service requests and change controls through the Service Management tool, following the team's change process. Store all work product and documentation in Azure DevOps as work is performed, including scripts, code, GPO documentation, runbooks, and SOPs. All work products are the property of the branch. Cross-skill with the Senior Server Administrator so that AD/GPO and CIS knowledge is shared, not held by one person. Take on additional on-premises duties as team responsibilities are realigned, as directed by the Manager.

Required Skills & Experience

 5+ years of experience with Active Directory: domain services, replication, delegation, permissions, and domain controller troubleshooting. 5+ years of experience with Group Policy: design, scoping, filtering, troubleshooting, and change control in a large environment. 5+ years of experience with PowerShell: modules, error handling, remote execution, scheduled and unattended scripts, and AD/GPO automation. 3+ years of experience with implementation of CIS benchmarks (or equivalent hardening baselines) on Windows endpoints via GPO and scripting. 5+ years of experience with Windows Server administration and lifecycle management across a large server estate, including build, patching, upgrading, and decommissioning. Experience with documenting while working: SOPs, runbooks, and change records kept current, with no after-the-fact write-ups. Experience working from a tracked work queue (such as Azure DevOps boards) and within formal service request and change control processes.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

 Experience with task automation and orchestration beyond PowerShell, such as scheduled workflows and automation platforms. Endpoint patch management experience, including third-party application and Windows OS patching. Third-party application packaging and deployment automation, including application bundles (such as PDQ). PKI and AD Certificate Services operations.

Success Metrics / Deliverables

 Success is assessed against metrics established with the Manager and tracked in Azure DevOps, including AD/GPO backlog reduction, CIS items implemented, and script and documentation coverage. AD/GPO backlog reduced and tracked in Azure DevOps. CIS items implemented per the Senior's direction, with before and after state recorded. Core administrative and remediation tasks covered by tested, documented PowerShell, with a baseline script library in Azure DevOps. All work product, including scripts, code, and documentation, stored in Azure DevOps as property of the branch, with no work held locally or in personal storage. Tested coverage on AD/GPO and PowerShell-based processes, so that more than one person can run and support them. SOPs for recurring AD/GPO and hardening tasks written and reviewed by the Senior.

Role: Senior macOS Cyber Security Engineer, Endpoint Security (C++/Swift)

Location: Remote (PST working hours)

Requirement Type: Contractual

Experience: 6-10 years, we can evaluate more senior as well but need to build a pyramid.

W-2 Rate: $65 - $70/hr.

Job Description:

About the work

You'll work on the macOS sensor for CrowdStrike Falcon, an on-device security agent. It monitors file, process, network and identity activity, blocks malicious behavior, and streams telemetry to the cloud. The sensor runs entirely in user space as a System Extension. Much of the code is shared with Windows and Linux. The work requires high concurrency, high reliability, careful attention to memory & CPU usage and performance.

Required

- Languages: modern C++ (C++17/20) and Swift 6 (async/await, actors, strict concurrency checking). Also Objective-C++ to bridge Swift, C++ and C APIs.

- macOS systems programming: Foundation and CoreFoundation, GCD and pthreads, POSIX/BSD APIs, Mach IPC, launchd daemons and agents, and XPC (C API and NSXPC
Connection).

· Performance, debugging and test:

o Profiling CPU and memory with Instruments and os_signpost.

o Debugging with LLDB, crash logs and os_log.

o XC
Test, sanitizers, fuzzing, and xcodebuild-based CI.

o Apple Silicon and Intel.

- Experience with codebases shared across Mac, Windows and Linux.

Core skills (one or more of the areas listed below)

- Process model and IPC: launchd daemons and agents, and XPC (C API and NSXPC
Connection).

- Endpoint Security and System Extensions: Endpoint Security clients handling both blocking (AUTH) events and notification events, user/MDM approval, upgrades.

- Network Extension: content filters, both flow-level (NEFilterDataProvider) and packet-level (NEFilterPacketProvider), and Network.framework.

- Security and crypto: Verifying code signatures (SecCode / SecStaticCode) and validating certificates (SecTrust), Keychain, Entitlements, hardened runtime, and macOS privacy permissions.

- Devices and storage: IO
Kit (hardware and device enumeration) and DiskArbitration (disk and volume events).

- Packaging and deployment: installers, notarization, and MDM configuration profiles deployed through Jamf, Intune or similar tools.

- Performance, debugging and test: Profiling CPU and memory with Instruments and os_signpost, Debugging with LLDB, crash logs and os_log, XC
Test, sanitizers, fuzzing, and xcodebuild-based CI.

Nice to have

- UI: SwiftUI and AppKit apps and app extensions.

- Testing against macOS and Xcode betas before public release.

- Experience shipping EDR/AV, network security or device-management products.

Job Title: Senior macOS Cyber Security Engineer – Endpoint Security (C++/Swift) Location: Remote – United States Work Schedule: Pacific Standard Time (PST) working hours Employment Type: Contract ( W2 only ) Experience: 6–10 years (more experienced candidates may also be considered) Work Authorization: No specific visa restriction(F1 Opt not allowed) Job OverviewWe are looking for experienced Senior macOS Cyber Security Engineers to develop, enhance, and maintain endpoint security capabilities for the CrowdStrike Falcon sensor.

 Job Title: Senior macOS Cyber Security Engineer – Endpoint Security (C++/Swift)

 Location: Remote – United States
 Work Schedule: Pacific Standard Time (PST) working hours
 Employment Type: Contract ( W2 only )
 Experience: 6–10 years (more experienced candidates may also be considered)
 Work Authorization: No specific visa restriction(F1 Opt not allowed)

Job Overview

We are looking for experienced Senior macOS Cyber Security Engineers to develop, enhance, and maintain endpoint security capabilities for the CrowdStrike Falcon sensor. This on-device security agent monitors file, process, network, and identity activity, prevents malicious behavior, and sends security telemetry to the cloud.

The role focuses on macOS systems programming, endpoint security, high-performance software development, and security agent reliability. The sensor operates in user space as a macOS System Extension, requiring strong expertise in concurrency, memory management, CPU optimization, debugging, and cross-platform development.

Key Responsibilities

-
Develop and maintain macOS endpoint security components using modern C++, Swift, and Objective-C++.

-
Implement security features that monitor file, process, network, and identity activities.

-
Work with macOS System Extensions, Endpoint Security APIs, Network Extensions, and interprocess communication mechanisms.

-
Design and optimize concurrent, high-reliability software with careful attention to CPU utilization, memory consumption, and system performance.

-
Troubleshoot complex issues using debugging, crash analysis, logging, and profiling tools.

-
Develop and maintain automated tests and contribute to continuous integration pipelines.

-
Collaborate on shared codebases supporting macOS, Windows, and Linux.

-
Ensure compatibility with Apple Silicon and Intel-based Mac systems.

-
Contribute to secure software design, code quality, performance improvements, and production reliability.

Required Technical Skills

-

Programming Languages

  -
Strong hands-on experience with modern C++ (C++17/C++20).

  -
Proficiency in Swift, including Swift 6, async/await, actors, and strict concurrency checking.

  -
Experience with Objective-C++ for integrating Swift, C++, and C APIs.

-

macOS Systems Programming

  -
Strong knowledge of Foundation and CoreFoundation.

  -
Experience with Grand Central Dispatch (GCD), pthreads, POSIX/BSD APIs, and Mach IPC.

  -
Familiarity with launchd daemons and agents, XPC C APIs, and NSXPC
Connection.

-

Performance, Debugging, and Testing

  -
Experience profiling CPU and memory usage with Instruments and os_signpost.

  -
Proficiency in LLDB, crash log analysis, and os_log.

  -
Experience with XC
Test, sanitizers, fuzz testing, and xcodebuild-based CI.

  -
Understanding of performance optimization and memory management in production software.

-

Cross-Platform Development

  -
Experience working with large codebases shared across macOS, Windows, and Linux.

  -
Ability to develop reliable, maintainable, and performance-sensitive system software.

Core macOS Security Expertise

Candidates should have hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas:

-
 Endpoint Security and System Extensions: Endpoint Security clients, authorization (AUTH) events, notification events, user/MDM approval, and extension upgrades.

-
 Network Security: Network Extension content filters, NEFilterDataProvider, NEFilterPacketProvider, and Network.framework.

-
 Process Management and IPC: launchd services, daemons, agents, XPC, and interprocess communication.

-
 Security and Cryptography: Code-signature verification using SecCode/SecStaticCode, certificate validation using SecTrust, Keychain, entitlements, hardened runtime, and macOS privacy permissions.

-
 Devices and Storage: IO
Kit for hardware and device enumeration, and DiskArbitration for disk and volume events.

-
 Packaging and Deployment: macOS installers, application notarization, and MDM configuration profiles using Jamf, Microsoft Intune, or similar platforms.

Nice-to-Have Skills

-
Experience developing SwiftUI or AppKit applications and app extensions.

-
Experience testing software against macOS and Xcode beta releases before public availability.

-
Background in endpoint detection and response (EDR), antivirus (AV), network security, or device-management products.

-
Experience building and maintaining security agents or other low-level system software.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will have strong macOS systems programming experience, proficiency in C++ and Swift, and practical knowledge of operating-system internals, concurrency, debugging, and performance optimization. Candidates with experience building commercial endpoint security products, EDR/AV agents, or macOS security extensions will be highly preferred.

Interview Process

Interviews are expected to begin immediately. Candidates should be available for prompt interview scheduling and comfortable working during Pacific Time business hours.

Submission Details

Interested candidates should share their updated resume along with their current location, work authorization, contact details, total years of experience, relevant macOS development experience, expected hourly rate, and interview availability.

Position Overview

We are seeking an individual who can demonstrate technical proficiency, strong communication skills, and has the desire to learn and be involved in maintaining the security of our clients through the patching process. Thrive ’s Patching Team is responsible for supporting internal staff and our clients in utilizing our systems to manage and support regular patching in client environments. The Systems Administrator will be responsible for a variety of tasks, including but not limited to configuration, troubleshooting, remediation, and creating documentation of processes. This position may require working outside normal business hours as needed.

 ESSENTIAL DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES may include but are not limited to the following:

- Follow Thrive 's established best practices for task management.

- Manage the daily prioritization, coding, and routing of service incidents, requests, and change control.

- Design and implement patching schedules and configurations, aligning customer requirements with Thrive Service Offerings.

- Set and manage client expectations throughout the troubleshooting process, maintaining a focus on both prompt resolution and world-class customer service.

- Troubleshoot patching issues, installation failures, and configuration-related errors.

- Perform patch maintenance including onboarding, approvals, catalog updates, and client configurations.

- Create and maintain documentation for processes, procedures, and system configurations.

- Regular communication with clients regarding their patching and configurations.

- Document time within case management system following Thrive ’s best practices.

- Communicate with customers via phone, email, and chat in a timely, courteous, empathetic, and professional manner, providing clear updates and case status throughout the resolution process.

- Organize and own customer cadence meetings to regularly discuss patch configuration and patch health score results.

- Stay current on new technologies to provide updated support and training to staff and clients.

- Collaborate with team members and support tasks outside core responsibilities as needed.

- Other duties as assigned by management.

Requirements

**What IT Client Services contributes to Cardinal Health**
Information Technology oversees the effective development, delivery, and operation of computing and information services. This function anticipates, plans, and delivers Information Technology solutions and strategies that enable operations and drive business value.
IT Client Services provides Tier 1-3 virtual and physical support to the organization's end users for software, hardware, digital employee experience management, conference room technology and meeting support, warehouse technology, server, network, and enterprise systems issues. Frequently responding to escalated issues from the IT Service Center, this group resolves user requests through discussions with users and coordination with internal and external resources and provides education and trainings to users to facilitate knowledge transfer and prevent problem reoccurrence. IT Client Services also maintains ownership for certain end user productivity platforms and capabilities, such as virtual environments and collaboration toolsets, and addresses service outages. This area acquires, installs and upgrades PC components and software, while also performing asset management for software and hardware.
**Digital Employee Experience (DEX) Product Owner Role Summary**
The Digital Employee Experience (DEX) Product Owner is responsible for leading the execution and value realization of Cardinal Health's Digital Employee Experience transformation roadmap. This role will serve as the business owner and strategic leader for a multi-year DEX program focused on improving employee productivity, reducing digital friction, modernizing IT service delivery, and enabling proactive employee experiences through data, automation, AI, and journey-based design.
The Digital Employee Experience (DEX) product owner role is responsible for ensuring Cardinal Health realizes the full value of its DEX tool investment. This product owner role is responsible for converting telemetry, sentiment, and operational insights into measurable business outcomes including improved employee productivity, lower support costs, optimized technology spending (i.e. tech refresh), and enhanced employee experiences.
The DEX Product Owner will function as both a strategic transformation leader and a traditional technical Product Owner, overseeing a team responsible for DEX analytics, experience campaigns, and value realization while managing the product backlog, change controls, and release governance with Client Engineering and support teams. Job Title: Senior macOS Cyber Security Engineer – Endpoint Security (C++/Swift)

Location: Remote – United States
Work Schedule: Pacific Standard Time (PST) working hours
Employment Type: Contract ( W2 only )
Experience: 6–10 years (more experienced candidates may also be considered)
Work Authorization: No specific visa restriction(F1 Opt not allowed)

Job Overview

We are looking for experienced Senior macOS Cyber Security Engineers to develop, enhance, and maintain endpoint security capabilities for the CrowdStrike Falcon sensor. This on-device security agent monitors file, process, network, and identity activity, prevents malicious behavior, and sends security telemetry to the cloud.

The role focuses on macOS systems programming, endpoint security, high-performance software development, and security agent reliability. The sensor operates in user space as a macOS System Extension, requiring strong expertise in concurrency, memory management, CPU optimization, debugging, and cross-platform development.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and maintain macOS endpoint security components using modern C++, Swift, and Objective-C++.

Implement security features that monitor file, process, network, and identity activities.

Work with macOS System Extensions, Endpoint Security APIs, Network Extensions, and interprocess communication mechanisms.

Design and optimize concurrent, high-reliability software with careful attention to CPU utilization, memory consumption, and system performance.

Troubleshoot complex issues using debugging, crash analysis, logging, and profiling tools.

Develop and maintain automated tests and contribute to continuous integration pipelines.

Collaborate on shared codebases supporting macOS, Windows, and Linux.

Ensure compatibility with Apple Silicon and Intel-based Mac systems.

Contribute to secure software design, code quality, performance improvements, and production reliability.

Required Technical Skills

Programming Languages

Strong hands-on experience with modern C++ (C++17/C++20).

Proficiency in Swift, including Swift 6, async/await, actors, and strict concurrency checking.

Experience with Objective-C++ for integrating Swift, C++, and C APIs.

macOS Systems Programming

Strong knowledge of Foundation and CoreFoundation.

Experience with Grand Central Dispatch (GCD), pthreads, POSIX/BSD APIs, and Mach IPC.

Familiarity with launchd daemons and agents, XPC C APIs, and NSXPC
Connection.

Performance, Debugging, and Testing

Experience profiling CPU and memory usage with Instruments and os_signpost.

Proficiency in LLDB, crash log analysis, and os_log.

Experience with XC
Test, sanitizers, fuzz testing, and xcodebuild-based CI.

Understanding of performance optimization and memory management in production software.

Cross-Platform Development

Experience working with large codebases shared across macOS, Windows, and Linux.

Ability to develop reliable, maintainable, and performance-sensitive system software.

Core macOS Security Expertise

Candidates should have hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas:

Endpoint Security and System Extensions: Endpoint Security clients, authorization (AUTH) events, notification events, user/MDM approval, and extension upgrades.

Network Security: Network Extension content filters, NEFilterDataProvider, NEFilterPacketProvider, and Network.framework.

Process Management and IPC: launchd services, daemons, agents, XPC, and interprocess communication.

Security and Cryptography: Code-signature verification using SecCode/SecStaticCode, certificate validation using SecTrust, Keychain, entitlements, hardened runtime, and macOS privacy permissions.

Devices and Storage: IO
Kit for hardware and device enumeration, and DiskArbitration for disk and volume events.

Packaging and Deployment: macOS installers, application notarization, and MDM configuration profiles using Jamf, Microsoft Intune, or similar platforms.

Nice-to-Have Skills

Experience developing SwiftUI or AppKit applications and app extensions.

Experience testing software against macOS and Xcode beta releases before public availability.

Background in endpoint detection and response (EDR), antivirus (AV), network security, or device-management products.

Experience building and maintaining security agents or other low-level system software.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will have strong macOS systems programming experience, proficiency in C++ and Swift, and practical knowledge of operating-system internals, concurrency, debugging, and performance optimization. Candidates with experience building commercial endpoint security products, EDR/AV agents, or macOS security extensions will be highly preferred.

Interview Process

Interviews are expected to begin immediately. Candidates should be available for prompt interview scheduling and comfortable working during Pacific Time business hours.

Submission Details

Interested candidates should share their updated resume along with their current location, work authorization, contact details, total years of experience, relevant macOS development experience, expected hourly rate, and interview availability.

jobs.description:
About Flexport: At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward.

 About Flexport :

At Flexport , we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

 The Opportunity:

 Flexport IT is looking for a Senior IT Systems Engineer to support our SaaS based Collaboration and Endpoint Management platforms. In this role, you will be responsible for the configuration, integration, administration, and support of Google Workspace, Slack, Office365, Confluence, Jira, Okta, Jamf, and Intune. You will play a critical role in ensuring these platforms are secure, scalable, and optimized. The candidate will have broad knowledge across IT as a whole, in-depth hands on working knowledge, and a strong security mindset.

Your expertise will be critical in automating workflows, protecting sensitive systems and data, mitigating security risks, and maintaining compliance. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, lead IT engineering projects, and provide day to day operations support.

 You Will

- Administer and provide escalation support for our SaaS platforms.

- Implement and maintain policies, software deployment, patching, and security compliance for our Mac and Windows endpoints, using Jamf and Intune.

- Own the lifecycle management across our core collaboration and endpoint management platforms.

- Develop automation scripts and workflows to improve administrative efficiency and user experience (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Okta Workflows).

- Monitor system health, performance, and usage; proactively resolve or escalate issues.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Security, Engineering, HR, Legal) to ensure proper alignment and integration of SaaS tools with company infrastructure and processes.

- Perform investigations/discovery across our systems for Legal and HR.

- Assist in vendor management and product evaluations.

- Drive solutions and project work.

- Onboard new applications for single sign-on.

- Develop and maintain technical operating procedures, policies, and engineering roadmaps.

- Work closely with the Security team to ensure the platform is designed and implemented with security best practices.

- Provide Tier 3 IT support.

 You Should Have

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field (or comparable experience).

- 3+ years of experience in supporting SaaS Collaboration tools, Mac and Windows endpoint management.

- Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

- In-depth knowledge of email delivery flow, IT security, and IAM concepts.

- Understanding of RBAC and permissions models across core SaaS applications.

- Scripting and automation experience.

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

 Role: Senior macOS Cyber Security Engineer, Endpoint Security (C++/Swift)
 Location: Remote (PST working hours)

 Client : Accenture/Amazon
 Work Authorization: U.S. Citizen (USC) or Green Card (GC) holders only

 Requirement Type : Contractual

 Experience : 6-10 years, we can evaluate more senior as well but need to build a pyramid.
 W-2 Rate: $65 - $70/hr.
J ob Description:
About the work
You'll work on the macOS sensor for CrowdStrike Falcon, an on-device security agent. It monitors file, process, network and identity activity, blocks malicious behavior, and streams telemetry to the cloud. The sensor runs entirely in user space as a System Extension. Much of the code is shared with Windows and Linux. The work requires high concurrency, high reliability, careful attention to memory & CPU usage and performance.

Required

- Languages: modern C++ (C++17/20) and Swift 6 (async/await, actors, strict concurrency checking). Also Objective-C++ to bridge Swift, C++ and C APIs.

- macOS systems programming: Foundation and CoreFoundation, GCD and pthreads, POSIX/BSD APIs, Mach IPC, launchd daemons and agents, and XPC (C API and NSXPC
Connection).

· Performance, debugging and test:

o Profiling CPU and memory with Instruments and os_signpost.

o Debugging with LLDB, crash logs and os_log.

o XC
Test, sanitizers, fuzzing, and xcodebuild-based CI.

o Apple Silicon and Intel.

- Experience with codebases shared across Mac, Windows and Linux.

 Core skills (one or more of the areas listed below)

- Process model and IPC: launchd daemons and agents, and XPC (C API and NSXPC
Connection).

- Endpoint Security and System Extensions: Endpoint Security clients handling both blocking (AUTH) events and notification events, user/MDM approval, upgrades.

- Network Extension: content filters, both flow-level (NEFilterDataProvider) and packet-level (NEFilterPacketProvider), and Network.framework.

- Security and crypto: Verifying code signatures (SecCode / SecStaticCode) and validating certificates (SecTrust), Keychain, Entitlements, hardened runtime, and macOS privacy permissions.

- Devices and storage: IO
Kit (hardware and device enumeration) and DiskArbitration (disk and volume events).

- Packaging and deployment: installers, notarization, and MDM configuration profiles deployed through Jamf, Intune or similar tools.

- Performance, debugging and test: Profiling CPU and memory with Instruments and os_signpost, Debugging with LLDB, crash logs and os_log, XC
Test, sanitizers, fuzzing, and xcodebuild-based CI.

Nice to have

- UI: SwiftUI and AppKit apps and app extensions.

- Testing against macOS and Xcode betas before public release.

- Experience shipping EDR/AV, network security or device-management products.

Rubrik's Product Line Sales organization drives focused growth across Rubrik's specialized workloads, including our SaaS data protection and security portfolio (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Salesforce, and other critical SaaS applications). We're hiring a SaaS Product Line Sales Specialist to own and accelerate Rubrik's SaaS data protection business within a defined territory. This is a highly technical, quota-carrying overlay role: you'll be the subject-matter expert who can go deep on tenant architecture, identity and access models, backup and recovery mechanics, and the shared responsibility model — and use that fluency to win deals against SaaS-native point solutions. jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE SECURITY TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - You're securing the frontier of AI. The model weights training on our infrastructure are the most valuable and most targeted artifacts in technology, and we're standing up the compute to hold them faster than anyone ever has. A breach isn't a leak, it's the frontier walking out the door.

 - Build the entire security program from scratch. Most leaders inherit someone else's system and spend a career patching it. Here you own it end to end, bare metal to boardroom, as we scale across continents.

 - The industry's playbook was written for one building at a time. Vendor-managed appliances, manual process, and standards that assume a security team walks the floor. None of that survives contact with what we're building, so we build what should exist rather than buying what does.

 - Your threat surface is measured in gigawatts. The customers running on our infrastructure are building the most consequential technology in human history, and being responsible for the physical and logical security of that work makes everything else feel small.

ROLE SCOPE

 - Design the security control plane end to end and make the architecture decisions the rest of the platform locks against, before the first campus depends on them.

 - Build and operate that control plane at every site, on premises where resilience and bandwidth demand it, with a thin management layer in the cloud where that serves better.

 - Own PKI, certificate lifecycle, identity integration, and automated deprovisioning, so access ends the moment employment does rather than at the next audit.

 - Build the integrations, APIs, and monitoring that tell you a site is degrading before anyone files a ticket, on an estate adding campuses faster than any manual model can track.

 - Reject the hand-built, appliance-per-site, vendor-managed pattern the physical security industry treats as normal, and replace it with infrastructure that is versioned, reproducible, and recoverable.

 - Own backup, disaster recovery, and the non-production environment where changes are proven before they reach a live site.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c

 - You've designed and run a production virtualization and clustered storage platform, and you can walk through a failover you actually tested rather than one you assumed would work.

 - You've been the design authority on an architecture other people built against, and you can name a decision you got wrong and what it cost to unwind.

 - You've owned database high availability and recovery, and you've restored from your own backups rather than trusting that they ran.

 - You run PKI and certificate lifecycle as automation, so expiry is a solved problem rather than something that pages you at 2am.

 - You've integrated identity systems so provisioning and deprovisioning happen without a human in the loop.

 - You've replaced a vendor-managed or hand-built system with something reproducible, and you can explain what the accepted approach gets wrong and why.

 - You write code and scripts as a normal part of the job, not as an occasional exception.

 - Bonus: Video management and access control platforms (Genetec Security Center, Milestone, Lenel). Enterprise virtualization and clustered storage (Hyper-V, VMware vSphere, Nutanix, failover clustering). Database high availability (SQL Server Always On, clustering). Cloud management planes (AWS). Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell DSC).

We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We're hiring a Sr. Infrastructure Engineer to own the shared layer that every Harvey IT system runs on. You'll join Core IT Engineering & Infrastructure, reporting to Dave Vega, Director of IT, alongside engineers who own identity and collaboration, Microsoft platforms, networking, and client platforms.

Harvey is cloud-first. We run no servers or data centers of our own. Our IT infrastructure is cloud tenants, SaaS configuration, office networks across a growing global footprint, and the automation that ties them together. Today that cross-cutting work is done on the side by each platform owner. This role makes it someone's primary job, so it gets built once, done well, and doesn't break quietly.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

You'll own the shared infrastructure, automation and reliability work that cuts across every IT platform.

 - IT cloud accounts and tenants. Own access, guardrails and cost for the cloud accounts IT runs (AWS, Azure, GCP projects for IT tooling). Be the BizTech engineering partner to Security and Infrastructure on tenant-level changes, such as cloud migrations that touch Entra and M365.

 - Infrastructure as code for IT. Build and run the Git repos, CI pipelines and review process for IT configuration (Okta, Jamf, Intune, Google Workspace). Platform owners keep owning their config. You own the framework they all use.

 - IT automation and provisioning. Own the automation behind identity lifecycle and IT workflows: SCIM and provisioning flows, onboarding and offboarding orchestration across systems, and IT workflows in Serval.

 - Monitoring, backup and resilience. Set up health checks and alerting for critical IT systems and integrations, config drift detection, SaaS backup (Google, Slack, M365) and tested recovery runbooks.

 - Scripts and internal tooling. Take over the scripts and admin utilities that live on individual laptops today. Put them in source control, document them and keep them running.

 - Office site standard. Work with Network and AV/Media teams to define the repeatable technical template for new offices: configuration, monitoring and documentation each site copies. Network and AV build execution stays with their owners.

 - Engineering practices. Raise the bar on change control, documentation and runbooks across the pillar, so primaries and backups can cover for each other.

 - Certificates, domains and DNS. Track and renew every certificate IT depends on (Apple Push, SAML signing, SSL, Wi-Fi/802.1X). Work with Network and CorpSec teams to own and manage DNS NS solutions for IT. Build expiry monitoring to avoid surprises.

WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 6+ years in corporate IT engineering, systems engineering or SRE, with at least 2 years owning shared infrastructure or automation for a SaaS-first company.

 - Strong infrastructure-as-code experience. You've managed real systems with Terraform or similar, in Git, with pull-request review and CI.

 - Solid scripting in Python plus one of Bash, PowerShell or Go. You write code other people can read and maintain.

 - Hands-on with identity and provisioning: SAML, OIDC, SCIM and lifecycle automation in Okta or Entra.

 - Working knowledge of at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP): IAM, accounts and cost basics.

 - Comfort with DNS, TLS and certificate management, and basic enterprise networking.

 - You've built monitoring and alerting that people actually trust, and written runbooks that someone else used successfully.

 - Clear written communication. You can explain a change, its risk and its rollback to non-engineers.

BONUS POINTS

 - Terraform providers for Okta, Google Workspace or Jamf, or config-as-code tools for Intune

 - Serval or similar IT automation platforms

 - SaaS backup and recovery tools for Google Workspace, Slack or M365

 - Multi-site office rollouts across regions, including working with local vendors and ISPs

 - Experience at a fast-growing company where company headcount grew faster than the IT team

COMPENSATION

$153,000 - $210,500 USD

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Corporate Technology Services, the Digital Workplace Engineer is a technical manager accountable for the Desktop Engineering service that the managed service provider (MSP) delivers for AMETEK. In this role you will ensure the MSP meets contractual requirements and service levels, and acts as the quality gate by testing and validating changes to the endpoint environment (Microsoft Intune, MDM and Tanium) before they move to production.

The Digital Workplace
Engineer also serves as AMETEK's technical authority for end-user computing and the primary link between the MSP, IT Architecture and Cybersecurity.
