jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We're hiring a Sr. Infrastructure Engineer to own the shared layer that every Harvey IT system runs on. You'll join Core IT Engineering & Infrastructure, reporting to Dave Vega, Director of IT, alongside engineers who own identity and collaboration, Microsoft platforms, networking, and client platforms.

Harvey is cloud-first. We run no servers or data centers of our own. Our IT infrastructure is cloud tenants, SaaS configuration, office networks across a growing global footprint, and the automation that ties them together. Today that cross-cutting work is done on the side by each platform owner. This role makes it someone's primary job, so it gets built once, done well, and doesn't break quietly.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

You'll own the shared infrastructure, automation and reliability work that cuts across every IT platform.

 - IT cloud accounts and tenants. Own access, guardrails and cost for the cloud accounts IT runs (AWS, Azure, GCP projects for IT tooling). Be the BizTech engineering partner to Security and Infrastructure on tenant-level changes, such as cloud migrations that touch Entra and M365.

 - Infrastructure as code for IT. Build and run the Git repos, CI pipelines and review process for IT configuration (Okta, Jamf, Intune, Google Workspace). Platform owners keep owning their config. You own the framework they all use.

 - IT automation and provisioning. Own the automation behind identity lifecycle and IT workflows: SCIM and provisioning flows, onboarding and offboarding orchestration across systems, and IT workflows in Serval.

 - Monitoring, backup and resilience. Set up health checks and alerting for critical IT systems and integrations, config drift detection, SaaS backup (Google, Slack, M365) and tested recovery runbooks.

 - Scripts and internal tooling. Take over the scripts and admin utilities that live on individual laptops today. Put them in source control, document them and keep them running.

 - Office site standard. Work with Network and AV/Media teams to define the repeatable technical template for new offices: configuration, monitoring and documentation each site copies. Network and AV build execution stays with their owners.

 - Engineering practices. Raise the bar on change control, documentation and runbooks across the pillar, so primaries and backups can cover for each other.

 - Certificates, domains and DNS. Track and renew every certificate IT depends on (Apple Push, SAML signing, SSL, Wi-Fi/802.1X). Work with Network and CorpSec teams to own and manage DNS NS solutions for IT. Build expiry monitoring to avoid surprises.

WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 6+ years in corporate IT engineering, systems engineering or SRE, with at least 2 years owning shared infrastructure or automation for a SaaS-first company.

 - Strong infrastructure-as-code experience. You've managed real systems with Terraform or similar, in Git, with pull-request review and CI.

 - Solid scripting in Python plus one of Bash, PowerShell or Go. You write code other people can read and maintain.

 - Hands-on with identity and provisioning: SAML, OIDC, SCIM and lifecycle automation in Okta or Entra.

 - Working knowledge of at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP): IAM, accounts and cost basics.

 - Comfort with DNS, TLS and certificate management, and basic enterprise networking.

 - You've built monitoring and alerting that people actually trust, and written runbooks that someone else used successfully.

 - Clear written communication. You can explain a change, its risk and its rollback to non-engineers.

BONUS POINTS

 - Terraform providers for Okta, Google Workspace or Jamf, or config-as-code tools for Intune

 - Serval or similar IT automation platforms

 - SaaS backup and recovery tools for Google Workspace, Slack or M365

 - Multi-site office rollouts across regions, including working with local vendors and ISPs

 - Experience at a fast-growing company where company headcount grew faster than the IT team

COMPENSATION

$153,000 - $210,500 USD

 IT WINDOWS SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR

SpaceX is looking for a Systems Administrator with knowledge and broad experience across Microsoft-based technologies. This employee will be a member of the Information Technology Windows Infrastructure team and will support all SpaceX personnel. The ideal candidate will be flexible and flourish in a fast-paced and challenging environment. They should be a self-starter, self-motivator, and possess ingenuity to excel at this position.

- Support users and maintain critical resources in a broad range of use cases and environments.

- Troubleshoot and recover failed Windows systems or resources.

- Implement policies based on guidance from security and engineering teams.

- Define, document, and implement best practice standards.

- Support user productivity applications such as O365, Outlook, Teams.

- Monitor for and remediate critical issues in production environments.

- Contribute to Internal Documentation and Runbooks.

- Partner with Internal Service Desk Teams for ticketing escalations and triage.

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- Bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline and 1+ years of experience in IT systems administration OR 3+ years of experience in IT systems administration without a degree.

- 3+ years of experience maintaining a Windows-based infrastructure, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, IIS, etc.

 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Experience with Authentication and SSO solutions (SAML, OIDC/OAUTH, Flask, Mellon, ADFS, NPS/Radius/Tacacs).

- 5+ years implementing and troubleshooting Windows systems (Windows 10/11, Windows Server 2016+).

- Analysis of memory dump and logs for advanced troubleshooting of systems.

- Recovery of failed Windows systems (unable to boot).

- Imaging of Windows systems (WDS, sysprep).

- Operating system patch management at scale.

- Experience in leveraging code repositories and revisioning tools.

- Understanding of EntraID as an authentication platform and Identity Provider with security features.

- Experience in user administration in Active Directory and EntraID.

Ware and supporting a virtual infrastructure

jobs.description:
Latitude AI ( [lat.ai](http://lat.ai)) is building the future of Ford’s autonomy roadmap to make travel safer, less stressful, and more enjoyable for everyone. Bringing this vision to scale, our fully in-house developed hands-free ADAS platform will debut on the all-new Ford Fathom in 2027.

When you join the Latitude team, you’ll work alongside leading experts across machine learning and robotics, cloud platforms, mapping, sensors and compute systems, test operations, systems and safety engineering – **_all dedicated to redefining the relationship between people and their vehicles for millions of customers._**

As a Ford Motor Company subsidiary, we operate independently to develop automated driving technology at the speed of a technology startup. Latitude is headquartered in Pittsburgh with engineering centers in Dearborn, Mich., and Palo Alto, Calif.

**Meet the Team:**

The Enterprise Cyber Security team is focused on ensuring the resilience of our corporate environment with focus on protection of our corporate systems, IP, and employee data. We are a close-knit team with strong cross-functional roles in the company.

As a Cyber Security Engineer, you will be the hands-on technical lead securing our High Performance Computing (HPC)/Virtualization environments. Your job is to have a deep understanding of this infrastructure, network architecture, and the operations depending on it, including our software/hardware/network engineering, fleet operations requirements, and administrative functions. You will use your knowledge and experience to design, implement, automate, and continuously improve our security posture.

**What you'll do:**

- Identity Management and Device Management design, implementation, and deployment (Entra/Okta, MDM solutions like Intune)
- Network Security design and engineering, applying best practices in software, network, and infrastructure engineering
- Consult and advocate security best practices for DMZ architectures, NAC/NAP, lateral isolation, and multi-site data movement in Network management tooling (like Palo Alto, Fortinet, F5)
- Deliver projects on time, on budget, with excellent quality and security configurations
- Review the existing and new deployments and architecture designs looking for design flaws, security improvements, and advocate for stronger security controls that meet functional and operational needs
- Work hand-in-hand with the Cloud Platform, IT, and Product teams to research, design and develop security solutions and deployments and strategies tailored to Latitude’s business needs
- Engage actively in Data Center and Network Security initiatives to assess existing security access controls, and implementations of supplemental technical solutions to improve overall security.
- Document findings, conduct comparisons, perform threat and risk assessments, and Proof of Concepts aiding the team in making informed decisions about the impact of various design options.
- Develop, Review, and Design the automation and orchestration for security aspects device controls and access to services
- Provide inputs into dashboards and report metrics on the status of the Cyber Security posture
- Plan for, execute, and follow through on projects and engagements independently
- Hands on deployment of solutions, working independently and as part of a team
- Provide mentoring and skill set knowledge transfer to team members and engineering staff
- Moderate and contribute to Supercomputing System Administration that contributes to:

  - Proactive monitoring, analysis, and correcting system security issues
  - Development of scripts to automate, perform security checks, and develop tools to enhance support of the Cloud/Virtualized systems and development environments

- Developing playbooks/runbooks, operational and troubleshooting documentation
- Evaluate and contribute to designs for Network and Infrastructure Solutions with Security and Functionality as pillars of implementation

**What you'll need to succeed:**

- At a minimum, a Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Cyber Security or a related field and 4+ years of relevant experience (or Master's degree and 2+ years of relevant experience)
- **Strongly prefer 8+ years related experience or 6 years with a Master’s degree; as an Identity and Device Management Engineer and/or Network Security Architect/Engineer. Actively deploying solutions from scratch to Production**
- 2+ years of related experience in vulnerability management and adjusting the risk rating/severity dependent on internal factors for cloud and other infra.
- Experience with Lustre, Kerberos, and Linux Administration
- Proficiency in scripting languages, including Bash, Python, Go, or Java to create production level services and automation tools that incorporate into CI/CD
- Proficiency and hands-on experience using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to automate the creation of cloud resources, virtualized systems, and review infrastructure deployments. E.g. Terraform, Cloud Formation, Ansible, or others
- Ability to grasp new technologies quickly and prioritize and multitask on multiple responsibilities.
- Hands-on Experience with patching and hardening Linux, MacOS, and Windows Systems (clients and servers), images, and containers.
- Proficient in Network Protocols and Firewall Management, with hands-on experience in configuration and optimization to ensure network security internally and at perimeters.
- Critical thinking and a holistic view of Cyber Security with ability to balance security requirements with mission needs and collaboration across teams
- Exceptional organizational and time management skills demonstrated through adept autonomy, independent work, collaborative teamwork, and a professional demeanor.
- Strong experience with architecting/deploying scalable security services and workloads in cloud native and virtualized environments
- Ability to deploy Device Management solutions to control access to Company Solutions
- Understand engineering design limitations and provide guidance for teams to secure their deployments to achieve desired performance in budget and on time
- An Independent take-charge attitude while being open-minded, creatively thinking, willing to take calculated risks, and make informed decisions
- Strong understanding of Cyber Security Standards (ISO27001, NIST 800-53)
- Experience with Jenkins a plus
- Experience with Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) principles and implementations
- Exposure to data governance, secure data movement, and storage lifecycle management
- Must have demonstrated proficiency and strength in verbal, written, presentation, and communications skills, including technical diagramming
- A sense of comradery, compassion, and unparalleled passion/energy

**What we offer you:**

- Competitive compensation packages
- High-quality individual and family medical, dental, and vision insurance
- Health savings account with available employer match
- Employer-matched 401(k) retirement plan with immediate vesting
- Employer-paid group term life insurance and the option to elect voluntary life insurance
- Paid parental leave and Adoption/Surrogacy support program
- Paid medical leave
- Unlimited vacation and 15 paid holidays
- Daily lunches, snacks, and beverages available in all office locations
- Pre-tax spending accounts for healthcare and dependent care expenses
- Pre-tax commuter benefits
- Monthly wellness stipend
- Backup child and elder care program
- Professional development reimbursement
- Employee assistance program
- Discounted programs that include legal services, identity theft protection, pet insurance, and more
- Company and team bonding outlets: employee resource groups, quarterly team activity stipend, and wellness initiatives

Learn more about Latitude’s team, mission and career opportunities at [lat.ai](https://lat.ai/)!

The expected base salary range for this full-time position in California is $160,000 - $240,000 USD. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Latitude employees are also eligible to participate in Latitude’s annual bonus programs, equity compensation, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.

Candidates for positions with Latitude AI must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a culturally diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status or protected veteran status.

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Systems Administrator to independently support and administer Windows and Linux systems within secure enterprise environments. This role is responsible for day-to-day system operations, advanced end-user support, troubleshooting issues beyond documented Tier 1 procedures, maintaining approved configurations, and owning technical issues through resolution or appropriate escalation.

 WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Administer, configure, troubleshoot, and maintain Windows and Linux workstations and systems.

- Independently diagnose and resolve hardware, operating system, application, authentication, and network connectivity issues.

- Perform user, group, permission, service, file-system, and enterprise authentication administration using approved processes.

- Support domain-connected Windows and Linux systems, including troubleshooting domain membership and authentication issues.

- Support workstation provisioning, system deployments, patching, upgrades, approved software installations, and configuration changes.

- Troubleshoot TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing/connectivity, and physical network issues and determine when escalation to network engineering is required.

- Use system logs, Event Viewer, command-line tools, PowerShell and/or Bash to investigate and resolve technical issues.

- Support virtualization environments and virtual machines within established architecture and procedures.

- Create, maintain, and improve SOPs, technical documentation, and repeatable administrative processes.

- Evaluate operational and security impact before making changes and follow approved change-management and configuration-control processes.

- Partner with Cybersecurity, Engineers, and other technical teams to resolve complex issues and maintain secure system operations.

- Provide technical guidance and support to Junior Systems Administrators as needed.

 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Active TS/SCI security clearance.

- Active CompTIA Security+ certification or higher DoD 8140/8570-aligned certification.

- Working knowledge of Windows system administration and troubleshooting.

- Working knowledge of Linux administration, command-line tools, permissions, services, and troubleshooting.

- Experience with Active Directory or comparable centralized identity and authentication services.

- Understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, IP addressing, subnetting, and network troubleshooting.

- Experience independently troubleshooting systems using logs, diagnostic tools, and technical documentation.

- Familiarity with PowerShell, Bash, or similar administrative scripting.

- Ability to work independently within established security requirements, SOPs, and configuration baselines.

- Strong documentation, communication, troubleshooting, and customer-service skills.

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with VMware, Hyper-V, or similar virtualization technologies.

- Experience supporting engineering, manufacturing, or specialized technical applications.

- Experience in DoD, government, classified, or other regulated computing environments.

- Additional Microsoft, Linux, VMware, networking, or security certifications.

US Salary Range

 $117,000 - $154,000 USD

 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

 Benefits

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits .

 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

-

 No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

- Please always verify communications:

  - Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

  - Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com .

-

 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

-

 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 Data Privacy

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.description:
Microsoft Intune Administrator – Endpoint Management

Location: Downers Grove, IL

Work Arrangement: Hybrid with 2–3 days working from home per week

Salary: $80,000–$100,000, depending on experience

Employment Type: Full-time

About the Opportunity

A growing enterprise managed services provider is adding a Microsoft Intune Administrator to its Endpoint Team. This is a hands-on role focused on Intune administration, endpoint policies, device compliance, application deployment, and device lifecycle management.

You’ll also support key parts of the Microsoft 365 environment, including SharePoint Online, Exchange Online, Entra ID, and Teams. SharePoint experience is a plus, while strong, practical Intune experience is the priority.

What You’ll Do

 Administer Microsoft Intune and manage device configuration, compliance policies, and endpoint lifecycle.
 Deploy and manage applications through Intune.
 Monitor device health and compliance using Intune and Microsoft 365 tools.
 Support endpoint access and administration across Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, Entra ID, Teams, and OneDrive.
 Use PowerShell to automate administrative tasks, reporting, and endpoint configurations.
 Support hybrid endpoint environments, including Autopilot, Conditional Access, and mobile device management.
 Improve SharePoint Online sites with attention to governance, usability, and ongoing support.
 Work with engineering and managed services teams to resolve issues and improve endpoint operations.
 Use N-able N-central to support daily operations and client environments.

What We’re Looking For

 3+ years of hands-on Microsoft Intune administration experience.
 Experience deploying applications and managing device configuration and compliance in Intune.
 Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, Entra ID, Teams, and OneDrive.
 PowerShell scripting experience for automation, reporting, or administration.
 Familiarity with Autopilot, Conditional Access, and mobile device management.
 Clear communication skills and a collaborative, team-focused approach.

Preferred Experience

 SharePoint Online administration or site support.
 N-able N-central experience.
 Experience supporting MSP clients or multi-tenant environments.

Compensation & Benefits

 Salary of $80,000–$100,000, depending on experience. Candidates with strong Intune, SharePoint, and N-central experience may be considered toward the top of the range.
 Medical, dental, and vision coverage.
 401(k) with employer match.
 Paid time off.
 Certification reimbursement.
 A collaborative, technically focused team and opportunities for continued growth.

jobs.description:
Core Responsibilities:Tests and evaluates vendor hardware for engineering certification through Device Council, including laptops, desktops, monitors, docks and peripherals. Builds test plans from standard evaluation checklists, benchmarks performance, validates BIOS, firmware, driver and accessory compatibility, and makes documented pass/fail recommendations on 45-day and 60-day certification tracks. Works on-site in the hardware lab whenever hands-on testing needs to be completed, and on a hybrid schedule otherwise.Develops hardware test standards and recommends vendor selections and new technologies. Partners with support, Mac engineering, executive support, trading floor and contact center teams to test devices against their business needs, and works with vendors such as HP, Dell, Lenovo, Kensington and EPOS on pilots, firmware, roadmap briefings and pricing inputs.Troubleshoots, diagnoses and resolves hardware, firmware and driver issues at the engineering level with Windows Engineering and Operations teams. Uses Splunk and SysTrack to identify user experience issues and usage patterns, and Microsoft Graph queries against Intune data to find hardware issues proactively. Recommends fixes, then plans, tests and deploys them across the enterprise.Owns Microsoft Edge and Google Chrome on Windows. Tests and validates each major release, manages update channels and cadence, and builds and maintains browser configuration and ADMX-backed policy in Microsoft Intune. Partners with Cyber Security on browser security baselines, extension governance and browser incidents, and resolves browser support requests.Packages, tests and deploys BIOS, firmware and driver updates in waves across 30,000 Windows devices, and works with the OS deployment team so newly certified models have the drivers they need. Validates Windows 11 feature updates on certified hardware.Submits ServiceNow change requests, validates results, provides follow-up production support and communicates changes to crew.Writes and maintains test plans, test results and documentation that other engineers can follow and repeat, and co-authors crew quick-start guides with support teams before certification. Shares knowledge with newer engineers on testing processes and releases.Administers evaluation hardware: receives, tracks, ships, wipes and redeploys evaluation units across sites, and keeps the test hardware tracker current. Delivers work in sprints using Jira and Confluence.Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
Qualifications:Minimum of five years related work experience.Undergraduate degree in a related field or the equivalent combination of training and experience.Hands-on experience testing and evaluating enterprise hardware, including benchmarking, managing BIOS, firmware and drivers with vendor tools (for example, HP Image Assistant), and troubleshooting docks, monitors and peripherals.Windows 10/11 endpoint engineering experience with Microsoft Intune and Configuration Manager, including packaging, collections, configuration profiles and ADMX-backed policy.Experience managing Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome in the enterprise, including release channels, policy and extensions.Experience with ServiceNow change management, including wave-based rollouts, validation and user communication.Clear written communication: test plans, change records and documentation others can follow.Ability to own several workstreams at once (vendors, partner teams and in-flight evaluations) with limited direction, and to raise risks early.
Preferred Qualifications:MacOS management exposurePowerShell scripting for automation and validation
Endpoint analytics: Splunk, SysTrack and Microsoft Graph queries for Intune device data
Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD)
Jira and ConfluenceHeadset and peripheral certification for unified communications (Microsoft Teams, Genesys)
Vendor management: pilots, escalations and roadmap briefings

At Vanguard, we don't just have a mission—we're on a mission.

To work for the long-term financial wellbeing of our clients. To lead through product and services that transform our clients' lives. To learn and develop our skills as individuals and as a team. From Malvern to Melbourne, our mission drives us forward and inspires us to be our best.

Description

 Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

Your greatest work is ahead!

Leidos Defense Systems is seeking a highly motivated Systems Engineer who loves collaboration and being a part of something big, to join our team. This role drives the implementation of Value Driven Design and advanced Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) workflows across complex, high-priority DoD portfolios. As a Leidos Systems Engineer, you will bridge systems architecture, parametric lifecycle modeling, and cross-functional engineering execution. You will lead requirements and architecture working groups, design advanced automated tool integrations using Cameo Systems Modeler, and oversee the verification lifecycle for critical national security hardware and software environments.

If this sounds like the kind of environment where you can thrive, keep reading!

Leidos Defense Systems Sector provides a diverse portfolio of systems, solutions, and services covering land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace for customers worldwide. Solutions for Defense include enterprise and mission IT, large-scale intelligence systems, command and control, geospatial and data analytics, cybersecurity, logistics, training, and intelligence analysis and operations support. Our team is solving the world’s toughest security challenges for customers with “can’t fail” missions. To explore and learn more, click here!

Are you ready to make an impact? Share your resume with us today!

Primary Responsibilities.

Lead the structural and behavioral capture of high-speed system architectures in Cameo Systems Modeler / MagicDraw, creating and maintaining unified SysML Logical, Physical, and Allocative views.Oversee the creation, maturation, and tracking of constrained-syntax requirements (utilizing EARS-aligned paradigms) to guarantee high-integrity requirement-to-verification traceability and robust test artifact mapping.Develop, expand, and maintain complex parametric manufacturing and O&S lifecycle models within scripting environments (Excel, Python, MATLAB) to quantify systemic impacts of design alternatives and drive sensitivity analysis.Formulate, manage, and facilitate multi-discipline requirements and architecture working groups to define cross-functional engineering interfaces and establish rigorous open-architecture configuration management.Direct the execution of comprehensive trade studies, technical decision briefs, and executive white papers evaluating warfighter utility, manufacturing readiness, and lifecycle cost/benefit tradeoffs.Build custom Velocity Template Language (VTL) scripts inside Cameo to automate the generation of dynamic contract deliverables, Interface Control Documents (ICDs), and program milestone design reviews.Provide technical leadership within a matrixed team environment

Basic Qualifications.

BS degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related STEM discipline with 4+ years of experience
Proven proficiency with MBSE methodologies and direct architecture capture using SysML-compliant tools (specifically Cameo Systems Modeler or MagicDraw).Hands-on experience developing or managing complex structural allocations (e.g., Block Definition and Internal Block Diagrams from L0 down to subsystem levels) and generating automated documents/reports via scripting (VTL, Python, or MATLAB).Demonstrated experience drafting, analyzing, and decomposing technical requirement structures (preferably using EARS or automated requirements management tracking databases like DOORS).Strong communication skills with a proven ability to lead small technical teams, align multidisciplinary engineering divisions, and present effectively internally/externally
Ability to work full-time onsite in a controlled area (SCIF environment) with a willingness to travel 10-20% to customer and partner organizations.U.S. Citizenship is mandatory. Candidate must possess an active TS clearance
Preferred Qualifications.

Master's Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related STEM discipline with 4+ years of experience
Industry experience covering high-speed dynamics, aerothermodynamics, hypersonics, or advanced propulsion areas
Advanced, administrative, or power-user experience with Cameo Systems Modeler / MagicDraw, IBM DOORS, SIMIO, or equivalent enterprise MBSE and requirements databases
Familiarity with DoD acquisition lifecycle and program processes
Experience applying parametric cost modeling, Monte Carlo techniques, or advanced mathematical trade studies to defense hardware acquisition programs.ASEP/CSEP (INCOSE) or OMG Certified Systems Modeling Professional (OCSMP) credentials.Active Top-Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility.

What does a Sr. Systems Engineer do at Swire Coca - Cola?
The Sr. Systems Engineer is a senior technical expert on the Systems team. This role is responsible for leading the design, implementation, and optimization of complex IT and OT systems. The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise, a proactive mindset, and a strong understanding of operational environments. This position plays a key role in modernizing infrastructure, enhancing security and compliance, and integrating IT capabilities into traditionally isolated systems.

Responsibilities

Lead the design and deployment of scalable, secure, and resilient infrastructure across IT and OT environments
Serve as a technical escalation point for complex issues involving servers, storage, networking, and operational systems
Collaborate with the Systems Architect to align infrastructure initiatives with long-term strategic goals
Drive modernization efforts within OT environments, focusing on improved security, compliance, and manageability
Support cloud migration initiatives and evaluate platforms for future virtualization needs
Develop and maintain documentation for system configurations, processes, and procedures
Mentor Systems Engineers and Administrators, fostering technical growth and knowledge sharing
Conduct system audits and performance reviews to ensure optimal operation and adherence to standards
Interface with vendors and internal stakeholders to evaluate and implement new technologies
Collaborate across Dev, Security, and Data teams to ensure alignment on infrastructure initiatives, system integrations, and compliance effort
Requirements

Bachelor's Degree Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field required
Relevant certifications, Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) preferred5+ years experience in IT systems administration and engineering required
Strong expertise in Windows and Linux operating systems
Advanced knowledge of virtualization platforms and cloud infrastructure
Proficiency in networking, firewalls, and system security
Experience integrating IT management capabilities into non-traditional environments
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
Ability to lead technical initiatives and manage multiple priorities independently
Experience with scripting and automation (e.g., PowerShell,) preferred
Familiarity with monitoring and management tools preferred
Understanding of compliance frameworks applicable to OT environments preferred
Experience with backup and disaster recovery solutions preferred

jobs.description:
The EUT Specialist-_SME provides senior technical leadership for endpoint management services supporting the SEC Infrastructure Support Services (ISS) contract. This role ensures secure, reliable lifecycle operations for SEC endpoint platforms, including Windows devices, virtual endpoints, and mobile assets, in alignment with PWS requirements for compliance, operational readiness, and service quality. The SME leads design and enforcement of endpoint baselines, patching, vulnerability remediation, and policy controls while supporting modernization initiatives such as Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

The position also drives cross-functional resolution of complex endpoint issues, maintains SOPs and documentation for audit readiness, and mentors technical staff to improve service performance and consistency.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES
Endpoint Lifecycle and Platform Operations

Lead operations and maintenance for SEC-issued endpoints, including laptops, desktops, virtual computers, and mobile devices.Direct provisioning, configuration, and decommissioning activities across the full endpoint lifecycle in accordance with SEC standards.Oversee enterprise application packaging, deployment, and maintenance for baseline and mission-specific software.Manage preproduction endpoint environments to validate new configurations, updates, and releases before production deployment.
Security, Compliance, and Policy Governance

Establish and maintain endpoint configuration baselines, compliance policies, and security controls for Windows and supported mobile platforms.Lead patch and vulnerability management activities, including remediation planning and closure reporting.Develop, maintain, and version-control endpoint SOPs, architecture artifacts, and operational documentation to support FISMA and audit readiness.Ensure endpoint operations align with SEC policy, zero-trust objectives, and approved change control processes.
Intune Engineering and Automation
Serve as the technical SME for Microsoft Intune in Windows environments, including device configuration profiles, compliance policies, and application delivery.Lead Autopilot and endpoint onboarding workflows to improve deployment speed, user readiness, and provisioning consistency.Design and implement PowerShell and automation solutions to reduce manual effort, improve reliability, and standardize endpoint operations.Integrate endpoint management workflows with enterprise tooling and reporting processes to improve visibility and service performance.
Incident Resolution, Collaboration, and Service Improvement

Lead complex troubleshooting for Autopilot enrollment failures, policy conflicts, application packaging issues, and endpoint compliance anomalies.Coordinate with security, infrastructure, service desk, and vendor teams to resolve escalated incidents and prevent recurrence.Provide technical mentorship and quality oversight to endpoint engineers and support personnel.Support endpoint SLA/operational reporting, including metrics for patch compliance, incident trends, lifecycle status, and service outcomes.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
US Citizenship required : Must meet contract requirements.

Clearance: Ability to obtain and maintain SEC Public Trust (or higher if required).

Education: Bachelors in a relevant field (e.g., Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering).

Experience
10+ years of experience in endpoint engineering and enterprise endpoint management within complex IT environments. A degree can be substituted for years of experience.Demonstrated subject matter expertise in Microsoft Intune for Windows endpoint administration and policy management.Demonstrated experience supporting multi-platform endpoint environments, including Windows and mobile/Apple ecosystems.Proven experience leading endpoint security, lifecycle management, troubleshooting, and documentation/SOP governance in regulated environments.Demonstrated experience leading endpoint modernization initiatives, including Windows Autopilot and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
Technical Skills
Microsoft Intune (Windows endpoint management, configuration profiles, compliance policies, and application delivery)
Multi-platform endpoint administration across Windows and mobile/Apple ecosystem devices
Windows lifecycle management and endpoint policy baselines
Endpoint security controls and compliance policy governance
Windows Autopilot
Microsoft Defender for EndpointPowerShell scripting and endpoint automation
Enterprise application packaging and deployment
Troubleshooting of enrollment failures, policy conflicts, and compliance anomalies
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Experience supporting U.S. federal IT environments with FISMA, NIST, and zero-trust control implementation.Hands-on experience with co-management or migration strategies across Intune and legacy endpoint management platforms.Demonstrated success building endpoint operational dashboards and reporting integrations for compliance and SLA tracking.Strong experience leading cross-functional endpoint modernization efforts in large, distributed user environments.Advanced troubleshooting experience across identity, policy, and security tooling integrations impacting endpoint compliance.Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102)
Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200)ITIL 4 Foundation
WORK ENVIRONMENT / OTHER
Operational Support: May require participation in on-call or surge support activities depending on operational needs.

Location: On-site at SEC HQ, Washington, DC.

Travel: As required per contract direction.

jobs.description:
Job Description:
Title: Senior CrowdStrike Security Engineer
Locations: Coppell TX, Tampa FL or Jersey City NJ - (3 Days Hybrid)
Employment Type: Contract-to-Hire (CTH)
Interview Process: 2 Rounds
Pay Range: $85 to $90 per hour on W2.
Job Summary
* Seeking an experienced Endpoint Security Engineer to deploy, manage, and optimize CrowdStrike Falcon and enterprise endpoint security solutions.
* This role focuses on endpoint protection, security policy management, troubleshooting, DLP, security integrations, and migration from legacy security tools to modern platforms.
Required Qualifications
* 5+ years of hands-on CrowdStrike and endpoint security engineering experience.
* Strong expertise in CrowdStrike Falcon EDR, NGAV, sensor management, policy tuning, and detection analysis.
* Knowledge of Windows, macOS, Linux, endpoint networking, TLS, proxies, firewalls, and network security.
* Experience troubleshooting complex endpoint security issues and managing security controls.
* Understanding of SaaS security, MS Entra ID, and AWS/Azure environments.
Key Responsibilities
* Deploy and manage CrowdStrike Falcon modules, including EDR, NGAV, Firewall, and Identity Protection.
* Maintain sensor health, endpoint coverage, security policies, detection rules, and exception handling across Windows, macOS, Linux, servers, VDI, and supported mobile devices.
* Troubleshoot endpoint security incidents, analyze detections, investigate false positives, and perform root-cause analysis.
* Maintain Sky-high Web Gateway, Symantec DLP, ICAP scanning tools, and related endpoint security infrastructure.
* Support security tool upgrades, migrations, and decommissioning, including transitions to Zscaler and modern CrowdStrike capabilities.
* Integrate security telemetry with SIEM/SOAR platforms to support threat detection, incident response, and audit requirements.
* Develop automation using scripting, APIs, and workflows to improve operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with security, infrastructure, and application teams on security improvements, documentation, and technology evaluations.

Job Description
BAE is seeking an experienced Desktop & Windows engineer to support technical development and testing of Desktop Operating System (OS) Images for the Executive Office for the U.S. Attorneys (EOUSA) for our customer, the U.S. Attorneys' Office (USAO).

Required Education, Experience, & Skills
 Bachelors in computer science, business, or other relevant disciplines. Ten (10) years of relevant work experience may be substituted for degree requirement. Anticipated Skill Set: Deep knowledge of Windows OS (Windows 11) internals, architecture, and configuration. Expertise with Active Directory, Group Policy Objects (GPO), OU structure, and domain services. Strong experience with imaging and deployment tools such as MDT, SCCM/MECM, MECM OSD, Autopilot, and Intune. Proficiency with device management, compliance policies, configuration profiles, and Windows Update for Business. Skilled in PowerShell scripting for automation, reporting, and troubleshooting. Experience managing drivers, firmware, hardware standards, and lifecycle management Knowledge of enterprise networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VPN, certificates). Endpoint security: BitLocker, Defender for Endpoint, application control, privilege management. Patch management and vulnerability remediation. Monitoring and logging using tools like Event Viewer, Log Analytics, SIEM platforms. Troubleshooting complex desktop, application, and hardware issues. Supporting virtualization technologies (VDI, Hyper-V). Experience in programming languages such as C#, Visual Basic with strong knowledge in .NET.
Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills
 Deep PowerShell proficiency, including building advanced modules and automating enterprise-scale workflows. Strong experience with cloud-based endpoint management (Intune, Azure AD, Conditional Access, Defender for Endpoint). Expertise with modern provisioning methods (Autopilot, ESP customization, scripted deployments). Familiarity with Zero Trust endpoint principles and secure configuration baselines. Solid understanding of certificate services, PKI, and enterprise certificate management. Experience with Windows troubleshooting using symbols, process monitoring tools, and performance analyzers (ProcMon, WinDbg).

jobs.summary: Computer World Services, Corp. (CWS) seeks an Endpoint Engineer to develop, maintain, deploy, and support enterprise endpoint capabilities for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program, including endpoint images, application packaging, device provisioning, software...
jobs.description:
Computer World Services, Corp. (CWS) seeks an Endpoint Engineer to develop, maintain, deploy, and support enterprise endpoint capabilities for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program, including endpoint images, application packaging, device provisioning, software deployment, patching, configuration baselines, and Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI).

Computer World Services, Corp. (CWS) seeks an Endpoint Engineer to develop, maintain, deploy, and support enterprise endpoint capabilities for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program, including endpoint images, application packaging, device provisioning, software deployment, patching, configuration baselines, and Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI).

The engineer supports physical and virtual endpoints throughout their lifecycle across USMEPCOM Headquarters, Military Entrance Processing Stations (MEPS), Remote Processing Substations, COOP locations, and remote users. The role maintains a clear division of responsibility with cybersecurity personnel who identify, prioritize, and validate findings, while the Endpoint Engineer tests and implements approved changes through change control and provides deployment evidence for validation.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

  - Develop, test, and maintain standardized endpoint images, including drivers, OS settings, security baselines, and required software, and support image versioning, release, rollback, and retirement procedures.

  - Develop automated deployment task sequences, provisioning workflows, enrollment processes, and configuration profiles using Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager, Windows Autopilot, or comparable platforms.

  - Package commercial, Government, and internally developed software with installation, detection, dependency, upgrade, and removal logic, and test and troubleshoot package deployments.

  - Develop and maintain approved scripts and automation for provisioning, packaging, configuration, and remediation in version-control repositories.

  - Support endpoint patching for operating systems, applications, drivers, and firmware, maintaining pilot groups, deployment rings, maintenance windows, and exception processes; test updates and monitor compliance.

  - Engineer and support VDI base images, desktop pools, application delivery, and user profiles; troubleshoot login, profile, performance, and connectivity issues; and coordinate dependencies with virtualization, storage, network, and identity teams.

  - Support endpoint deployment and refresh projects, OS upgrades, application migrations, and endpoint-management transitions.

  - Provide advanced engineering support for complex endpoint, packaging, deployment, patching, and VDI incidents, including major incidents and root-cause corrective actions, and improve Service Desk and field-support knowledge content.

  - Review cybersecurity findings assigned to endpoint operations, assess operational impact and rollback needs, implement approved remediation through change and release procedures, and provide completion evidence; apply DISA STIGs and endpoint-security baselines.

  - Maintain endpoint inventories, image and package records, patch status, VDI documentation, SOPs, and deployment and rollback plans, and provide endpoint health and compliance information for program reporting.

Education & Experience

Required:

  - Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience where permitted by the labor category.

  - Minimum of six (6) years of relevant experience in endpoint engineering, systems engineering, device management, desktop engineering, VDI engineering, or a related discipline.

  - Experience maintaining enterprise endpoint images and developing, testing, and deploying application packages.

  - Experience supporting endpoint provisioning, deployment, patching, configuration, lifecycle management, and VDI.

  - Experience implementing endpoint-security or vulnerability-remediation changes using controlled testing, phased deployment, validation, and rollback practices.

  - Strong written, verbal, analytical, and technical problem-solving skills.

Preferred:

    - Experience with Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager, Windows Autopilot, Defender for Endpoint, and Entra ID hybrid endpoint management.

    - Experience with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, or comparable endpoint-automation technologies.

    - Experience packaging applications using MSI, MSIX, Win32, App-V, or comparable formats.

    - Experience with VMware Horizon, Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, Citrix, or another enterprise VDI platform.

    - Experience supporting federal or DoD endpoint environments, including DISA STIGs and RMF remediation evidence.

    - Experience supporting large-scale OS migrations, device refreshes, or endpoint-management modernization.

Certifications

  - Required: Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, when relevant to the assigned Microsoft 365 or Intune environment.

  - Preferred: CompTIA Security+ or another security certification, ITIL 4 Foundation, or relevant Microsoft, VMware, Citrix, cloud, or automation certification.

Security Clearance

- Active Secret clearance or higher is required.

Other (Travel, Work Environment, DoD 8570 Requirements, Administrative Notes, etc.)

Work Environment / Travel:

  - Remote position; Chicago, IL–area candidates preferred.

  - Occasional after-hours maintenance, deployment windows, critical incident support, on-site work, or travel may be required.

Administrative Notes:

 Period of Performance: March 1, 2027 – February 28, 2033

 Contract Start Date: March 1, 2027
Note: By applying to this position, the candidate acknowledges and consents to having their resume included in an active competitive Government contract bid.

jobs.description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human** Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

### **The TDI Client Platform Engineering Team**

The **Technology, Data, and Insights (TDI)** team is on a mission to accelerate Okta’s scale. We are a group of innovative engineers who prioritize automation, testing, and performance tuning. We touch every part of the business, and we are obsessed with creating a seamless, secure end-user experience for every Okta employee.

### **The Staff Client Platform Engineer Opportunity**

As a Staff Client Platform Engineer, you will be the subject matter expert for Okta’s **macOS and iOS** fleet. While your primary focus is the Apple ecosystem, you will also play a key role in our broader endpoint strategy, contributing to our **Windows, Android, Linux, and VDI** management workflows as needed. This is an ideal path for an engineer who wants to maintain deep Apple expertise while expanding their influence across the entire OS landscape.

We are looking for a versatile engineer who thinks **automation-first**. You will combine Jamf Pro expertise with open-source tools like Munki and Santa, while helping to bridge the gap between platforms using unified tools like FleetDM.

**What makes this role unique:** You are **Customer Zero**. Because we build identity and device management products, you will work directly with Okta’s own Product and Engineering teams to validate new capabilities across platforms, surface real-world feedback, and help shape the roadmap for tools used by millions of people globally.

_This role reports to the Senior Manager of Client Platform Engineering._

### **What You’ll Be Doing**

- **Apple Fleet Management:** Own the global macOS and iOS fleet using Jamf Pro, overseeing enrollment, configuration profiles, and application deployment.
- **Cross-Platform Support:** Contribute to the management and security of Windows (via Intune/Autopilot) and Linux endpoints as the program evolves, ensuring a consistent security posture across all OS types.
- **Tooling & Evolution:** Administer open-source tools (Munki, Santa) and lead evaluations of emerging platforms like FleetDM to enhance cross-platform fleet visibility.
- **Security & Compliance:** Ensure endpoints meet NIST, CIS, and STIG standards. Partner with Security teams to respond to vulnerabilities across the entire fleet.
- **Engineering & Infrastructure as Code (IaC):** Apply an IaC mindset to device management using code-based workflows (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, or Jamf API). Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to ensure repeatable, scalable, and automated deployments regardless of the OS.
- **Technical Direction:** Set the architecture and technical direction for a domain, such as Apple platform, endpoint security tooling or devices-as-code, and write design or docs that formalize it.
- **Customer Zero Advocacy:** Act as a primary feedback loop for Okta’s internal product teams. Test new features in production and influence the product roadmap based on operational data.
- **Operational Excellence:** Provide Tier 3 escalation support for global IT teams and participate in an on-call rotation.

### **What You’ll Bring**

- **Core Experience:** 8+ years in endpoint engineering with a focus on Apple platforms at enterprise scale.
- **Technical Versatility:** A strong understanding of Windows and Linux operating systems; you aren't just a "Mac person", you understand how to apply engineering principles to any OS.
- **MDM Mastery:** Deep expertise in managing endpoints at scale via MDM, such as Jamf Pro. Familiarity with Microsoft Intune, FleetDM or other cross-platform MDM/UEM solutions is a significant plus.

- **Scripting:** Proficiency in Bash, Python, Go, or Swift (PowerShell experience is a bonus).
- **Tooling:** Experience with Git, GitHub Actions, Terraform, or similar CI/CD frameworks.
- **Security:** Understanding of ADE/DEP, MDM/DDM protocols, and platform-specific hardening (e.g., BitLocker, FileVault, LUKS).

- **Identity Knowledge:** Familiarity with SAML and OIDC and how they integrate with endpoint authentication.

**Additional requirements:**

- This position requires the ability to access federal environments and/or have access to protected federal data. As a condition of employment for this position, the successful candidate must be able to submit documentation establishing U.S. Person status (e.g. a U.S. Citizen, National, Lawful Permanent Resident, Refugee, or Asylee. 22 CFR 120.15) upon hire.

#### **Extra Credit**

- Hands-on experience with FleetDM or osquery for multi-OS visibility.
- Experience with Autopkg pipelines or AWS Lambda for endpoint automation.
- Background in Federal compliance (FedRAMP).
- Relevant certifications (Apple, Okta, Microsoft, AWS, Jamf).

### **Location & Work Style**

This is a **hybrid** role. Candidates must be located near an Okta office. In the San Francisco Bay Area, employees are expected to be in-office a minimum of **2 days per week**.

#P2763

Below is the annual base salary range for candidates located in San Francisco Bay Area. Your actual base salary will depend on factors such as your skills, qualifications, experience, and work location. In addition, Okta offers equity (where applicable), bonus, and benefits, including health, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), flexible spending account, and paid leave (including PTO and parental leave) in accordance with our applicable plans and policies. To learn more about our Total Rewards program please visit: [https://rewards.okta.com/us](https://rewards.okta.com/us).

The annual base salary range for this position for candidates located in the San Francisco Bay area is between:

$194,000—$267,000 USD

**The Okta Experience**

- [Supporting Your Well-Being](http://rewards.okta.com)
- [Driving Social Impact](https://www.okta.com/company/okta-for-good/)
- [Developing Talent and Fostering Connection + Community](https://www.okta.com/company/talent-connection-community/)

We are intentional about connection. Our global community, spanning over 20 offices worldwide, is united by a drive to innovate. Your journey begins with an immersive, in-person onboarding experience designed to accelerate your impact and connect you to our mission and team from day one.

Okta is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, or status as a protected veteran. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and convictions records, consistent with applicable laws.

If reasonable accommodation is needed to complete any part of the job application, interview process, or onboarding please [use this Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1EfiEYZrIyhA2X4Fijk0R3RKYOzNoS3wtvyM4nhbZnXE/edit) to request an accommodation.

jobs.description:
**Endpoint \& SSE Security Engineer**

**At ING Hubs Spain we are looking for an Endpoint \& SSE Security Engineer**

**Your role and work environment:**

The team is a part of ING Global CISO department responsible for IT security within ING group and provides services for many organizational units all over the world.

Join our dynamic team and become an integral part of our mission to ensure the security and resilience of our cloud infrastructure. We offer a collaborative work environment, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to work with cutting-edge technologies.

If you are ready to make an impact and contribute to the security of our public cloud environment, we invite you to apply now. Let's shape the future of cloud security together!

**Your key responsibilities:**

* maintain enterprise Secure Service Edge (SSE) platforms,

* support the deployment and adoption of web security, DLP, and internet access protection capabilities within the SSE ecosystem,

* perform operational administration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of SSE services,

* collaborate with infrastructure, networking, and security teams during solution implementation projects,

* participate in an on-call support rotation and support critical incident response activities,

* develop and maintain technical documentation and operational procedures,

* identify opportunities for automation and continuous service improvement,

* ensure stable and secure operation of the SSE environment.

**What are we looking for?**

At ING, we value and support our employees before we start recruiting talent from outside. If you believe that this position is the right next step in your career at ING, we encourage you to apply

We are looking for you if you have:

* at least 3 years of experience in administration and management of proxy server environments,

* practical experience in securing workstations and endpoint devices,

* knowledge of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) technologies, processes, and controls,

* experience in implementing and maintaining web security and internet access control solutions,

* understanding of Secure Web Gateway (SWG), proxy, URL filtering, and traffic inspection concepts,

* knowledge of endpoint security technologies, including malware protection, device control, and security policy enforcement,

* practical experience with Microsoft Entra ID and identity-related security controls,

* experience in troubleshooting network connectivity and security-related issues,

* knowledge of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, and proxy architectures,

* strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify risks and recommend appropriate mitigations,

* communication skills with the ability to effectively cooperate with technical and business stakeholders,

* readiness to participate in an on-call support rotation,

* a results-oriented mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality outcomes and continuous improvement.

* **English level** -- C1.

**You'll get extra points for:**

* experience with Enterprise DLP solutions (e.g., Microsoft Purview, Symantec DLP, Forcepoint DLP),

* experience with cloud security technologies and Secure Service Edge (SSE) / SASE platforms,

* knowledge of Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Microsoft Purview,

* familiarity with Zero Trust security principles,

* experience with security monitoring and incident response processes,

* knowledge of CASB technologies,

* experience in automating operational tasks and reporting,

* relevant security certifications

* undefined

**What do we offer?**

The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but... What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details.

Check out what is waiting for you!

**Be flexible my friend.**

Our model is all about flexibility and accountability. Keeping both our customers and our colleagues needs in mind, you determine together which days you work at home and which you come to ING MAD to offer your best self. Do your thing.

**Restaurant card.**

So that thinking about what to have for lunch doesn't take up your time or your cravings.

**Our house will be your home.**

In our offices you can find electric mobility solutions, doctor, hairdresser, gym, The Good Service (to help you with your errands) and much more!

**Health insurance.**

For you and all your family (spouse/partner and children).

**Life insurance.**

We help you protect what matters most to you.

**Flexible remuneration.**

In addition, you will enjoy our flexible remuneration model, through a more tax-advantaged way, you will be able to access other services such as nursery, transport card, training aids...

**Transport allowance.**

It doesn't matter where you live, we'll help you get to the office.

**Pension plan.**

You can benefit from our pension plan after 1 month with us!

**Discover ING Hubs Spain**

**We're building something exciting---and we want you to be part of it.**

ING is launching **the new member of ING Hubs in Spain**, an integral part of ING in charge of designing and delivering important technological and operational solutions to make banking frictionless for our customers. ING Hubs play a key role in our 'Growing the difference' strategy to become the best European bank. This will be our sixth global hub, joining a network of over 13,000 professionals in the Philippines, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Türkiye and Spain.

**What makes us different?**

**We have a tech-first mindset:**We're not just a bank---we're a tech company that happens to do banking. Our new hub will be a center of excellence for scalable, fast, and secure technology.

**We have global impact:** You'll be working on solutions that serve more than 34 million of customers in over 38 countries.

**We are agile:**ING was the first bank to adopt agile at scale. We continue to evolve with a collaborative, cross-functional way of working.

**Sustainability at the heart of what we do:** We have a role to play in defining new ways of doing business that align economic growth with positive environmental and social impact.

At ING, we believe in**diversity, inclusion, and belonging.** We're proud of our international teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive. We value authenticity, collaboration, and continuous learning.

We're looking for **curious minds, bold builders, and passionate problem-solvers** . If you're looking for a place to **find new ways to drive efficiency and provide superior customer value** , where your ideas matter, and where you can grow with purpose---**we're looking forward to meeting you.**

#LI-DNI

jobs.description:
Senior Windows Infrastructure Engineer (Cloud L2)
Location: Lima, PeruType: Full-time
Job SummaryThe Senior Windows Infrastructure Engineer is the technical anchor and senior escalation point for the Windows estate that powers the managed services platform, a multi-client environment hosted on AWS.

Senior Windows Infrastructure Engineer (Cloud L2)

Location: Lima, Peru

Type: Full-time

Job Summary

The Senior Windows Infrastructure Engineer is the technical anchor and senior escalation point for the Windows estate that powers the managed services platform, a multi-client environment hosted on AWS. The role owns complex incidents from triage through to root cause and fix, keeps the platform secure, patched and observable, and turns operational knowledge into runbooks and automation so that L1 can safely take on more of the routine work.

The work is grounded in deep Windows Server operations: Active Directory, IIS, hybrid identity, Group Policy, PowerShell, certificate services and the wider Microsoft ecosystem. The estate is Windows Server 2019 and above, end-to-end, with a negligible Linux footprint. AWS is the platform it all runs on and is operated daily, but it is the Microsoft stack that defines the role: we hire for deep Windows expertise first.

Responsibilities

-
 Incident escalation and resolution: Take L1 escalations in Jira Service Management and own complex Windows Server and AWS incidents from triage to root cause to remediation, across multi-client, AWS-hosted environments (approx. 3 L1 escalations per week, alongside own queue and project work).

-
 Major incidents and on-call: Cover the Primary on-call rota for P1/P2 incidents (senior escalation rota for major incidents, compensated in line with policy), usually one week a month. Lead the technical response during P1s and give technical updates to the Incident Manager and SDMs.

-
 Problem management: Carry out root-cause analysis on repeat or major incidents, raise problem records and follow fixes through to closure (roughly 3 problem management tickets a week).

-
 Windows platform administration: Administer and harden Windows Server 2019/2022/2025: Active Directory (forest/domain design, replication, FSMO, GPOs, trusts), DNS, DHCP, WSUS, AD CS, certificates and PKI, and file and print services.

-
 Hybrid identity: Operate hybrid identity between on-premises AD and AWS Managed Microsoft AD, federation with Entra ID (Azure AD) and AD FS, SAML, OIDC, OAuth, Kerberos and MFA. Support identity projects such as the Okta/SSO migration.

-
 IIS management: Manage IIS in depth: sites, application pools, bindings, ARR / URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing and performance tuning.

-
 AWS hosting layer: Operate the AWS hosting layer for Windows workloads day to day: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch, Systems Manager (Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command), AWS Backup and Directory Service.

-
 Vulnerability remediation and patching: Fix critical Windows and third-party vulnerabilities following the documented seven-stage remediation process. Plan, deploy, roll back and troubleshoot Windows patching at scale. Fix Tanium and Wiz cloud findings (including AWS security group findings) and own the third-party runbooks. Activity carried out most weekends.

-
 Observability: Drive observability of the Windows estate: event log strategy, performance baselines, CloudWatch metrics and alarms, and Grafana dashboards.

-
 Platform projects and migrations: Build and test changes for estate-wide programmes, for example the security-stack migration (Google SecOps agents on 2,000+ servers in 5 AWS accounts), the Grafana agent rollout and the Splunk-to-Grafana migration, and OS upgrades. Write the runbook and hand the work over to L1 once it becomes BAU.

-
 Automation: Write and maintain PowerShell and SSM automation for bulk administration, scheduled tasks, configuration drift correction and reporting, using DSC where appropriate.

-
 Changes: Plan, raise and carry out normal and emergency changes. Present them at the Cloud CAB and cover the Secondary (planned change) on-call rota, usually one week a month.

-
 Knowledge and L1 coaching: Write runbooks, SOPs and knowledge articles to codify operational standards. Run the daily ticket clinic with L1 and act as buddy for new L1 starters.

Eligibility Requirements

- 7+ years operating Windows Server in production, with deep hands-on experience on Windows Server 2019 and above

- Active Directory at depth: forest/domain design, replication, FSMO roles, trusts, sites and services, schema, tombstone and recovery

- Group Policy at scale: design, troubleshooting (RSoP, gpresult), security baselines, WMI filtering

- IIS at depth: site and app pool configuration, ARR, URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, performance tuning

- DNS, DHCP, WSUS and Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS): real operational experience; certificate management and PKI in enterprise Windows environments

- Advanced PowerShell: scripting, modules, remoting, error handling, automation patterns, DSC familiarity

- Windows patching and vulnerability remediation at scale in regulated environments: planning, deployment, rollback and troubleshooting

- Windows performance troubleshooting: PerfMon, ETW, memory dump analysis, IIS request diagnostics

- Hybrid identity: AD on-premises ↔ cloud, Entra ID (Azure AD) Connect / federation, AD FS; practical implementation and troubleshooting of SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, Kerberos, LDAP and MFA

- Day-to-day operation of Windows workloads on AWS: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch; Systems Manager (Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command, State Manager, Parameter Store); AWS Directory Service / Managed Microsoft AD / AD Connector. Deep AWS architect-level expertise is not required.

- Strong ITIL grounding (incident, problem, change and service lifecycle management); prior experience in an MSP or shared-services environment managing multiple client estates under SLA; owns problems through to resolution

- Advanced / fluent professional English, written and spoken

- Able to work New York-aligned hours consistently, from a reliable, distraction-free home office with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power and a professional video and audio setup

-
 Nice to Have

  - Grafana/Prometheus, Splunk, Tanium, Wiz, Qualys

  - SQL Server on Windows; Terraform or Ansible; Git and CI/CD

  - Experience supporting financial services clients

  - AZ-800/801, SC-300, AWS SysOps or Solutions Architect Associate, ITIL 4 Foundation

How to Apply

- Click "Apply Now" to submit your resume through our career site

- Be sure to include any relevant experience that aligns with the role.

- Qualified candidates will be contacted by a member of our recruitment team for next steps

About eClerx

 eClerx is a leading provider of productized services, bringing together people, technology and domain expertise to amplify business results.​

  The firm provides business process management, automation, and analytics services to a number of Fortune 2000 enterprises, including some of the world’s leading financial services, communications, retail, fashion, media & entertainment, manufacturing, travel & leisure, and technology companies. Incorporated in 2000, eClerx is traded on both the Bombay and National Stock Exchanges of India. The firm employs more than 19,000 people across Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Switzerland, Egypt. India, Italy, Netherlands, Peru, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, the UK, and the USA.

For more information, visit

You can also find us on:

 eClerx

 eClerx is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law. We are also committed to protecting and safeguarding your personal data. Please find our policy here
