While your primary focus is the Apple ecosystem, you will also play a key role in our broader endpoint strategy, contributing to our Windows, Android, Linux, and VDI management workflows as needed. This is an ideal path for an engineer who wants to maintain deep Apple expertise while expanding their influence across the entire OS landscape.

We are looking for a versatile engineer who thinks automation-first . You will combine Jamf Pro expertise with open-source tools like Munki and Santa, while helping to bridge the gap between platforms using unified tools like FleetDM.

 What makes this role unique: You are Customer Zero . Because we build identity and device management products, you will work directly with Okta’s own Product and Engineering teams to validate new capabilities across platforms, surface real-world feedback, and help shape the roadmap for tools used by millions of people globally.

 This role reports to the Senior Manager of Client Platform Engineering.

 What You’ll Be Doing

- Apple Fleet Management: Own the global macOS and iOS fleet using Jamf Pro, overseeing enrollment, configuration profiles, and application deployment.

- Cross-Platform Support: Contribute to the management and security of Windows (via Intune/Autopilot) and Linux endpoints as the program evolves, ensuring a consistent security posture across all OS types.

- Tooling & Evolution: Administer open-source tools (Munki, Santa) and lead evaluations of emerging platforms like FleetDM to enhance cross-platform fleet visibility.

- Security & Compliance: Ensure endpoints meet NIST, CIS, and STIG standards. Partner with Security teams to respond to vulnerabilities across the entire fleet.

- Engineering & Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Apply an IaC mindset to device management using code-based workflows (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, or Jamf API). Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to ensure repeatable, scalable, and automated deployments regardless of the OS.

- Technical Direction: Set the architecture and technical direction for a domain, such as Apple platform, endpoint security tooling or devices-as-code, and write design or docs that formalize it.

- Customer Zero Advocacy: Act as a primary feedback loop for Okta’s internal product teams. Test new features in production and influence the product roadmap based on operational data.

- Operational Excellence: Provide Tier 3 escalation support for global IT teams and participate in an on-call rotation.

 What You’ll Bring

- Core Experience: 8+ years in endpoint engineering with a focus on Apple platforms at enterprise scale.

- Technical Versatility: A strong understanding of Windows and Linux operating systems; you aren't just a "Mac person", you understand how to apply engineering principles to any OS.

- MDM Mastery: Deep expertise in managing endpoints at scale via MDM, such as Jamf Pro. Familiarity with Microsoft Intune, FleetDM or other cross-platform MDM/UEM solutions is a significant plus.

- Scripting: Proficiency in Bash, Python, Go, or Swift (PowerShell experience is a bonus).

- Tooling: Experience with Git, GitHub Actions, Terraform, or similar CI/CD frameworks.

- Security: Understanding of ADE/DEP, MDM/DDM protocols, and platform-specific hardening (e.g., BitLocker, FileVault, LUKS).

- Identity Knowledge: Familiarity with SAML and OIDC and how they integrate with endpoint authentication.

 Additional requirements:

- This position requires the ability to access federal environments and/or have access to protected federal data. As a condition of employment for this position, the successful candidate must be able to submit documentation establishing U.S. Person status (e.g. a U.S. Citizen, National, Lawful Permanent Resident, Refugee, or Asylee. 22 CFR 120.15) upon hire.

 Extra Credit

- Hands-on experience with FleetDM or osquery for multi-OS visibility.

- Experience with Autopkg pipelines or AWS Lambda for endpoint automation.

- Background in Federal compliance (FedRAMP).

- Relevant certifications (Apple, Okta, Microsoft, AWS, Jamf).

 Location & Work Style

This is a hybrid role. Candidates must be located near an Okta office. In the San Francisco Bay Area, employees are expected to be in-office a minimum of 2 days per week .

#P2763

Your actual base salary will depend on factors such as your skills, qualifications, experience, and work location. In addition, Okta offers equity (where applicable), bonus, and benefits, including health, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), flexible spending account, and paid leave (including PTO and parental leave) in accordance with our applicable plans and policies. To learn more about our Total Rewards program please visit: https://rewards.okta.com/us .

 The annual base salary range for this position for candidates located in the San Francisco Bay area is between:

 $194,000 - $267,000 USD

 The Okta Experience

We are intentional about connection. Our global community, spanning over 20 offices worldwide, is united by a drive to innovate. Your journey begins with an immersive, in-person onboarding experience designed to accelerate your impact and connect you to our mission and team from day one.

jobs.description:
## Introduction to Role & Team

As a Senior Engineer, you will independently lead automation initiatives across the employee experience lifecycle while also serving as a hands-on technical resource for day-to-day service delivery and desktop support. You’ll optimize workflows, implement AI-powered integrations, manage core service tooling, provide general office support, including conference room AV equipment, and drive tangible service improvements in support of the zero-ops vision.

In this role you'll:

- Solves complex service problems using automation and AI-driven techniques.

- Takes initiative in identifying automation opportunities.

- Begins to influence team direction and standards.

## What You’ll Do

- Administer and configure Jira Service Management, including workflows, queues, automation rules, permission schemes, and reporting dashboards

- Maintain desktop engineering standards, including OS imaging, application packaging, patch management, and endpoint lifecycle management

- Provide Service Desk support as needed, including responding to tickets, triaging incoming requests, and handling first-line troubleshooting for hardware, software, and account access issues

- Integrate AI agents into service experiences (e.g. employee chatbots, self-service tools)

- Partner with support and platform teams to identify and automate common issues

- Analyze service data to prioritize automation impact

- Mentor junior engineers and set standards for automation best practices

- **Participate in day-to-day IT operations as needed**, including monitoring and actioning items in the ticket queue

- **Perform hands-on physical tasks** (e.g., workstation setup, AV troubleshooting, hardware swaps, network equipment adjustments) as required to ensure seamless employee support

This role is based in London, and we ask that you’re within a commutable distance to this office, so that you’re able to come onsite regularly to collaborate across engineering teams, Monday - Wednesday. We have a hybrid work style and ask that all Engineers be onsite Monday - Wednesday during core hours (9:00am - 3:00pm*).

## About You

- Must have Skills & Experience:

  - 6+ years of experience in Engineering and Workplace technology

  - Experience with administration of Jira

  - Experience working with ThousandEyes or similar tools.

  - Strong scripting proficiency (Python, Bash).

  - Working experience with Slack integrations, or similar tools.

  - Comfortable with MDM tools (Iru) and endpoint automation (macOS).

  - Solid understanding of networking, and endpoint security.

  - Able to independently troubleshoot cross-system issues.

## Benefits & Perks

- Annual personal learning & development budget

- Private Medical Insurance (PMI)

- Private Dental Insurance

- Babylon Health app

- Mental health support

- Enhanced parental leave, including a highly competitive maternity package

- Unlimited PTO

- Subsidised gym membership

- ‘Double matched’ pension contributions up to 6%

- Premium App Access

**About Us**

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.

**AI Fluency**

AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes.

We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us.

**Final Compensation**

Will be determined based on factors such as the selected candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and other job-related considerations.

**Inclusion at Bumble Inc.**

Bumble Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. We're happy to make any reasonable adjustments that will help you feel more confident throughout the process, please don't hesitate to let us know how we can help.

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example: she/her, he/him, they/them, etc).

**AI in Bumble Inc. Hiring**

At Bumble, we may use AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process — such as helping us record, transcribe, and summarize conversations, and supporting job alignment by comparing resumes and job descriptions to highlight skills and potential roles that may be a good match. These tools help us work more efficiently and stay focused on you during our conversations. Importantly, all hiring decisions are made by people. AI is used only to support our team’s efficiency and improve the candidate experience — not to evaluate or decide on your candidacy. Participation in AI-supported interviews and conversations is completely voluntary and will not impact your candidacy. If you’d prefer to opt out, simply let your recruiter or interviewer know at the start of a call, or anytime during the interview or conversation. Summaries and related data are retained only as long as needed in line with our internal data retention policies. If at any point you’d like a transcription or summary deleted, please contact your recruiter directly.

**Fraudulent Candidate Detection**

Our applicant tracking system analyzes signals relating to device, IP, email, and phone data associated with each application to protect applicants and our hiring process from fraudulent applications. These signals provide indicators for internal review only and do not constitute a definitive determination of identity or intent. No applicant is rejected, advanced, or otherwise affected based solely on this analysis without human review

For further information on how we hold and manage your data, please refer to our [Privacy Policy](https://bumble.com/en/candidate-privacy-policy).

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

 IT SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR, MISSION SYSTEMS

SpaceX is looking for a highly skilled and versatile Launch IT Systems Administrator to support the networking, compute, and application support needs of our launch environment. This role is critical to enabling safe, reliable, and high-cadence launch operations across multiple sites. The ideal candidate thrives in mission-critical settings, brings a strong sense of urgency balanced with operational excellence, and is comfortable operating as a technical generalist across multiple IT disciplines.

   RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Design, deploy and augment IT infrastructure including networking, server, and desktop hardware that directly supports mission-critical networks across the country.

- Provide direct IT support during launch and test campaigns.

- Perform periodic systems upgrades and maintenance in between critical operations, sometimes on weekends and evenings.

- Proactively monitor IT services and respond rapidly to incidents to ensure high availability and optimal systems performance.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to proactively identify and resolve potential technical issues with systems deployments.

- Author and maintain documentation for IT systems, including systems overview, design drawings and operational procedures.

- Leverage automation tools and contribute to broader IT systems engineering and infrastructure-as-code initiatives.

- Ensure that systems are configured and maintained in compliance with industry and cybersecurity standards (e.g. ITAR, ISO, NIST).

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

- 3+ years of experience in IT systems administration.

- Experience with both Linux and Windows server administration.

- Experience designing, deploying, supporting and troubleshooting enterprise networks.

 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Working knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, NTP, PTP etc.), firewall administration and cybersecurity technologies.

- Proficiency in scripting (Bash/Powershell/Python) and automation frameworks (Terraform, Ansible, Puppet).

- Familiarity with Active Directory and multi-platform authentication/identity environments.

- Experience with virtualization platforms and tools.

- Understanding of Layer 1 configuration best practices and multiplexing technologies.

- Working knowledge of Windows-based systems and services, including the ability to set up, configure, upgrade, manage, and troubleshoot said infrastructure.

- Ability to administer and troubleshoot Linux-based systems and services through command line.

- Experience supporting real-time systems, industrial control networks, or operational technology (OT) environments in aerospace, defense, energy, or similar high-reliability industries.

- Experience with configuration management, provisioning, infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines and other DevOps concepts/tools.

- Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate with internal/external customers, vendors, management etc. in both formal and informal situations.

 ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Ability to pass DoD background check for launch site access.

- Willingness to participate in an after-hours on-call rotation and work extended hours or weekends as necessary.

- Willingness to travel (up to 20%, including flying to other sites worldwide) and potential time at sea supporting marine systems.

- Ability to lift 30 lbs.

- Ability to work at heights.

- Ability to drive (active valid driver’s license).

 COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:

IT Systems Administrator: $95,000.00 - $120,000.00/per year

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock, stock options, or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

 ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

- To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here .

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEO
Compliance@spacex.com .

About Us - Values Overview

Welcome to the University of North Texas System. The UNT System includes the University of North Texas in Denton and Frisco, the University of North Texas at Dallas and UNT Dallas College of Law, and University of North Texas Health Fort Worth. We are the only university system based exclusively in the robust Dallas-Fort Worth region. We are growing with the North Texas region, employing more than 14,000 employees, educating a record 49,000+ students across our system, and awarding nearly 12,000 degrees each year.

We are one team comprised of individuals who are committed to excellence, curiosity and innovation. We are transforming lives and creating economic opportunity through education. We champion a people-first values-based culture where We Care about each other and those we serve. We believe that we are Better Together because we foster an environment of respect, belonging, and access for all. We demonstrate Courageous Integrity through setting exceptional standards and acting in the best interest of our communities. We are encouraged to Be Curious about opportunities for learning, creating, discovering, and innovating, and are encouraged to learn from failure. Show Your Fire by joining our team and exhibiting your passion and pride in your work as part of our UNT System team.

Learn more about the UNT System and how we live our values at www.UNT
System.edu.

Department Summary

CAS IT champions, builds, and applies technology to help UNT advance education, creativity, and research. Benefits include:
• Flexible hours and remote work arrangements
• UNT scholarship (roughly 66% savings!) for employee and immediate family
• 36 days PTO with yearly accrual for vacation/sick
• Clear and reasonable work priorities
• Transparent leadership

Position Overview

This position serves as a technical resource within Academic Technologies IT Infrastructure, supporting the administration, security, automation, and lifecycle management of Windows endpoints across university academic and administrative environments. Working as part of a team, the position supports devices used by faculty, staff, students, classrooms, laboratories, research facilities, and specialized academic computing environments.

Responsibilities include deploying, configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting Windows endpoints using technologies such as Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM), Windows Autopilot, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, PowerShell, and Microsoft Graph.

The position plays an important role in the transition from MECM/SCCM and traditional imaging to modern, cloud-based endpoint management through Microsoft Intune, with an emphasis on automated provisioning, application deployment, security compliance, and endpoint lifecycle management.

Additionally, the position develops and supports automation solutions to improve operational efficiency, endpoint security, and reliability while collaborating with university IT teams, faculty, researchers, and vendors to address technical challenges and support institutional needs.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in related field and four years of related computing work experience; or any equivalent combination of education, training and experience.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Endpoint Management: Understanding of Windows device lifecycle management, including provisioning, deployment, maintenance, upgrades, retirement, and secure decommissioning.

Application and Update Management: Ability to package, deploy, update, and troubleshoot Windows applications using Intune and MECM/SCCM, along with managing operating system updates, drivers, and phased deployments.

Scripting and Automation: Ability to develop and maintain PowerShell scripts for endpoint configuration, software deployment, automated remediation, and reporting.
Endpoint Security: Knowledge of security best practices, including least privilege, BitLocker, Windows LAPS, Windows Firewall, Secure Boot, vulnerability remediation, and Zero Trust principles.

Identity and Access Management: Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, device identities, Group Policy, security groups, and endpoint administrative-access controls.

Monitoring and Troubleshooting: Ability to analyze endpoint inventory, deployment, compliance, and security data; troubleshoot hardware, software, authentication, and configuration issues; and assist with endpoint reporting and analytics.

Documentation and Collaboration: Ability to maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and change records while collaborating effectively with university IT teams and stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Preferred qualifications include experience or familiarity with enterprise Windows endpoint management, including Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM), Windows Autopilot, and device lifecycle management. Knowledge of PowerShell scripting, automation, configuration management, and automated remediation is highly desirable.

Candidates should have familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, device identities, security groups, and access management, as well as endpoint security technologies and practices such as BitLocker, Windows LAPS, security baselines, vulnerability remediation, endpoint privilege management, and Zero Trust principles.

Additional preferred experience includes:
Packaging, deploying, and maintaining Win32 applications across enterprise environments.
Managing Windows operating system updates, patching, and device provisioning.
Supporting migrations from MECM/SCCM to Microsoft Intune and other cloud-based endpoint management solutions.
Developing automation and remediation solutions using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, or other APIs.
Using Rapid7 or comparable vulnerability-management platforms to identify and remediate security vulnerabilities.
Supporting specialized computing environments, including research systems, academic laboratories, and scientific instrumentation.
Participating in enterprise IT projects, following established service-management practices, and collaborating across technical teams.
Working in higher-education or similarly complex enterprise IT environments.

Required License/Registration/Certifications

Preferred certifications include Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, Identity and Access Administrator Associate, and Azure Administrator Associate, or equivalent certifications.

Job Duties

Endpoint Management and Administration Administer and maintain Windows endpoints using Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM), with an emphasis on transitioning endpoint management from MECM to Intune and modern cloud-based management practices.
Device Provisioning and Lifecycle Management Deploy, configure, and manage Windows devices using Windows Autopilot and other approved provisioning technologies.
Application Packaging and Deployment Package, deploy, update, and troubleshoot applications using Intune, MECM/SCCM, and other enterprise software-management tools. Support the migration of application deployments from MECM to Intune.
Operating System Updates and Patch Management Manage Windows feature updates, quality updates, drivers, and deployment rings.
Endpoint Security and Compliance Maintain endpoint security controls, including Defender for Endpoint, BitLocker, Windows LAPS, and security baselines. Support vulnerability remediation and compliance monitoring.
PowerShell Scripting and Automation Develop and maintain scripts and automation for endpoint configuration, application deployment, remediation, and reporting.
Identity and Access Management Support endpoint identities and access controls using Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory, including device joins, security groups, and administrative permissions.
Troubleshooting, Documentation, and Collaboration Troubleshoot endpoint issues, maintain technical documentation, and collaborate with university IT teams to support faculty, staff, students, classrooms, laboratories, and research environments.

Physical Requirements

Communicating with others to exchange information.
Sedentary work that primarily involves sitting/standing.

Environmental Hazards

No adverse environmental conditions expected.

Work Schedule

M-F 8-5 (2 days remote)

Driving University Vehicle

No

Security Sensitive

This is a Security Sensitive Position.

Special Instructions

Applicants must submit a minimum of two professional references as part of their application. If needed, additional references can be added after the application has been submitted.

Benefits

For information regarding our Benefits, click here.

EEO Statement

What IT Client Services contributes to Cardinal Health

Information Technology oversees the effective development, delivery, and operation of computing and information services.
This function anticipates, plans, and delivers Information Technology solutions and strategies that enable operations and drive business value.

IT Client Services provides Tier 1-3 virtual and physical support to the organization's end users for software, hardware, digital employee experience management, conference room technology and meeting support, warehouse technology, server, network, and enterprise systems issues.
Frequently responding to escalated issues from the IT Service Center, this group resolves user requests through discussions with users and coordination with internal and external resources and provides education and trainings to users to facilitate knowledge transfer and prevent problem reoccurrence.
IT Client Services also maintains ownership for certain end user productivity platforms and capabilities, such as virtual environments and collaboration toolsets, and addresses service outages.
This area acquires, installs and upgrades PC components and software, while also performing asset management for software and hardware.

jobs.description:
Description

 Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

Your greatest work is ahead!

Leidos Defense is seeking a highly skilled, visionary Principal Systems Engineer to join our multi-disciplinary engineering organization. In this role, you will drive the architectural design, hardware-software integration, and deployment of next-generation tactical systems, and advanced technologies for critical Department of Defense (DoD) initiatives. As a Principal contributor, you will act as a primary subject matter expert, translating complex customer concepts into flight-ready hardware solutions. You will provide strategic technical direction across multi-functional Integrated Product Teams (IPTs), manage high-level engineering complexities, design robust embedded architectures, and guide engineering teams through entire hardware lifecycles.

If this sounds like the kind of environment where you can thrive, keep reading!

Solutions for Defense include enterprise and mission IT, large-scale intelligence systems, command and control, geospatial and data analytics, cybersecurity, logistics, training, and intelligence analysis and operations support. Our team is solving the world’s toughest security challenges for customers with “can’t fail” missions. To explore and learn more, click here!

Are you ready to make an impact? Share your resume with us today!

Architect, lead, and deliver state-of-the-art hypersonic vehicle designs, and custom/COTS Line Replaceable Units (LRUs) for missile systems.

Support complex system designs utilizing high-integrated multi-disciplinary integration techniques and Weapon Open System Architecture/WOSA frameworks.

Direct multi-disciplinary Integrated Product Teams (IPTs). Act as the primary internal technical authority, hosting weekly technical interchange meetings with external subcontractors to maintain design consistency.

Partner with engineering teams to translate military standards into rigorous hardware requirements. support Control Account Managers (CAMs) by providing precise technical write-ups, work breakdowns, and schedule estimates for Earned Value Management (EVM), CapEx initiatives, and major competitive proposals.

Demonstrated experience leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams, acting as an IPT Lead, product owner, or scrum master within an agile framework.U.S. Citizenship is strictly required. Candidate must possess an active Top Secret security clearance
Ability to travel 25% or more
Preferred Qualifications.

Prior experience developing high complexity hypersonic systems
Familiarity with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) methodologies, SysML concepts, or requirements tools such as Cameo/MagicDraw and IBM DOORS.Hands-on experience implementing open system architectures such as Weapon Open System Architecture (WOSA) or Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA) messaging standards.

jobs.description:
Computer World Services, Corp. (CWS) seeks a Senior Endpoint Engineer to design, maintain, secure, automate, and modernize enterprise endpoint capabilities for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program, including endpoint images, application packaging, device provisioning, software deployment, patching, configuration baselines, and Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI).

Computer World Services, Corp. (CWS) seeks a Senior Endpoint Engineer to design, maintain, secure, automate, and modernize enterprise endpoint capabilities for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program, including endpoint images, application packaging, device provisioning, software deployment, patching, configuration baselines, and Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI).

The engineer supports physical and virtual endpoints throughout their lifecycle across USMEPCOM Headquarters, MEPS, Remote Processing Substations, COOP locations, and remote users. The role maintains a clear division of responsibility with cybersecurity personnel who identify, prioritize, and validate findings, while the Endpoint Engineer tests and implements approved changes through change control and provides deployment evidence for validation.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

  - Serve as senior engineer for enterprise endpoint imaging, packaging, deployment, patching, configuration, and VDI capabilities.

  - Design, build, test, and maintain standardized endpoint images, including drivers, OS settings, security baselines, and required software, and establish image versioning, release, rollback, and retirement procedures.

  - Develop automated deployment task sequences, provisioning workflows, enrollment processes, and configuration profiles using Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager, Windows Autopilot, or comparable platforms.

  - Package commercial, Government, and internally developed software with installation, detection, dependency, upgrade, and removal logic, and test and troubleshoot package deployments.

  - Develop and maintain approved scripts and automation for provisioning, packaging, configuration, and remediation in version-control repositories.

  - Design and administer endpoint patching for operating systems, applications, drivers, and firmware, establishing pilot groups, deployment rings, maintenance windows, and exception processes; test updates and monitor compliance.

  - Engineer and support VDI base images, desktop pools, application delivery, and user profiles; troubleshoot login, profile, performance, and connectivity issues; and coordinate dependencies with virtualization, storage, network, and identity teams.

  - Support endpoint deployment and refresh projects, OS upgrades, application migrations, and endpoint-management transitions, developing technical implementation plans.

  - Provide Tier 3/Tier 4 engineering support for complex endpoint, packaging, deployment, patching, and VDI incidents, including major incidents and root-cause corrective actions, and improve Service Desk and field-support knowledge content.

  - Review cybersecurity findings assigned to endpoint operations, assess operational impact and rollback needs, implement approved remediation through change and release procedures, and provide completion evidence; apply DISA STIGs and endpoint-security baselines.

  - Maintain endpoint inventories, image and package records, patch status, VDI documentation, SOPs, and deployment and rollback plans, and provide endpoint health and compliance information for program reporting.

Education & Experience

Required:

  - Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience where permitted by the labor category.

  - Minimum of eight (8) years of relevant experience in endpoint engineering, systems engineering, device management, desktop engineering, VDI engineering, or a related discipline.

  - Experience designing and maintaining enterprise endpoint images and developing, testing, and deploying application packages.

  - Experience supporting endpoint provisioning, deployment, patching, configuration, lifecycle management, and VDI.

  - Experience implementing endpoint-security or vulnerability-remediation changes using controlled testing, phased deployment, validation, and rollback practices.

  - Strong written, verbal, analytical, and technical problem-solving skills.

Preferred:

    - Experience with Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager, Windows Autopilot, Defender for Endpoint, and Entra ID hybrid endpoint management.

    - Experience with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, or comparable endpoint-automation technologies.

    - Experience packaging applications using MSI, MSIX, Win32, App-V, or comparable formats.

    - Experience with VMware Horizon, Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, Citrix, or another enterprise VDI platform.

    - Experience supporting federal or DoD endpoint environments, including DISA STIGs and RMF remediation evidence.

    - Experience supporting large-scale OS migrations, device refreshes, or endpoint-management modernization.

Certifications

  - Required: Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, when relevant to the assigned Microsoft 365 or Intune environment.

  - Preferred: CompTIA Security+ or another security certification, ITIL 4 Foundation, or relevant Microsoft, VMware, Citrix, cloud, or automation certification.

Security Clearance

- Active Secret clearance or higher is required.

Other (Travel, Work Environment, DoD 8570 Requirements, Administrative Notes, etc.)

Work Environment / Travel:

  - Remote position; Chicago, IL–area candidates preferred.

  - Occasional after-hours maintenance, deployment windows, critical incident support, on-site work, or travel may be required.

Administrative Notes:

 Period of Performance: March 1, 2027 – February 28, 2033

 Contract Start Date: March 1, 2027
Note: By applying to this position, the candidate acknowledges and consents to having their resume included in an active competitive Government contract bid.

jobs.summary: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re...
jobs.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

As a Senior IT Engineer on the IT Engineering team, you’ll shape how identity and access work across 1Password. You’ll lead Identity and Access Management (IAM) initiatives, improve our Okta environment, and help expand Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled workflows across IT. Your work will make secure access simpler and more reliable, helping advance 1Password’s mission to create a safer, simpler digital future for everyone.

How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What we're looking for:

• Bring substantial experience in a technical IT role, including experience in IT engineering or systems administration.

• Administer Okta or a comparable Identity Provider (IdP), such as Microsoft Entra ID, in a production environment.

• Apply identity protocols including Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) to connect applications.

• Build integrations and automation using Representational State Transfer (REST) APIs and scripting languages such as Python and Bash.

• Use infrastructure or configuration as code with Git-based workflows, including pull requests and code review.

• Demonstrate experience applying AI to accelerate or replace team workflows, while managing project timelines, risks, stakeholder communication, and organizational change.

• Bring experience managing an IdP with Terraform, using 1Password Enterprise and Device Trust, or supporting Service Organization Control 2 (SOC 2), Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), or ISO 27001 audits.

What you can expect:

• Operate and improve Okta, including tenant configuration, policies, lifecycle management, and complex identity issues.

• Lead IAM initiatives from concept through rollout, including role-based access control, access reviews, and onboarding and offboarding automation.

• Build safeguards that make identity and access changes safer to deploy and easier to audit.

• Design durable application integrations using SAML, OIDC, SCIM, and custom API work where needed.

• Simplify access requests and employee lifecycle processes so secure workflows are also efficient workflows.

• Partner with IT, Security, and Device Infrastructure teams to plan rollouts, manage risk, establish identity practices, and support audit and compliance work.

• Participate in the on-call rotation and provide clear guidance on identity and access questions across 1Password.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $117,000 USD and $164,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $103,000 CAD and $144,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work
We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

 Growth and future
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community
🤝 Paid volunteer days
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.

1Password uses artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technologies, including natural language processing and predictive analytics, to assist in the initial screening of employment applications and improve our recruitment process. See here https://www.ashbyhq.com/downloadables/ashby-bias-audit-08-2024.pdf for the latest third party bias audit information. If you prefer not to have your application assessed using AI/ML features, you may opt out by completing this form https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/1password/automation-notice. For additional information see our Candidate Privacy Notice https://1password.com/files/candidate-privacy-notice.pdf.

jobs.description: Nature and Scope This position is responsible for the administration, support, and continuous improvement of end-user computing environments, including desktop and laptop systems, mobile devices, operating systems, and enterprise productivity applications. The role also supports onboarding and offboarding processes, asset lifecycle management, and Tier 1 to 3 support for all ARI applications. In addition, this role provides advanced technical support, systems administration, and operational engineering across multiple Ohio-based domains. Key areas of responsibility include identity lifecycle management, endpoint management platforms, IT service management (ITSM) administration, Tanium platform support, and coordination with infrastructure, networking, security, and corporate IT teams. Essential Duties and Responsibilities End-User Computing & Desktop Support Install, configure, maintain, and support desktop and laptop systems, including both on-premises and cloud-based applications. Provide technical support, troubleshooting, and user training for hardware, software, and enterprise applications. Support Microsoft Office 365 and related productivity tools. Install, upgrade, and patch operating systems and software; ensure endpoint security controls are properly implemented and maintained. Support VPN configurations, installs, and maintenance as directed by Network Security. Provide support for mobile communication devices and telephony platforms. Manage hardware lifecycle activities, including installation, replacement, and break/fix support. Maintain inventory of spare parts, peripherals, and end-user equipment. Identity & Access Management Perform user onboarding and offboarding processes across multiple domains in compliance with JSOX standards. Serve as the primary owner for Ohio-based user terminations across multiple domains, including isolated networks. Manage Active Directory (AD) and Entra ID accounts, including provisioning, role changes, and deprovisioning. Administer group memberships, distribution lists, shared mailboxes, and access permissions. Troubleshoot authentication issues, Conditional Access policies, and identity-related incidents. Endpoint & Platform Administration Administer endpoint management tools, including SCCM, Intune, LDAP, GPO, and Tanium. Deploy software packages and troubleshoot endpoint agent issues. Support multi-domain endpoint operations, including isolated lab environments. Ensure compliance with endpoint security standards and patching requirements. IT Service Management (ServiceNow) Configure and maintain ServiceNow catalog items, workflows, forms, notifications, and automation scripts. Support CMDB data integrity initiatives, including cleanup, deduplication, and asset attestation. Contribute to platform enhancements and usability improvements (e.g., search optimization, UI simplification). Participate in collaboration with corporate ITSM teams and vendors. Assist with Discovery and Service Mapping in support of Change Management processes. Asset & Lifecycle Management Support equipment intake, deployment, and lifecycle management processes. Conduct asset audits and reconciliation across multiple domains. Maintain accurate tracking of IT assets and ensure alignment with compliance standards. Security, Compliance & Operational Support Adhere to all IT policies, including JSOX controls, in daily operations. Support MFA implementation and maintenance across enterprise applications. Assist with monitoring, reporting, and compliance validation activities. Support email security operations, including message tracing, spam release, and quarantine management. Provide support for secure and compliant operations within isolated network environments. Infrastructure & Cross-Functional Support Assist infrastructure and network teams with server installations, rack and stack activities, cabling, and switch port patching. Support print server management and collaborate with vendors (e.g., Canon) for device deployment and replacement. Provide technical support for specialized lab systems and environments. Training & Continuous Improvement Develop technical training materials, including videos and user documentation, using tools such as Camtasia and Clipchamp. Identify and implement process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and reduce ticket volume. Drive initiatives that improve user experience and technology adoption across the organization. Perform any other tasks/duties as assigned by management. Education Requirements and Qualifications To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. High School Diploma required; Associate Degree or technical equivalent preferred. Minimum of three (3) years of experience in desktop support or end-user computing required. Relevant certifications preferred (e.g., CompTIA A+, MCSA, MCITP, MCDST, MOS). ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification is a plus. Experience supporting multi-domain environments and identity lifecycle processes. Nature and Scope

 This position is responsible for the administration, support, and continuous improvement of end-user computing environments, including desktop and laptop systems, mobile devices, operating systems, and enterprise productivity applications. The role also supports onboarding and offboarding processes, asset lifecycle management, and Tier 1 to 3 support for all ARI applications.

 In addition, this role provides advanced technical support, systems administration, and operational engineering across multiple Ohio-based domains. Key areas of responsibility include identity lifecycle management, endpoint management platforms, IT service management (ITSM) administration, Tanium platform support, and coordination with infrastructure, networking, security, and corporate IT teams.

    Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  End-User Computing & Desktop Support

  Install, configure, maintain, and support desktop and laptop systems, including both on-premises and cloud-based applications.
  Provide technical support, troubleshooting, and user training for hardware, software, and enterprise applications.
  Support Microsoft Office 365 and related productivity tools.
  Install, upgrade, and patch operating systems and software; ensure endpoint security controls are properly implemented and maintained.
  Support VPN configurations, installs, and maintenance as directed by Network Security.
  Provide support for mobile communication devices and telephony platforms.
  Manage hardware lifecycle activities, including installation, replacement, and break/fix support.
  Maintain inventory of spare parts, peripherals, and end-user equipment.

    Identity & Access Management

  Perform user onboarding and offboarding processes across multiple domains in compliance with JSOX standards.
  Serve as the primary owner for Ohio-based user terminations across multiple domains, including isolated networks.
  Manage Active Directory (AD) and Entra ID accounts, including provisioning, role changes, and deprovisioning.
  Administer group memberships, distribution lists, shared mailboxes, and access permissions.
  Troubleshoot authentication issues, Conditional Access policies, and identity-related incidents.

    Endpoint & Platform Administration

  Administer endpoint management tools, including SCCM, Intune, LDAP, GPO, and Tanium.
  Deploy software packages and troubleshoot endpoint agent issues.
  Support multi-domain endpoint operations, including isolated lab environments.
  Ensure compliance with endpoint security standards and patching requirements.

    IT Service Management (ServiceNow)

  Configure and maintain ServiceNow catalog items, workflows, forms, notifications, and automation scripts.
  Support CMDB data integrity initiatives, including cleanup, deduplication, and asset attestation.
  Contribute to platform enhancements and usability improvements (e.g., search optimization, UI simplification).
  Participate in collaboration with corporate ITSM teams and vendors.
  Assist with Discovery and Service Mapping in support of Change Management processes.

    Asset & Lifecycle Management

  Support equipment intake, deployment, and lifecycle management processes.
  Conduct asset audits and reconciliation across multiple domains.
  Maintain accurate tracking of IT assets and ensure alignment with compliance standards.

    Security, Compliance & Operational Support

  Adhere to all IT policies, including JSOX controls, in daily operations.
  Support MFA implementation and maintenance across enterprise applications.
  Assist with monitoring, reporting, and compliance validation activities.
  Support email security operations, including message tracing, spam release, and quarantine management.
  Provide support for secure and compliant operations within isolated network environments.

    Infrastructure & Cross-Functional Support

  Assist infrastructure and network teams with server installations, rack and stack activities, cabling, and switch port patching.
  Support print server management and collaborate with vendors (e.g., Canon) for device deployment and replacement.
  Provide technical support for specialized lab systems and environments.

    Training & Continuous Improvement

  Develop technical training materials, including videos and user documentation, using tools such as Camtasia and Clipchamp.
  Identify and implement process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and reduce ticket volume.
  Drive initiatives that improve user experience and technology adoption across the organization.

   Perform any other tasks/duties as assigned by management.

  High School Diploma required; Associate Degree or technical equivalent preferred.
  Minimum of three (3) years of experience in desktop support or end-user computing required.
  Relevant certifications preferred (e.g., CompTIA A+, MCSA, MCITP, MCDST, MOS).
  ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification is a plus.

  Experience supporting multi-domain environments and identity lifecycle processes.
  Hands-on experience with endpoint management platforms such as SCCM, Intune, and Tanium.
  Experience administering ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms.

  Strong proficiency in Microsoft Windows operating systems and Microsoft 365 applications.
  Working knowledge of Active Directory, Entra ID, GPOs, LDAP, and endpoint management tools.

  Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.

Tests and evaluates vendor hardware for engineering certification through Device Council, including laptops, desktops, monitors, docks and peripherals. Builds test plans from standard evaluation checklists, benchmarks performance, validates BIOS, firmware, driver and accessory compatibility, and makes documented pass/fail recommendations on 45-day and 60-day certification tracks. Works on-site in the hardware lab whenever hands-on testing needs to be completed, and on a hybrid schedule otherwise.Develops hardware test standards and recommends vendor selections and new technologies. Partners with support, Mac engineering, executive support, trading floor and contact center teams to test devices against their business needs, and works with vendors such as HP, Dell, Lenovo, Kensington and EPOS on pilots, firmware, roadmap briefings and pricing inputs.Troubleshoots, diagnoses and resolves hardware, firmware and driver issues at the engineering level with Windows Engineering and Operations teams. Uses Splunk and SysTrack to identify user experience issues and usage patterns, and Microsoft Graph queries against Intune data to find hardware issues proactively. Recommends fixes, then plans, tests and deploys them across the enterprise.Owns Microsoft Edge and Google Chrome on Windows. Tests and validates each major release, manages update channels and cadence, and builds and maintains browser configuration and ADMX-backed policy in Microsoft Intune. Partners with Cyber Security on browser security baselines, extension governance and browser incidents, and resolves browser support requests.Packages, tests and deploys BIOS, firmware and driver updates in waves across 30,000 Windows devices, and works with the OS deployment team so newly certified models have the drivers they need.Validates Windows 11 feature updates on certified hardware.Submits ServiceNow change requests, validates results, provides follow-up production support and communicates changes to crew.Writes and maintains test plans, test results and documentation that other engineers can follow and repeat, and co-authors crew quick-start guides with support teams before certification. jobs.description: ## Desktop / Endpoint EngineerApply: USA - PA - Oaks: Full time: Posted Today: R0038426SEI is seeking a Desktop/Endpoint Engineer. Join a team responsible for delivering a secure, modern, and reliable endpoint experience across a global enterprise. As a Desktop Engineer, you will independently support core endpoint services while continuing to deepen your expertise in Microsoft Intune, MECM/SCCM, Windows 11, Autopilot, endpoint security, software deployment, and automation. This opportunity is designed for an endpoint or desktop professional with foundational experience who can support routine deployments and troubleshooting and is ready to grow their skills by contributing to smaller engineering initiatives with guidance from senior team members. ## **What you will do:** ## Endpoint Administration & Support· Support and maintain enterprise endpoint management platforms across a global environment.· Manage device provisioning, software deployment, patch management, and compliance monitoring.· Manage endpoint configurations using Microsoft Intune and MECM/SCCM.· Monitor endpoint health and troubleshoot device management issues. ## Modern Workplace Technologies· Build and maintain Microsoft Intune configuration profiles, compliance policies, and device enrollment processes.· Support Windows Autopilot provisioning and enrollment activities.· Contribute to Windows 11 deployment and modernization initiatives.· Identify opportunities to improve endpoint management, automation, and user experience. ## Application Deployment & Lifecycle Management· Package, test, deploy, and support enterprise applications.· Monitor software deployment success and resolve installation issues.· Prepare and support application change requests through established change management processes.· Coordinate assigned application rollout activities. ## Security & Compliance· Administer endpoint security technologies including BitLocker, LAPS, Microsoft Defender, and device compliance policies.· Support security initiatives designed to protect enterprise devices and data.· Monitor compliance and coordinate remediation activities. ## Technical Troubleshooting· Provide Level 2/3 support for operating system, application, and endpoint management issues.· Investigate and resolve device deployment, compliance, and configuration problems.· Work closely with Service Desk, Infrastructure, Security, and Engineering teams.· Participate in an after-hours support rotation as needed. ## jobs.description:
About Eagle Wireless

Eagle Wireless is building the connective tissue of the physical world.

Every connected car, every industrial sensor, every IoT device that needs to talk to the cloud reliably and securely — that’s where we come in. We design and deliver cellular modules and connectivity solutions that automotive, and IoT companies trust to work for years, in the field, without compromise.

Our teams span North America, Europe, and APAC, giving you the chance to collaborate with world-class engineers and go-to-market experts solving hard problems at global scale — from cybersecurity and supply chain resilience to regulatory compliance across dozens of markets.

If you want your work to matter in a world that’s rapidly connecting everything, and you want to do it alongside people obsessed with getting the hard stuff right, Eagle Wireless is where that happens.

Job Summary

Eagle Wireless is the only Western-aligned provider of IoT and automotive connectivity modules with operations across North America, Europe, and APAC. We deliver secure, high-performance connectivity solutions for automotive and IoT markets, backed by U.S.-based manufacturing, global engineering expertise, and local support in every region where we operate. Featured in the Wall Street Journal. $44M raised. Growing fast.

This is an on-site role in Minneapolis, Minnesota. Solon, Ohio is possible for the right candidate. The role involves regular travel to our sites in North America and occasional travel to Europe and APAC.

You will own the compute layer every team at Eagle Wireless runs on: physical servers and storage at our sites, our AWS accounts, the virtual machines and clusters on both, the container platform on top of them, the Linux systems our engineers build and test on, and the backup and recovery behind all of it. Our stack is Proxmox, AWS, Ubuntu and RHEL/Rocky, Podman, Ansible, and Axcient. This is a platform seat. You set the standard, write it down, and make the site teams better at running it.

Key Duties & Responsibilities

On-premises compute

Servers, hypervisor hosts, storage, and UPS at our locations, including racking, cabling, out-of-band management (IPMI/iLO/iDRAC), and NAS storage
Hardware lifecycle, capacity planning, and patching, including failed-disk replacement and data recovery
The compute foundation for the new Solon factory and headquarters

AWS and virtual compute

AWS accounts, regions, EC2, storage, and ECR, including account lifecycle and AWS health and abuse notices
Virtual machines and clusters on-premises and in AWS, for every team that runs on them: Proxmox installs, VM standards, P2V and rehosting of physical servers, and AWS image imports
Backup and recovery for the infrastructure IT owns, tested rather than assumed: Axcient, Proxmox Backup Server, drive imaging, and AWS image restores, including backups of the DHCP, DNS, and firewall configurations
Linux and Windows server hardening for the hosts IT owns

Containers, Linux, and services

The container platform: rootless Podman with systemd Quadlets, Portainer, the private registry, and the standards for how services are deployed
Ansible-based deployment with least-privilege access, so application teams can deploy without IT involvement
Reverse proxies and certificates: nginx and Traefik, SSL issuance and renewal, and the standard for publishing applications through the proxy
Linux server installs, user, sudo, and SSH key provisioning, and a defined process for developer requests for root access, build machines, and test VMsHands-on Linux support for our engineers at the operating system level: build machines, test systems, packages, networking, storage, and performance
The instances behind internal services such as Jenkins, Gerrit, PyPI, and FTP/EDI. IT stands up and runs the instances. The teams own their projects and pipelines.

Automation and observability

Infrastructure as code and scripts in Bash, PowerShell, and Python that make provisioning and routine operations repeatable
Logging, monitoring, and dashboards for the platform, with ELK and GrafanaSingle sign-on for the platforms IT hosts, working with the IT administrators who own identity

Standards and the team around you

Written infrastructure standards in Confluence, treated as a deliverable of the role, not a byproductA clear line with application owners: you run the platform, they run what is on it
Cross-trained backup with our compute engineer in Belgrade, and they for youA working dependency with the network side: you build and host the DNS, NTP, proxy, and DHCP servers and back up their configurations; the network side configures and operates the services on them and owns connectivity between our sites and AWS
Enough network depth to troubleshoot firewalls, routing, VPN, DNS, and DHCP and keep the core network running during an outage
Change plans with validation and rollback steps for production changes
Architecture reviewed by our CISO before it ships

Qualifications/Skills/Knowledge

7+ years in infrastructure or systems engineering, with recent ownership of a hybrid on-premises and cloud environment
Expert-level Linux administration (Ubuntu and RHEL/Rocky): systemd, shell scripting, package management and repositories, storage on hypervisor hosts (ZFS or LVM-thin) including capacity monitoring and disk failure recovery, networking, performance troubleshooting, and users, sudo, and SSH at scale
Proven experience supporting engineers on many Linux systems, including build machines, test systems, and developer escalations
Hands-on depth with virtualization on Linux (Proxmox preferred) and AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, S3)
Backup and recovery, including restores you have run yourself and recovery after a VM or host failure
Configuration management with Ansible and scripting in Bash, PowerShell, or PythonContainer experience with Docker or Podman and systemdA habit of writing things down: diagrams, standards, and runbooks someone else can follow
Degree or equivalent relevant experience
Windows Server administration
Working knowledge of firewalls, routing, VPN, and DNS/DHCP
Reverse proxies and certificate management (nginx, Traefik)
Rootless Podman with systemd QuadletsAxcient and Proxmox Backup ServerProxmox clustering, including quorum and Corosync failure scenarios
Infrastructure as code with TerraformKubernetes and HelmELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) and GrafanaRunning Jenkins and Gerrit instances
Entra ID single sign-on and federation (SAML and OIDC)
Supporting manufacturing or engineering workloads

Our work environment is collaborative, and we offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, which includes medical/dental/vision, generous PTO and paid parental leave programs.

Eagle Wireless recognizes the importance of forming inclusive teams to foster an environment where creative solutions are made for our clients, and all have the opportunity to thrive and succeed. We encourage candidates from a variety of backgrounds to apply to be a part of our team.

jobs.description:
Greenberg Traurig (GT), a global law firm with locations across the world in 15 countries, has an exciting employment opportunity for you. We offer competitive compensation and an excellent benefits package, along with the opportunity to work within an innovative and collaborative environment.

 Join our Technology Team as an AI Platform Engineer located in various offices.

We are seeking a professional who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. The ideal candidate possesses strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, ensuring efficiency and accuracy in every task. With a dedicated work ethic and a can-do attitude, you will take initiative and approach challenges with confidence and resilience. Excellent communication skills are essential for collaborating effectively across teams and delivering exceptional client service. If you are someone who demonstrates initiative, adaptability, and innovation, we invite you to join our team.

This role can be based in various offices, on a hybrid basis. This role reports to the Director of Enterprise Content and Cloud Services.

 Position Summary:

The AI Platform Engineer builds, automates, and operates shared cloud AI services for the firm’s AI development and solution teams. Working primarily in Microsoft Azure, the engineer owns AI platform configuration, hosted model deployments and endpoints, access controls, observability, capacity, costs, and production readiness, with additional responsibility for approved AI services in AWS, Google Cloud, and vendor environments. The role provides secure, reusable capabilities for AI applications and agents and partners with Data Engineering on governed access to enterprise information. This is a hands-on platform engineering and operations role, not a model-training or application feature-development role.

 Key Responsibilities:

- Builds and operates shared AI platform services, primarily in Azure, including model deployments, endpoints, configuration, upgrades, and retirement of model versions and services.

- Develops reusable automation for provisioning, model deployment, access configuration, and monitoring using version-controlled infrastructure-as-code, scripts, and controlled deployment pipelines.

- Monitors availability, latency, errors, and utilization; troubleshoots identity, networking, quota, and service issues; and leads platform incident response and vendor escalation.

- Maintains platform inventories, telemetry, audit records, and operational reporting, protecting client and firm information in logs under approved data-handling and retention requirements.

- Partners with security, cloud, identity, privacy, governance, and engineering teams to implement approved identity, least-privilege access, network-access, secrets-management, and logging controls.

- Builds secure, reusable platform access patterns for approved enterprise data and knowledge sources, preserving source permissions and implementing approved confidentiality controls.

- Establishes usage attribution, quota controls, budget monitoring, and capacity reporting; optimizes consumption, deployment choices, and cost without compromising service requirements.

- Defines service health indicators, alerting, runbooks, rollback procedures, and production-readiness criteria; tests changes before release and maintains lifecycle and recovery plans.

- Authors technical standards, reference architectures, and operational documentation; participates in architecture reviews and delivers training and technical guidance to solution teams.

- Serves as a technical advisor to vendors, stakeholders, and solution teams and provides guidance on platform design and operations.

- Appears on camera for meetings with colleagues and vendors.

- Performs other duties as assigned by management.

 Qualifications:

  Skills & Competencies

- Strong Azure platform engineering skills and understanding of managed AI services, including model deployments, endpoint authentication, quotas, versioning, and lifecycle management.

- Strong production operations skills, including observability, alerting, incident response, root-cause analysis, change management, capacity planning, and recovery.

- Ability to build and maintain reusable infrastructure-as-code using tools such as Terraform or Bicep and adopt the firm’s approved tooling and engineering standards.

- Proficiency in Python and/or PowerShell for API-driven provisioning, configuration, operational automation, and troubleshooting.

- Experience with Git, code review, and CI/CD pipelines, including testing, deployment approvals, secure configuration, and rollback.

- Practical knowledge of Entra ID, managed identities, service principals, secrets management, private connectivity, DNS, and least-privilege access.

- Understanding of APIs, search, indexing, and retrieval patterns sufficient to enable platform integration and troubleshoot with data and application engineers.

- Understanding of governed data access, source permissions, confidentiality, and safeguards for sensitive information in platform telemetry.

- Ability to analyze usage attribution, cost, performance, quotas, and capacity and implement practical optimization and cost-control measures.

- Strong problem-solving, documentation, communication, and delivery skills; ability to collaborate with vendors and technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  Education & Prior Experience

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or equivalent practical experience.

- 5+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud engineering, site reliability engineering, or AI infrastructure roles.

- Hands-on experience building and operating Microsoft Azure services in an enterprise production environment, including deployment, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management.

- Production experience operating at least one managed AI or large language model platform, such as Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, or an equivalent service.

- Demonstrated delivery of infrastructure-as-code, Python and/or PowerShell automation, and Git-based controlled deployment pipelines.

- Experience with AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or comparable platforms preferred. Docker/Kubernetes experience and relevant cloud or AI certifications are a plus.

- Experience working in a professional services organization strongly preferred. Law firm experience a plus.

 Physical Requirements:

- While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to move from workstation or desk, throughout the work area to work independently or with a team, to meet with colleagues or supervisor and retrieve work assignments.

- This position may also be sedentary and require the employee to sit for extended periods of time.

- Requires manual dexterity to dial a telephone, enter data into a computer, handle objects and operate tools.
