jobs.title: Analista en protección a Endpoint y XDR
jobs.summary: Desde una consultoría líder europea en servicios y soluciones digitales buscamos un/a Especialista en Protección de Endpoint y XDR para incorporarse a nuestro equipo de ciberseguridad, dinámico y en constante crecimiento. El/la candidato/a ideal deberá...
jobs.description:
Desde una consultoría líder europea en servicios y soluciones digitales buscamos un/a Especialista en Protección de Endpoint y XDR para incorporarse a nuestro equipo de ciberseguridad, dinámico y en constante crecimiento. El/la candidato/a ideal deberá contar con una sólida comprensión de las tecnologías de protección de Endpoint (Antivirus, Antimalware, EPP, entre otras), así como de plataformas EDR, XDR y SIEM, orientando su actividad al análisis, la investigación y la respuesta ante amenazas de seguridad.

Buscamos un perfil con experiencia en la administración, explotación y optimización de estas tecnologías, capaz de interpretar eventos de seguridad, identificar patrones de comportamiento malicioso y contribuir a la mejora continua de las capacidades de detección y respuesta. Se valorarán conocimientos sobre despliegue e implantación de soluciones Endpoint y XDR, aunque estas funciones no constituirán el foco principal del puesto.

Esta posición representa una excelente oportunidad para profesionales apasionados por la ciberseguridad que deseen contribuir activamente a la protección de organizaciones de alto nivel.

Responsabilidades:

* Analizar eventos, alertas y registros de seguridad procedentes de plataformas Endpoint, EDR, XDR y SIEM para identificar amenazas potenciales y actividades sospechosas.
* Investigar incidentes de ciberseguridad, participando en las actividades de detección, análisis, contención y seguimiento hasta su resolución.
* Administrar y optimizar las capacidades de monitorización, detección y respuesta de las soluciones Endpoint y XDR.
* Colaborar en la definición y mejora de casos de uso, reglas de detección, procedimientos operativos y playbooks de respuesta.
* Realizar análisis de amenazas, indicadores de compromiso (IoC) y tendencias emergentes para fortalecer la postura de seguridad.
* Colaborar con otros equipos de seguridad y operaciones para mejorar la capacidad de prevención, detección y respuesta ante incidentes.
* Participar en la integración y puesta en marcha de nuevas capacidades de protección Endpoint y XDR, aportando conocimientos funcionales y operativos.
* Mantenerse actualizado/a sobre las últimas amenazas, vulnerabilidades, técnicas de ataque y tendencias del sector de la ciberseguridad.

Requisitos:

* Titulación en Informática, Ciberseguridad o áreas afines. Se valorará experiencia equivalente.
* Más de 5 años de experiencia en ciberseguridad, con foco en tecnologías Endpoint, EDR, XDR y SIEM.
* Experiencia en administración, monitorización y análisis de soluciones de protección Endpoint y XDR.
* Conocimientos en análisis de logs, correlación de eventos, detección de amenazas y Threat Hunting.
* Experiencia en gestión e investigación de incidentes de ciberseguridad.
* Conocimiento de procesos de respuesta ante incidentes, casos de uso y buenas prácticas de operaciones de seguridad.
* Conocimientos de integración y despliegue de soluciones Endpoint y XDR, valorándose experiencia en proyectos de implantación.
* Capacidad analítica, orientación a la resolución de problemas y buenas habilidades de comunicación.
* Certificaciones de seguridad como Security+ (deseable ), CySA+, SC-200, SC-100, CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator/Analyst, CEH, GSEC o CISSP.

*Únete a un equipo que impulsa la innovación y trabaja en proyectos de alto impacto.*

*Ofrecemos la oportunidad de asistir, junto al equipo de ciberseguridad, a conferencias, ponencias y charlas en Congresos de Seguridad Informática, como Navaja Negra, RootedCON, Hacken, jornadas CCN STIC, etc. al ser patrocinadores de muchos de estos eventos.*

*Ponemos a tu disposición un amplio catálogo formativo en competencias tecnológicas y certificaciones de acuerdo con las exigencias de los proyectos y clientes. Formación en idiomas, donde podrás elegir entre 12 opciones. Formación en habilidades personales dentro del ámbito profesional. Uso de otras plataformas adicionales como Udemy y OpenWebinars.*

*Te ofrecemos una retribución a la carta, pudiendo elegir diferentes productos y modelar tú mismo cómo distribuirlos: seguro de salud, tickets de comida, guardería, tarjeta transporte y formación. Además, contarás con un seguro de vida incluido como parte de tus beneficios. También tendrás acceso a ventajas del grupo de empresa, como descuentos en diversos productos y servicios.*

*El contrato será indefinido, con un horario flexible de oficina, con posibilidad de teletrabajar para poder conciliar de la mejor forma tu vida personal-profesional. Proporcionamos estabilidad y un excelente ambiente laboral, formado por los mejores profesionales en el ámbito de la Ciberseguridad.*

*Ofrecemos una atractiva carrera profesional en función de la experiencia y potencial personal, dentro de una compañía en continua evolución y con un sólido crecimiento.*

jobs.description:
**Vem ser Ituber \& vem fazer Itaú** O Itaú é a marca mais valiosa do Brasil, a melhor empresa para trabalhar segundo o Great Place to Work e o maior banco da América Latina. Nós impactamos diariamente mais de 98 milhões de clientes em 18 países.

Somos feitos de pessoas e acreditamos que ter um quadro com pluralidade de origens, culturas, crenças, experiências, raças, deficiências, gêneros, orientações afetivo-sexuais e gerações ampliam as perspectivas e contribuem para um clima de respeito e valorização das diferenças. Não queremos você apenas por achar que tem a nossa cara. Queremos ter um pouco da sua também!

**Como é o dia a dia de um Ituber nessa área?** Você fará parte da Squad de Endpoint Security, atuando na sustentação e evolução dos controles de proteção de endpoints e workloads em um ambiente de alta criticidade. Buscamos uma pessoa com perfil analítico, curiosidade técnica e capacidade de aprofundar investigações, propor melhorias e colaborar com diferentes times de Cyber Security e Tecnologia.

**No Seu Dia a Dia Você Irá**

* Sustentar e evoluir soluções de Endpoint Security e EDR/XDR.
* Administrar e aprimorar a plataforma CrowdStrike Falcon ou ferramentas equivalentes.
* Monitorar a cobertura dos ativos, identificando gaps de proteção e conduzindo planos de ação.
* Apoiar análises de vulnerabilidades e CVEs, considerando exposição e contexto de risco.
* Analisar telemetrias, eventos e detecções de segurança.
* Desenvolver indicadores, métricas e dashboards de acompanhamento dos controles.
* Atuar na proteção de workloads em Cloud e na integração entre ambientes de nuvem e Endpoint Security.
* Evoluir guardrails e controles preventivos de segurança.
* Investigar incidentes e problemas relacionados a agentes, políticas e ferramentas de proteção.
* Trabalhar em parceria com áreas como SOC, CSIRT, Red Team e demais equipes de Cyber Security.
* Documentar processos, procedimentos e decisões técnicas.
* Identificar oportunidades de automação e melhoria contínua.

**Buscamos Profissionais Com Experiência Em**

* Endpoint Security
* EDR/XDR
* CrowdStrike Falcon (ou solução equivalente)
* Gestão de vulnerabilidades e CVEs
* Cloud Security
* Linux
* Troubleshooting e análise de incidentes
* Automação de processos
* Construção de indicadores e análise de dados

**Diferenciais**

* Experiência com proteção de workloads em Cloud.
* Vivência com integrações, automações e observabilidade de ambientes de segurança.
* Atuação em times de Cyber Security, SOC, CSIRT ou Red Team.

**Ao se tornar um ituber você tem_**

* Vale-Transporte
* Vale-Refeição (Restaurantes) / Vale-Alimentação (Supermercados)
* Plano médico (Fundação Saúde Itaú ou Central Nacional Unimed)
* Plano odontológico (Odontoprev ou Interodonto)
* Seguro de Vida
* PLR -- Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (Mediante resultados do banco)
* Previdência privada
* Descontos exclusivos em nossos produtos financeiros
* Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida
* Auxílio Creche / Babá (para papais e mamães)
* Incentivo a estudos
* Wellhub ou TotalPass
* Acesso aos Clubes de Lazer Itaú (Guarapiranga / Itanhaém e São Sebastião)
* Algumas vantagens que você pode conhecer durante o processo 😊

Conheça mais sobre nossa cultura: https://www.itau.com.br/relacoes-com-investidores/noticias/cultura-itubers-e-nosso-novo-conjunto-de-valores/

* Estimulamos candidaturas de pessoas com deficiência em todas as nossas posições, sendo assim, sinta-se à vontade para se candidatar em vagas sinalizadas como exclusivas ou não para pessoas com deficiência. Somos comprometidos com a inclusão e valorizamos a diversidade.

jobs.description:
**At World Fuel, our employees are the key to our global success. We are industry leaders due to the innumerable talents of our approximately 5000 strong professional team. Our people thrive in an entrepreneurial and culturally-diverse environment, where innovative thinking, collaboration and efficient execution are highly valued. Our high-performance culture is what allows us to drive sustained growth. Stronger together, we promote an environment where individuals can thrive.** **Endpoint Systems Engineer** **Location:** San José, Costa Rica

**About World Fuel** At World Fuel, technology plays a critical role in supporting employees and business operations around the globe. We're investing in modern workplace technologies that improve productivity, security, and user experience across a rapidly evolving digital environment.

We are looking for an Endpoint Systems Engineer to join our global IT Infrastructure team. In this role, you'll help design, build, automate, and support modern endpoint management solutions across Windows, macOS, mobile devices, and cloud-based desktop platforms.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone passionate about endpoint engineering, automation, cloud technologies, and modern device management.

What You'll Do

Modern Endpoint Management

* Engineer, deploy, and support endpoint management solutions across Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, and virtual desktop environments.
* Administer and enhance Microsoft Intune and Jamf Pro platforms.
* Build scalable device management policies, compliance controls, and configuration standards.
* Support modern device provisioning through Windows Autopilot, Apple Business Manager, and related technologies.

Cloud \& Virtual Desktop Engineering

* Design and support Windows 365 Cloud PC environments.
* Manage Cloud PC provisioning, lifecycle management, policy administration, and performance optimization.
* Support endpoint virtualization platforms and modern desktop delivery solutions.
* Contribute to the adoption of cloud-hosted workplace technologies.

Automation \& Platform Engineering

* Develop automation solutions using PowerShell, Python, Bash, APIs, and Infrastructure as Code principles.
* Improve operational efficiency through automation and process optimization.
* Build repeatable, scalable endpoint deployment and management frameworks.
* Maintain and enhance application deployment and software packaging processes.

Security \& Compliance

* Implement endpoint security, compliance, and device protection standards.
* Support Zero Trust initiatives and secure endpoint configuration practices.
* Monitor endpoint health, patch compliance, and platform performance.
* Partner closely with Security teams to strengthen endpoint resilience.

Troubleshooting \& Continuous Improvement

* Investigate and resolve complex endpoint and infrastructure issues.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement long-term solutions.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, standards, and procedures.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure, Service Desk, Operations, and Security teams on strategic initiatives and projects.

What You'll Bring

**Required Experience**

* 3 years of experience in endpoint engineering, systems engineering, infrastructure, workplace technology, or a related IT discipline.
* Experience supporting enterprise Windows and macOS environments.
* Hands-on administration experience with Microsoft Intune and Jamf Pro.
* Experience with application packaging, software deployment, and endpoint lifecycle management.
* Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

**Preferred Experience**

* Windows 365 Cloud PC administration and support.
* Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), VMware Horizon, Citrix, or other virtual desktop technologies.
* Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
* Intune automation, REST APIs, and Jamf API integrations.
* Git-based workflows and Infrastructure as Code methodologies.
* Windows Autopilot, Microsoft Autopatch, and Apple Business Manager.
* Endpoint security and Zero Trust practices.
* Microsoft, Azure, Apple, Jamf, Windows 365, or endpoint management certifications.

Education

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* Equivalent combination of education and experience will also be considered.

Why Join World Fuel?

* Work with modern cloud-first technologies including Intune, Jamf, Windows 365, and automation platforms.
* Help shape the future of endpoint management and workplace technology at a global scale.
* Collaborate with talented infrastructure, security, and engineering teams.
* Gain exposure to enterprise-level cloud, automation, and virtualization initiatives.
* Opportunity to lead technical improvements that impact thousands of users worldwide.
* Hybrid work environment with opportunities for professional growth and technical development.

#WFS

jobs.description:
Job Title- Senior Windows Systems Administrator – Active Directory / PowerShell

Position Overview This role is focused on hands-on enterprise Windows administration with an emphasis on Active Directory, Group Policy, PowerShell automation, Windows Server lifecycle management, and CIS hardening. You’ll work through an established operational backlog, implement AD/GPO changes and security baselines, automate repetitive administrative tasks, and maintain the scripts and documentation needed to make these processes repeatable and supportable.
The role works closely with the Senior Server Administrator and Server Operations Team Manager, with a strong focus on implementation, automation, documentation, and measurable backlog reduction.

What You'll Do Execute the Active Directory, Group Policy, and permissions work backlog, including GPO creation, modification, testing, retirement, delegation, and access changes. Implement CIS baselines through GPO and scripted remediation, working from the Senior Server Administrator's analysis and direction. Design, write, and maintain PowerShell for administration, automation, auditing, remediation, and reporting across endpoints and Active Directory. Identify repetitive operational tasks and automate them, replacing manual procedures with tested and documented scripts. Manage the Windows Server lifecycle at enterprise scale, including build, configuration, patching, upgrading, troubleshooting, and decommissioning. Receive and complete work assigned and prioritized by the Server Operations Team Manager, including work routed through the Senior Server Administrator or Server Administrator under the Manager's oversight. Log, update, and track work items in Azure DevOps. Work service requests and change controls through the Service Management tool while following the team's change process. Store work products and documentation in Azure DevOps as work is performed, including scripts, code, GPO documentation, runbooks, and SOPs. Cross-skill with the Senior Server Administrator so AD/GPO and CIS knowledge is shared across the team. Take on additional on-premises duties as team responsibilities are realigned, as directed by the Manager. Required Qualifications 10+ years of experience with Active Directory, including domain services, replication, delegation, permissions, and domain controller troubleshooting. 8+ years of experience with Group Policy, including design, scoping, filtering, troubleshooting, and change control in a large environment. 8+ years of experience with PowerShell, including modules, error handling, remote execution, scheduled and unattended scripts, and AD/GPO automation. 5+ years of experience implementing CIS benchmarks or equivalent hardening baselines on Windows endpoints through GPO and scripting. 8+ years of experience with Windows Server administration and lifecycle management across a large server estate, including build, patching, upgrading, and decommissioning. Experience documenting work as it is performed, including maintaining current SOPs, runbooks, and change records without relying on after-the-fact documentation. Experience working from a tracked work queue, such as Azure DevOps boards, and within formal service request and change-control processes. Preferred Qualifications Experience with task automation and orchestration beyond PowerShell, such as scheduled workflows and automation platforms. Endpoint patch management experience, including third-party application and Windows OS patching. Third-party application packaging and deployment automation, including application bundles such as PDQ. PKI and Active Directory Certificate Services operations. Success in This Role Success is assessed against metrics established with the Manager and tracked in Azure DevOps. Key outcomes include:
 Reduction and tracking of the AD/GPO backlog in Azure DevOps. Implementation of CIS items according to the Senior Server Administrator's direction, with before-and-after states recorded. Core administrative and remediation tasks covered by tested and documented PowerShell, including a baseline script library in Azure DevOps. All work products, including scripts, code, and documentation, stored in Azure DevOps as property of the branch, with no work held locally or in personal storage. Tested coverage of AD/GPO and PowerShell-based processes so that more than one person can run and support them. SOPs for recurring AD/GPO and hardening tasks written and reviewed by the Senior Server Administrator.

jobs.description:
Overview
 Client is seeking a Windows Client Engineer to manage and modernize its Windows endpoint environment through Microsoft Intune and SCCM (Configuration Manager), with a primary focus on reducing vulnerability risk. This hands-on role partners closely with security teams to analyze vulnerability findings, develop remediation solutions, and deploy fixes across the enterprise.
 The ideal candidate will have strong experience with Windows endpoint administration, endpoint vulnerability remediation, PowerShell scripting, and enterprise device management technologies. Success in this role requires the ability to investigate vulnerabilities, implement scalable fixes, and ensure compliance without disrupting end users.

Core Responsibilities
 • Review vulnerabilities identified through Tenable tools and manage the endpoint remediation process from investigation through closure.
 • Build, test, package, and deploy remediation solutions using Microsoft Intune and SCCM, including patches, application updates, configuration changes, registry modifications, and scripted fixes.
 • Author and maintain PowerShell scripts for automation, detection, and remediation, including Intune proactive remediations and SCCM configuration items.
 • Package and deploy third-party application updates through Intune, SCCM, or patch management tools.
 • Manage Windows Update policies and patching processes using Windows Update for Business, WSUS, or SCCM software updates.
 • Partner with vulnerability management and security teams to triage findings, validate remediation effectiveness, and identify false positives.
 • Track remediation progress and provide reporting on compliance, patch coverage, and outstanding risks against established service levels.
 • Maintain Windows configuration baselines and security hardening standards across endpoint devices.
 • Support co-management, device onboarding, compliance policies, and conditional access initiatives within the endpoint management environment.
 • Document remediation procedures and contribute to standardized, well-tested deployment practices.

Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies
 • Bachelor's degree or higher.
 • 3 to 5 years of experience engineering and administering Windows endpoints in an enterprise environment.
 • Proficiency with Microsoft Windows Client and Server operating systems.
 • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune and SCCM/Configuration Manager, including application packaging and deployment.
 • Strong PowerShell scripting skills for automation, detection, and remediation.
 • Experience with Windows patch management using Windows Update for Business, WSUS, or SCCM software updates.
 • Experience performing endpoint and vulnerability remediation, including investigating findings and implementing corrective actions.
 • Familiarity with vulnerability management concepts and tools, with Tenable experience strongly preferred and comparable platforms such as Qualys or Rapid7 considered relevant.
 • Understanding of CVEs, CVSS scoring, and translating vulnerability findings into remediation activities.
 • Knowledge of Windows operating systems, Active Directory, Group Policy, and Entra ID (Azure AD).
 • Ability to carefully test, validate, and deploy changes while minimizing impact to end users.
 • Demonstrated ability to work independently and proactively drive vulnerability investigation and remediation efforts.

Preferred Skills or Experience
 • Experience with application packaging tools such as PSADT, PatchMyPC, MSI, or MSIX.
 • Exposure to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Threat & Vulnerability Management integration.
 • Knowledge of security hardening frameworks, including CIS Benchmarks and DISA STIGs.
 • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft MD-102, SC-200, or CompTIA Security+.

Work Details
 • Contract position.
 • First shift schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
 • Interview required; an onsite visit is preferred but flexible.

Support scheduled maintenance activities involving Windows-based endpoint management servers and supporting database infrastructure.Perform assigned technical tasks under approved Change Records.Maintain technical documentation, SOPs, implementation guides, and troubleshooting procedures.Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field.At least 3 years of enterprise endpoint security administration experience.Hands-on experience administering SentinelOne EPP/EDR, including agent deployment, policy management, or security alert investigation.Experience managing endpoint security configurations and policies using Microsoft Intune.Strong PowerShell scripting and automation skills.Experience supporting Windows 10/11 enterprise environments.Knowledge of endpoint security, malware protection, security incident response, and endpoint hardening.Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Windows security controls.Ability to troubleshoot complex endpoint security and operational issues.Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Microsoft MECM/SCCM and migration to Intune.Experience with SentinelOne APIs and security workflow automation.Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, IBM QRadar, or Cortex XSOAR.Knowledge of NIST SP 800-53, CIS Benchmarks, and Zero Trust security principles.Experience supporting federal government or large enterprise environments.Relevant Microsoft endpoint administration, SentinelOne, or cybersecurity certifications.What Makes You Successful

You have personally administered endpoint protection platforms rather than only monitoring alerts.You can investigate endpoint security problems and implement solutions independently.You are comfortable working with Intune, Windows, and PowerShell.You collaborate effectively with cybersecurity, engineering, and operations teams.You take ownership of technical issues and document your work clearly.

Job Description:Company Description:

McDonald’s is proud to be one of the most recognized brands in the world, with restaurants in over 100 countries that serve 70 million customers daily. We continue to operate from a position of strength. Our updated growth strategy is focused on staying ahead of what our customers want and realizing further growth potential. Our relentless ambition is why McDonald’s remains one of the world’s leading corporations after almost 70 years. Joining McDonald's means thinking big and preparing for a career that can have influence around the world.

At McDonald’s, we see every day as a chance to create positive impact. We lead through our values centered on inclusivity, service, integrity, community and family. From support of Ronald McDonald House to our Youth Opportunity project and sustainability initiatives, our values keep us dedicated to using our scale for good: good for our customers, people, industry and planet. We also offer a broad range of outstanding benefits including a sabbatical program, tuition assistance and flexible work arrangements.

Department OverviewWe are seeking an experienced Endpoint Detection and Response Engineer III to join our Cybersecurity Endpoint Protection team, focused on building and sustaining enterprise‑grade endpoint protection capabilities at global scale. This role emphasizes engineering rigor, platform reliability, and thoughtful implementation of endpoint security controls that reduce risk while enabling business operations. The Engineer III collaborates closely with Detection Engineering and other cybersecurity and technology teams to ensure endpoint controls generate high‑fidelity telemetry and integrate effectively into detection and response workflows. This role contributes hands‑on expertise, continuous improvement, and durable solutions across McDonald’s endpoint ecosystem.

Please note that this position in based in Chicago, Illinois, and follows a hybrid work schedule, requiring attendance in the office 3-4 days per week.

 DutiesEngineer, configure, and operate endpoint protection platforms and controls in alignment with established standards and architectures. Assist in the continuous improvement and operational stability of endpoint protection services. Collaborate closely with Detection Engineering to ensure endpoint telemetry supports high-quality detection use cases. Implement preventative and hardening controls that reduce endpoint risk while maintaining business usability. Contribute technical input into design discussions and improvement initiatives Develop and maintain automation, scripts, and tooling to improve consistency and operational efficiency. Troubleshoot complex endpoint protection issues and provide advanced technical support when escalated. Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and standard operating procedures related to endpoint protection controls. Stay informed of emerging endpoint threats, trends, and technologies and share insights with the team. Qualifications5+ years of experience in cybersecurity with a strong focus on endpoint protection engineering or operations. Hands-on experience with enterprise endpoint protection or EDR/XDR platforms.Strong knowledge of Windows, macOS, and/or Linux endpoint operating systems. Experience implementing and operating security controls at enterprise scale. Proficiency in scripting or automation using tools such as PowerShell or Python. Solid understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and models such as NIST, CIS Controls, and MITRE ATT&CK. Experience and ability to participate in a 24x7x365 team. Analyze sophisticated issues, detail their impact on the business, resolve their root causes, and identify corrective actions to prevent similar future events. Super interpersonal skills, able to correspond with collaborators promptly and with attention to detail, vitality, and thoroughness to all levels of the organization. Experience handling third-party vendors and service providers. Preferred Qualifications

5+ years of experience designing, implementing, and operating enterprise scale endpoint protection and app control products across diverse global environments and operating systems.Demonstrated experience securing nontraditional and emerging endpoint platforms, including IoT devices, cloud hosted workloads, virtual machines, and containerized environments across major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, OCI). Experience supporting or enabling blue, purple, or red team activities through endpoint control engineering, telemetry improvements, and detection enablement. Advanced proficiency in scripting and automation (e.g., Python, PowerShell) to operationalize controls, improve reliability, and reduce manual effort through engineering led solutions. Strong experience integrating and extending security platforms via APIs, including REST and GraphQL, to enable automation, reporting, and ecosystem interoperability. Proven ability to integrate endpoint protection platforms with IT Service Management systems (e.g., ServiceNow) to support operational workflows and escalation paths. Experience leveraging data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., PowerBI, Tableau) to analyze endpoint trends, surface risk signals, and communicate technical insights effectively. Working knowledge of the ITIL operating model, with an understanding of how endpoint protection engineering supports broader service operations. Experience operating within Agile delivery models, contributing engineering work through iterative planning and execution. Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, ITIL, or equivalent advanced security or engineering credentials. Work with Microsoft/support vendors and internal Security, Identity, Application and local IT teams for complex technical issues.

jobs.title: MDM Systems Engineer
jobs.summary: About the Opportunity The Intersect Group is partnering with an innovative organization that leverages data, technology, and digital transformation to drive business growth and operational excellence. With a strong focus on data governance, system...
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

The Intersect Group is partnering with an innovative organization that leverages data, technology, and digital transformation to drive business growth and operational excellence. With a strong focus on data governance, system integration, and customer experience, this organization is committed to building scalable technology solutions that enable informed decision making across the enterprise. Their collaborative environment values continuous improvement, technical innovation, and delivering high quality data assets to business stakeholders.

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced MDM Systems Engineer to support and enhance a complex Master Data Management ecosystem that serves as a critical foundation for enterprise data operations. This role will play a key part in designing scalable integrations, managing data pipelines, and ensuring high quality master data is delivered reliably across multiple business platforms.

The MDM Systems Engineer will partner with technical and business teams to architect data flows, optimize system performance, and improve data governance practices. This individual will drive automation initiatives, resolve integration challenges, and contribute to the ongoing modernization of enterprise data platforms while ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and accessibility.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, build, and maintain scalable batch and real time data integration pipelines across MDM, PIM, Snowflake, and downstream systems

• Develop and optimize ETL and ELT workflows, APIs, and automated orchestration processes to support enterprise data operations

• Map source to target data flows, transformation logic, and business rules to ensure accurate and governed master data delivery

• Maintain data integrity, taxonomy structures, attribute schemas, and validation processes within MDM and PIM platforms

• Create and execute advanced SQL queries for data validation, quality auditing, regression testing, and anomaly detection

• Manage outbound data syndication and integrations with platforms such as Salesforce, eCommerce solutions, and reporting environments

• Translate business requirements into technical specifications, system designs, and actionable development tasks

• Investigate and resolve data pipeline issues, integration failures, and system incidents while maintaining service level expectations

Key Requirements

• 2 to 5 years of experience in data engineering, integration engineering, systems analysis, or a related enterprise data environment

• Strong proficiency in SQL, including complex joins, aggregations, window functions, data profiling, and schema analysis

• Hands on experience with Master Data Management or Product Information Management platforms such as EnterWorks, Precisely, Informatica, or similar solutions

• Experience working with Snowflake and cloud based data architectures

• Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, XML, ETL and ELT methodologies, and enterprise integration patterns

• Experience utilizing Jira, Confluence, and IT service management tools such as Ivanti or comparable platforms

• Knowledge of data governance, data quality frameworks, taxonomy management, and master data lifecycle processes

• Strong analytical, communication, and problem solving skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across both technical and nontechnical teams

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline

• Equivalent combination of professional experience and technical expertise will also be considered

Why Consider This Opportunity

• Opportunity to work on enterprise scale data initiatives and modernization efforts

• Exposure to leading cloud data technologies and integration platforms

• Highly collaborative environment with visibility across multiple business functions

• Direct impact on data strategy, operational efficiency, and business decision making

Apply Today

If you are a data driven technology professional with experience in data integration, MDM platforms, and cloud data environments, we would like to hear from you. Please submit your resume along with your contact information to The Intersect Group for immediate consideration. Qualified candidates will be contacted promptly to discuss this opportunity in greater detail.

The role is accountable for the image and task sequence architecture in Microsoft Configuration Manager, the Group Policy and configuration estate that governs the desktop, and the PowerShell that automates, hardens and self-heals it. The role spans both management planes: the on-premises ConfigMgr estate that builds the device today, and the Microsoft Intune and cloud-native stack the estate is moving to, provisioning, policy, application delivery and patching from the cloud. This is a hands-on build engineering role, not console administration: success is a device that provisions predictably, applies its configuration without conflict, performs well on day one, and stays that way through patch, upgrade and refresh cycles, regardless of which plane manages it.

Manage co-management and workload transition to Intune.Modern endpoint management with Intune and cloud management. Migrate GPO and ConfigMgr workloads to cloud management with clear validation.Cloud patch and update management. Own Windows servicing through Windows Update for Business, Autopatch where adopted, update rings, deferrals, expedited updates, feature updates, driver policy and compliance reporting. Optimize update delivery for remote and bandwidth-constrained sites.Cloud application delivery. Rationalize legacy policy, resolve conflicts, and map policies to Intune where appropriate.PowerShell automation and configuration scripting. Ensure scripts are logged, error-handled, idempotent, signed and source-controlled.Application packaging and delivery. Own application packaging across MSI, MSIX, App-V where required, and Intune Win32 apps. Standardize silent installs, transforms, uninstall logic, rollback testing, catalog quality and self-service delivery.Windows platform, identity and backend integration. Engineer endpoint dependencies including Active Directory, Entra ID, domain join, DNS, DHCP, PKI, WSUS, activation, Windows Hello for Business and LAPS. Understand network and content-delivery behavior supporting branch and remote builds.Security, hardening and patch engineering. Implement Windows security baselines, BitLocker, ASR, WDAC or AppLocker, Credential Guard, exploit protection and local admin controls. Maintain patch compliance, feature update readiness and remediation of non-compliant devices.End-user experience engineering. Measure and improve provisioning, OOBE, boot, sign-in, policy processing, application reliability and profile performance. Use telemetry, targets and proactive remediation to reduce tickets and technician touch.Operations, change and technical leadership. Lead change, pilot planning, validation, backout, Tier 3/4 escalation and root-cause analysis. Maintain clear documentation, runbooks, design records, roadmaps and technical debt priorities.Required Qualifications7 years in Windows endpoint or desktop engineering, with significant ownership of the build and configuration estate in a large or complex environment.Deep hands-on Microsoft Configuration Manager engineering: site administration, OS deployment, task sequence authoring and debugging, application and update deployment, collections, boundaries and content distribution.Demonstrable mastery of Windows OS deployment imaging and image servicing, WinPE and boot image customization, driver management, USMT, and in-place upgrade at scale.Hands-on Microsoft Intune engineering for Windows: Autopilot provisioning, settings catalog and ADMX-backed policy, compliance policies, platform scripts and proactive remediations, filters and scope tags.Cloud patch and update management with Windows Update for Business ring and deferral design, feature update control, expedited updates, and compliance reporting and familiarity with Windows Autopatch.Cloud application delivery through Intune Win32 apps, including packaging, detection and requirement rules, supersedence, and assignment strategy.Advanced Group Policy engineering: policy architecture, filtering, precedence and conflict resolution, ADMX central store, preferences, and systematic rationalization of legacy policy.Production-grade PowerShell scripting for configuration, automation, detection and remediation, including error handling, logging, code signing and source control.Strong Windows client internals and troubleshooting: registry, services, WMI, event and setup logs, performance analysis, profile and logon behavior.Application packaging across MSI, Win32 and MSIX, including detection logic, transforms and supersedence.Working knowledge of the supporting backend: Active Directory, Entra ID, DNS, DHCP, PKI and certificate autoenrollment, WSUS and update infrastructure, and activation services.Windows security baseline and hardening experience, including BitLocker, application control, ASR and patch compliance management.Enterprise change, incident and problem discipline, high-quality technical documentation, and clear communication to technical and nontechnical audiences.

jobs.description:
OverviewDecisionPoint seeks an Endpoint Engineer to develop, maintain, deploy, and support standardized endpoint capabilities for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

Overview

DecisionPoint seeks an Endpoint Engineer to develop, maintain, deploy, and support standardized endpoint capabilities for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This position supports endpoint images, application packaging, device provisioning, software deployment, patching, configuration baselines, and Virtual Desktop Infrastructure.

The Endpoint Engineer supports physical and virtual endpoints throughout their lifecycle, including testing, deployment, configuration, patching, troubleshooting, refresh, recovery, and retirement. The engineer works with the Senior Endpoint Engineer and other technical teams to deliver secure, consistent, and supportable endpoint services across USMEPCOM Headquarters, MEPS, Remote Processing Substations, COOP locations, and remote-user environments.

This role maintains a clear division of responsibility with Task 6 cybersecurity personnel. Task 6 identifies, prioritizes, and validates security findings. The Endpoint Engineer evaluates assigned findings, tests the approved correction, implements the operational change through established change-control procedures, and provides deployment evidence for cybersecurity validation.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred. Occasional after-hours maintenance, incident response, on-site support, or travel may be required.

 Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Endpoint Engineer will:

- Develop, test, maintain, and document standardized endpoint images.

- Maintain image components, operating-system settings, drivers, firmware dependencies, security baselines, required software, and deployment configurations.

- Support image versioning, testing, approval, release, rollback, and retirement processes.

- Validate endpoint images for functionality, compatibility, security, performance, and operational readiness.

- Develop and maintain automated device-deployment task sequences, provisioning workflows, enrollment processes, and configuration profiles.

- Support endpoint deployment using approved Microsoft and Government management platforms.

- Administer approved endpoint-management capabilities involving Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Configuration Manager, Windows Autopilot, or comparable technologies.

- Develop, test, maintain, and deploy application packages.

- Package commercial, Government, and internally developed software using approved formats and standards.

- Develop installation, detection, dependency, requirement, upgrade, repair, and removal logic.

- Test application packages for silent installation, accurate detection, compatibility, security, and clean removal.

- Troubleshoot package failures, dependency problems, application conflicts, detection errors, and deployment issues.

- Develop approved scripts and automation for provisioning, packaging, configuration, deployment, validation, and remediation.

- Maintain endpoint-management scripts and configurations in approved documentation and version-control repositories.

- Support patching of endpoint operating systems, applications, drivers, firmware, and management components.

- Configure and maintain pilot groups, deployment rings, production waves, maintenance windows, deadlines, and exception processes.

- Test operating-system updates, security patches, vendor patches, and application updates before production deployment.

- Monitor patch and deployment progress, failure rates, compliance status, endpoint health, and approved exceptions.

- Investigate failed patches and coordinate corrective actions, redeployment, rollback, or exception documentation.

- Engineer and support Virtual Desktop Infrastructure capabilities.

- Develop and maintain VDI base images, desktop pools, application delivery, user-profile configurations, and endpoint-access policies.

- Troubleshoot VDI login, profile, application, display, performance, peripheral, and connectivity problems.

- Support VDI refreshes, upgrades, capacity activities, deployment, testing, and optimization.

- Coordinate VDI dependencies with virtualization, storage, network, identity, application, and cybersecurity teams.

- Support endpoint deployment and refresh projects across geographically dispersed USMEPCOM locations.

- Assist with device provisioning, enrollment, configuration, testing, deployment, replacement, recovery, and retirement.

- Support operating-system upgrades, application migrations, technology refreshes, and endpoint-management transitions.

- Provide advanced engineering support for complex endpoint, image, application-packaging, deployment, patching, and VDI incidents.

- Analyze endpoint logs, deployment status, policy results, management-platform data, and other technical evidence.

- Support root-cause analysis and implement approved corrective actions for recurring endpoint incidents.

- Assist with major incidents and outages involving endpoint management, software deployments, VDI, or widespread device failures.

- Implement approved workarounds and restoration actions during endpoint-related incidents.

- Coordinate with the Service Desk and field-support teams to improve troubleshooting, escalation, and knowledge content.

- Develop technical guidance for common endpoint, packaging, deployment, patching, and VDI problems.

- Review cybersecurity findings assigned to endpoint operations by Task 6.

- Assess operational impact, dependencies, testing requirements, deployment approach, and rollback requirements.

- Test and implement approved endpoint security changes through established change and release procedures.

- Execute assigned remediation involving endpoint images, software versions, patches, configurations, policies, or management settings.

- Track the affected endpoint population, deployment status, failures, exceptions, and completion results.

- Provide remediation and completion evidence to Task 6 for validation.

- Coordinate unresolved remediation issues with cybersecurity personnel, vendors, system owners, and Government stakeholders.

- Apply approved endpoint-security baselines and DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides.

- Support endpoint compliance reporting, configuration validation, vulnerability remediation, and audit-evidence collection.

- Maintain endpoint inventories, deployment records, image documentation, software-package records, patch status, VDI records, and configuration baselines.

- Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, packaging instructions, test plans, deployment plans, rollback procedures, and recovery documentation.

- Follow approved incident, problem, change, release, configuration, asset, security, and quality-management processes.

- Provide endpoint health, deployment, patching, compliance, risk, and issue information for program reporting.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must meet all of the following requirements:

- Active Secret clearance or higher.

- Bachelor’s degree in information technology, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience where permitted by the applicable labor category.

- Minimum of six years of relevant experience in endpoint engineering, systems engineering, device management, desktop engineering, VDI engineering, or a related technical discipline.

- Experience developing or maintaining enterprise endpoint images.

- Experience developing, testing, and deploying application packages.

- Experience supporting endpoint provisioning, deployment, patching, configuration, and lifecycle management.

- Experience engineering or supporting Virtual Desktop Infrastructure.

- Experience implementing assigned endpoint-security or vulnerability-remediation changes.

- Experience troubleshooting complex endpoint, packaging, deployment, patching, or VDI issues.

- Knowledge of controlled testing, pilot deployment, phased implementation, validation, rollback, and change-management practices.

- Ability to maintain image documentation, software-package records, test plans, deployment plans, rollback procedures, and completion evidence.

- Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate certification when relevant to the assigned Microsoft 365 or Intune environment.

- Ability to support after-hours maintenance, deployment windows, critical incidents, and endpoint recovery when required.

- Strong written, verbal, analytical, and technical problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

- Experience with Microsoft Intune or Microsoft Endpoint Manager.

- Experience with Microsoft Configuration Manager or System Center Configuration Manager.

- Experience with Windows Autopilot and modern device provisioning.

- Experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

- Experience with Microsoft Entra ID and hybrid endpoint management.

- Experience with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, or comparable endpoint-automation technologies.

- Experience packaging applications using MSI, MSIX, Win32, App-V, or comparable formats.

- Experience with VMware Horizon, Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, Citrix, or another enterprise VDI platform.

- Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense endpoint environments.

- Experience applying DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides to Windows endpoints.

- Experience supporting Risk Management Framework controls, vulnerability remediation, or authorization evidence.

- Experience with endpoint analytics, compliance, configuration-management, or digital employee-experience tools.

- Experience supporting large-scale operating-system migrations, device refreshes, or endpoint-management modernization.

- CompTIA Security+ or another relevant security certification.

- ITIL v4 Foundation certification.

- Relevant Microsoft, VMware, Citrix, cloud, automation, or endpoint-management certification.

Skills and Competencies

- Enterprise endpoint engineering and support.

- Image development and automated deployment.

- Application packaging and software distribution.

- Operating-system and application patch management.

- Endpoint security-baseline implementation.

- VDI configuration, deployment, and troubleshooting.

- PowerShell and endpoint-management automation.

- Complex troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.

- Controlled testing, phased deployment, and rollback execution.

- Cybersecurity remediation and evidence development.

- Technical documentation and configuration management.

- Cross-functional engineering coordination.

- Strong attention to detail and change discipline.

jobs.description:
DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

Our Desktop Systems Engineering team is the front line of support for all users across the firm. We work with a wide range of the best technology available - - and we get to test, configure and deploy it all in an environment that continually challenges us and demands that we learn new things daily. The team is also responsible for driving innovation for technologies that impact users daily. The pace is fast but we also obsess about leaving no stone unturned when there is a problem to be solved. We believe in healthy debate, creative and collaborative problem solving and active knowledge sharing. Strong technical aptitude and a passion for technology are critical for success in the Systems Engineer role but initiative, strong analytics and drive are equally important.

 What you’ll be doing:

- Providing end-user support to employees in the Chicago corporate office and exchange floors

- Building, configuring, and upgrading workstations, laptops, and mobile devices

- Troubleshooting, maintenance, and upgrades of desktop managed servers

- User provisioning (user accounts, mobile devices, VPN, directory permissions)

- Providing support for conference room technologies

- Automation of repetitive system administration tasks

- Evaluating and recommending new hardware and software technologies or solutions

  What we’re looking for in this role:

- 2+ years of MEMCM/SCCM administration experience or similar

- Knowledge of application packaging and management

- Strong experience supporting and configuring Windows 11

- Strong knowledge of Group Policy management

- Powershell experience

- Passionate about technology

- Highly motivated, self-starter who is eager to grow within our organization

- Ability to manage projects independently

- Previous mobile device management experience

  Nice to have:

- Intune management experience

- Previous macOS or Linux support experience

- Previous Windows Server and Active Directory support experience

- Scripting or low-level programming experience

The annual base salary range for this position is $85,000 to $125,000 depending on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant skill set. The position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition, DRW offers a comprehensive suite of employee benefits including group medical, pharmacy, dental and vision insurance, 401k (with discretionary employer match), short and long-term disability, life and AD&D insurance, health savings accounts, and flexible spending accounts.

jobs.description:
Il settore Operazioni ha la responsabilità tecnica della produzione, della realizzazione e dell'archiviazione di tutti i contenuti (televisivi, radiofonici e multimediali) della SSR.

     All'interno della SRG SSR, il Digital Workplace offre ai collaboratori un ambiente di lavoro digitale moderno, sicuro e affidabile. Comprende dispositivi Windows e Apple, servizi Microsoft 365, strumenti di collaborazione e intranet, nonché l'automazione dei processi e alcune soluzioni basate sull'intelligenza artificiale.

     Mansioni Lei è la persona responsabile principale del prodotto Digital Workplace e si occupa dei seguenti ambiti:

      Definizione della visione di prodotto, della roadmap e dell'orientamento strategico.
      Gestione continua e basata sui dati dell'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto: dalla valutazione e sviluppo orientati ai bisogni, fino all'esercizio affidabile ed efficiente, passando per la migrazione o la sostituzione.
      Guida funzionale dei Product Owner e stretta collaborazione con la gestione del personale Operazioni, i Business Partner Operazioni e gli stakeholder rilevanti.
      Pianificazione e controllo delle risorse finanziarie, nonché gestione dei fornitori esterni, dei componenti e dei servizi.
      Implementazione della trasformazione verso un'organizzazione moderna e orientata al prodotto.

     Requisiti

      Competenze metodologiche ed esperienza nel product management agile, dalla pianificazione strategica all'implementazione operativa (ad es. SAFe, Scrum).
      Solide conoscenze tecniche e una visione strategica a 360 gradi del tema Digital Workplace, incluse attività di Endpoint Management (dispositivi, MDM/MAM, packaging) e dei servizi Microsoft 365 (collaborazione, comunicazione, intranet, soluzioni di provisioning, automazione, self‑service e integrazioni IA).
      Forte orientamento verso un'esperienza utente coerente e centrata sui bisogni lungo l'intero Digital Workplace, unito a entusiasmo per l'innovazione digitale e per le tendenze tecnologiche in un contesto in rapida evoluzione.
      Esperienza nel product management inclusa la gestione del budget, il controllo attivo dei costi/qualità tramite KPI e lo svolgimento di analisi costi‑benefici.
      Capacità di orientare il prodotto alla creazione di valore e agli obiettivi strategici e operativi, considerando gli sviluppi del mercato.
      Spiccate capacità di comunicazione e moderazione adeguate agli interlocutori, per gestire gli interessi degli stakeholder, promuovere la collaborazione interdisciplinare e sostenere i team.
      Ottime conoscenze di una lingua nazionale, oltre al tedesco o francese almeno a livello B1, e inglese a livello B1.

      Cosa offriamo Un ruolo di rilevanza nazionale con responsabilità end‑to‑end per un prodotto stimolante.

       Modalità di lavoro agile e orientata al prodotto.
       Collaborazione con team interdisciplinari, motivati e dinamici.

       La invitiamo a inviare i suoi documenti di candidatura (lettera di motivazione e CV) tramite il pulsante « Candidarsi ora ».

jobs.description:
Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey.

We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.

Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.

Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or @contentsquare-ext.com domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.

About the job
You will join the IT System Engineering team within the IT Department, alongside the IT Support and IT Project Management teams. Based in Paris, you will report to the IT System Engineering Manager and contribute to the design, deployment, maintenance, and continuous improvement of Contentsquare’s core IT platforms. This is a full-time, permanent position with no direct reports.
You will work across identity and access management, endpoint and mobile device management, SaaS applications, automation, and AI-enabled IT initiatives. The role is primarily on-site in Paris, with some remote work permitted according to company policy.
What you’ll do
Design, build, deploy, maintain, and continuously improve the core IT platform across identity and access management, endpoint management, enterprise mobility, and cross-functional SaaS applications.
Manage and improve Okta, Jamf, Google Workspace, Slack, Microsoft Intune, macOS, and Windows environments, ensuring secure, reliable, and effective services for employees.
Build and maintain automated workflows using Okta Workflows, Zapier, Workato, or similar platforms to simplify IT processes and improve the employee experience.
Develop, maintain, and improve Bash scripts and other scripts used to automate IT operations, system administration tasks, monitoring, configuration, and user or device lifecycle processes.
Collaborate with the IT Support team on escalated cases and cross-team projects, providing technical expertise across identity, endpoints, access, SaaS applications, and device management.
Lead assigned initiatives autonomously, contribute to project management, provide clear progress updates, and use tools such as Jira to track projects and deliverables.
Use AI tools and set up MCP servers to support automation, IT operations, and the AI at Work initiative.
Outcomes you will work toward
Maintain secure, reliable, and well-managed identity, endpoint, and SaaS environments for Contentsquare employees.
Improve the efficiency, scalability, and consistency of IT operations through automation and scripting.
Resolve escalated cases effectively in collaboration with the IT Support team.
Deliver owned projects and initiatives with clear planning, documentation, stakeholder communication, and follow-through.
Identify and implement practical opportunities to improve security, performance, reliability, and employee experience across the IT platform.
Operational responsibilities
Manage the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of identity, endpoint, MDM, SaaS, and automation platforms.
Develop and maintain Bash scripts and other scripts that reduce manual work and improve consistency across IT operations.
Monitor configurations, deployments, software updates, access, and security controls across managed environments.
Investigate complex technical issues, identify root causes, and implement scalable solutions.
Document systems, workflows, processes, and technical decisions clearly.
Collaborate with IT Support, IT Project Management, and other teams on escalated cases and cross-team projects.
What you’ll need to succeed
Experience in IT systems engineering, endpoint management, identity and access management, or a closely related field.
Proficiency in Okta and a solid understanding of identity and access management concepts.
Hands-on experience with Jamf, Google Workspace, and Slack.
Experience building and maintaining automated workflows with tools such as Okta Workflows, Zapier, Workato, or similar platforms.
Practical knowledge of macOS and Windows environments.
Proficiency in Bash and scripting, with the ability to automate repetitive administration tasks, integrate systems, troubleshoot issues, and maintain clear and reusable scripts.
Proficiency in AI tools for IT operations, automation, or productivity.
Experience setting up MCP servers.
The ability to contribute to project management and take ownership of initiatives.
The ability to work autonomously while collaborating effectively with others.
The ability to provide clear and regular progress updates on owned projects and initiatives.
A proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.
The ability to understand and follow clear guidelines and directions.
Professional fluency in English.
Nice-to-have
Some knowledge of Jira.
Experience with Microsoft Intune.
French language skills.
Experience contributing to internal AI, automation, or digital workplace initiatives.

If you are interested in this role, please send your CV in English.

Why you should join Contentsquare
We invest in our people through career development, mentorship, social events, philanthropic activities, and competitive benefits. We are always assessing the perks we offer to ensure we’re aligned with the employees' needs.

Here are a few we want to highlight:
- Virtual onboarding, Hackathon, and various opportunities to interact with your team and global colleagues both on and offsite each year
- Work flexibility: hybrid and remote work policies
- Generous paid time-off policy (every location is different)
- Lifestyle allowance
- A Culture Crew in every country we’re based in to coordinate regular activities for employees to get to know each other and bond outside of work
- Every full-time employee receives stock options, allowing them to share in the company’s success
- We have multiple Employee Resource Groups, that offer a safe space for individuals who share common identities, life experiences, or allyship to connect, support one another, and passionately advocate for the issues close to their hearts
- And more benefits tailored to each country

The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and administering the Tenable Suite environment, as well as configuring and maintaining them on Linux systems. This role requires a deep understanding of vulnerability management, security protocols, and the Tenable product suite, with a strong focus on Linux-based installation.

• Experience in providing status reports and products to senior management and customers

• Experience with plans, designs, and evaluations of security systems and architectures

Southcentral Foundation’s Endpoint Administrator manages, configures, and supports end-user devices across the organization. The role keeps endpoints secure, compliant, updated, and optimized, and supports device provisioning and endpoint security in collaboration with Information Technology Services teams.

Responsibilities

Southcentral Foundation’s (SCF) Endpoint Administrator position is responsible for the daily management, configuration, and support of end-user devices across the organization
This position will ensure that all endpoints remain secure, compliant, updated, and optimized for employee productivity at SCF
This position will manage and support Windows, macOS, iOT, and mobile devices using Microsoft Intune (MDM/MAM), Jamf Pro, Apple Business Manager (ABM) and/or SCCM/MECM
Deploy software, applications, and security updates to endpoint devices while also monitoring device compliance, health, and security baselines; remediate non-compliant devices
This position is also responsible for the support of provisioning processes such as Windows Autopilot and device enrollment workflows while assisting with endpoint security functions including BitLocker, Defender for Endpoint, and local device hardening in collaboration with Information Technology Services (ITS) teams to improve endpoint reliability and user experience
Skills

High School diploma; OR GED
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field; OR equivalent combination of education and experience; OR demonstrated proficiency as a Service Desk Technician II at SCF
Three (3) years of experience in IT support, desktop administration, or endpoint management roles with management of a Mobile Device Management (MDM) platform
Two (2) years of experience with scripting (PowerShell), software packaging, Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, or other enterprise endpoint management technologies
Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate certification; OR obtain within one (1) year of hire
Company Overview

Southcentral Foundation is a health care system which provides health care and related services to Alaska Native. It was founded in 1982, and is headquartered in Anchorage, Alaska, USA, with a workforce of 1001-5000 employees. Its website is http://www.southcentralfoundation.com/.

jobs.description:
Company Overview At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents.

Company Overview

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

Be part of a team that makes a real difference.

Job Description

 This is a full-time remote position that can be located anywhere in the U.S

We are hiring a Senior Information Systems Engineer to build and support engineering and automation of our End User Computing (EUC) platform. You will manage Windows endpoints through Microsoft Intune, deliver virtual desktops on Amazon Workspaces, and automate the work end to end with scripting, the Microsoft Graph API and Ansible.

This is a hands-on senior role. You will resolve escalated L2/L3 issues, replace manual processes with code, and mentor L1 support staff.

Key responsibilities

Endpoint management (Microsoft Intune)

- Design, build and maintain Intune configuration profiles, compliance policies, app deployments and update rings for Windows devices.

- Automate device, app and policy management through the Microsoft Graph API, including bulk changes, reporting and audit exports.

- Manage Windows Autopilot enrolment and zero-touch provisioning for new and refreshed devices.

- Integrate Intune with Entra ID (Azure AD) Conditional Access, groups and identity lifecycle processes.

Virtual desktops (Amazon Workspaces)

- Build and maintain Amazon Workspaces bundles, custom images and directory integration.

- Automate Workspaces provisioning, patching, rebuilding and decommissioning through the AWS CLI, SDKs or APIs.

- Monitor Workspaces performance, cost and utilization, and right-size running modes and bundles.

- Apply AWS security controls such as IAM, security groups, IP access control groups and encryption.

Automation and configuration management

- Write and maintain scripts in PowerShell, Python and Bash to automate repeatable EUC tasks.

- Develop Ansible playbooks and roles for endpoint and virtual desktop configuration, patching and compliance.

- Store code in Git, follow peer review, and run automation through CI/CD pipelines where suitable.

Operations and support

- Act as the L2/L3 escalation point for complex endpoint, application and virtual desktop incidents.

- Run root-cause analysis on recurring issues and deliver permanent fixes.

- Produce and maintain technical documentation, runbooks and knowledge base articles.

- Mentor L1 engineers and service desk staff and contribute to EUC standards and roadmap.

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.

- 5+ years in IT systems engineering, with at least 3 years focused on End User Computing.

-
 Scripting: strong PowerShell skills, plus working knowledge of Python and/or Bash for automation and API integration.

-
 Microsoft Intune with API: hands-on Intune administration at scale, and proven automation through the Microsoft Graph API (authentication via app registrations, REST calls, paging and throttling).

-
 Ansible Nice to have: experience writing playbooks, roles and inventories to manage Windows

-
 Amazon Workspaces: experience deploying and operating Workspaces, including bundles, custom images, directory services and lifecycle automation.

- Solid grounding in Windows 10/11 and Entra ID / Active Directory, Group Policy and core networking (DNS, DHCP, VPN).

- Experience with Git version control and ITSM tools such as ServiceNow or Jira Service Management.

Preferred qualifications

- Infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.

- Exposure to other VDI/DaaS platforms such as Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365 or Citrix.

- Experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and endpoint security baselines (CIS, Microsoft Security Baselines).

- Packaging experience with Win32 apps, MSIX or PSAppDeployToolkit.

- Relevant certifications, for example: Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102), AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or SysOps Administrator – Associate, and Red Hat Certified Specialist in Ansible Automation (Nice to Have)

Skills and attributes

- An automation-first mindset: you script a task the second time you do it.

- Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical users.

- Structured troubleshooting and calm ownership of high-impact incidents.

- Comfortable working independently and setting technical direction for a small team.

Benefits

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $91,000 - $110,000 annually, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.

 The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and underrepresented minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.summary: **DataSpurs** es *Partner Platinum en España y Portugal de Informatica by SalesForce* . Con un equipo liderado por personas con una dilatada trayectoria reconocida dentro del sector, como compañía se centra en su único ámbito de actuación en el que es...
jobs.description:
**DataSpurs** es *Partner Platinum en España y Portugal de Informatica by SalesForce* . Con un equipo liderado por personas con una dilatada trayectoria reconocida dentro del sector, como compañía se centra en su único ámbito de actuación en el que es especialista: ***Data*** . En DataSpurs defendemos una ***alta especialización*** para la definición, desarrollo e implantación de soluciones en el ámbito de *Big Data, Data Governance y Cloud Data Management*, especialmente con productos de la Plataforma Informatica IDMC.

Nuestro modelo de negocio está centrado en la realización de acciones puramente de *consultoría estratégica* en *cliente final*; nuestro crecimiento no viene determinado por la asignación de consultores a clientes, sino por la incorporación de personas a un equipo interno que contribuyan a desarrollar conocimiento y soluciones que posteriormente serán implantadas en cliente para dar respuesta a esas acciones de consultoría estratégica.

Debido al proceso de desarrollo interno que *DataSpurs* está atravesando, en la actualidad queremos ampliar el equipo dentro del áreade consultoría con perfiles de **CONSULTOR** para iniciativas de **Master Data Management (MDM)** . Incorporando a una persona con amplia trayectoria técnica para nuestra oficina de **MADRID** en un modelo de trabajo principalmente en remoto.

**FUNCIONES**:

Participará activamente en la puesta en marcha de iniciativas de MDM multidominio en entornos Cloud o híbridos, contribuyendo en la definición de la estrategia y enfoque más adecuado en función de las distintas casuísticas planteadas ya sea en el ámbito técnico y/o funcional. Contribuirá al diseño de soluciones realizando, entre otras funciones:

* definición e implementación del *framework* de MDM para garantizar una única fuente de verdad (*single source of truth*) en los datos más críticos de la organización
* consolidación e integración de datos maestros provenientes de múltiples sistemas origen (ERP, CRM, *eCommerce* , etc.) con diferentes patrones de ingesta (*batch, realtime, cdc*...)
* diseño y creación de reglas de calidad, limpieza y duplicación de registros inconsistentes o duplicados
* definición de políticas de gobierno de datos y flujos de trabajo (*workflows*) para establecer reglas claras sobre la creación, modificación y mantenimiento de datos maestros
* definición de las reglas de *match, merge, survivorship* para la generación del*golden record*
* modelado de datos maestros y diseño de arquitecturas para la distribución de la versión correcta de los datos a todos los sistemas consumidores
* gestión de requerimientos con el cliente y colaboración estrecha con otros miembros del equipo

**REQUISITOS**:

* experiencia previa de 3 años en proyectos de gestión de datos, idealmente enfocados en Master Data Management (MDM)
* conocimientos sólidos de:
* modelado de datos (modelos relacionales) y lenguaje SQL
* arquitecturas de datos y flujos de integración
* aspectos funcionales en los distintos procesos de negocio involucrados en la gestión de datos maestros (clientes, proveedores, productos)
* definición de reglas: calidad y aplicabilidad de las reglas de calidad propuestas
* experiencia real y demostrable con herramientas líderes de mercado, con especial interés en Informatica MDM (MDM cloud / IDMC), o soluciones similares como *SAP Master Data Governance, IBM Master Data Management, Stibo Systems o Semarchy*
* alta capacidad de interlocución con los diferentes *stakholders* implicados
* capacidad para trabajar en entornos ágiles y colaborativos
* perfil analítico, orientado a la calidad y resolución de problemas

**IMPORTANTE**:

* CERTIFICACIONES: debido al nivel de *partnership* que mantenemos y el *expertise* ofrecido, se mantiene un programa de certificaciones muy activo ayudando al equipo a obtener las certificaciones necesarias

**¿POR QUÉ DATASPURS?:**

* Visión a largo plazo: incorporarmos profesionales para que crezcan con nosotros en nuestras disciplinas clave, más allá de contrataciones para proyectos concretos
* proyectos tecnológicamente punteros y de alta especialización en el área de Data Management
* trabajo principalmente en remoto y flexibilidad horaria
* programa de inglés individualizado y 100% financiado por la compañía
* entorno de trabajo con calidad y calidez, en contenido y forma
* retribución flexible (cheques restaurant, seguro médico, cheque guardería)
* desarrollo profesional personalizado, considerando los intereses y motivaciones de cada persona
* ambiente de trabajo: informal a la vez que altamente profesional y competente

*DATASPURS está comprometida con la diversidad, la inclusión y la igualdad de trato, promoviendo una política transparente de atracción, selección y contratación que garantice la igualdad de oportunidades a todos los candidat@s, sin hacer ninguna exclusión por motivos de sexo, edad, raza u otra condición no relacionada con el buen desempeño del puesto que se desea cubrir.*
