jobs.description:
Position Overview:

We are looking for a dedicated Endpoint Engineer to join our client's technology team as an embedded, full-time engineering resource. This role was created to relieve an endpoint team operating at full capacity and to drive platform optimization, automation, and documentation modernization across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:

* Endpoint Architecture \& Platform Engineering Focus : **Endpoint Architecture is a critical component of this role and extends beyond day-to-day endpoint administration and troubleshooting.** The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, standardizing, and optimizing the organization's endpoint management ecosystem, ensuring scalability, security, automation, and operational efficiency across both Microsoft and Apple environments
* Endpoint Device Management: Administer and optimize Intune (Microsoft) and Kandji (Apple) across the full device fleet
* Microsoft 365 Optimization: Manage and optimize the M365 environment including licensing, policies, and platform governance
* Collaboration Platform Administration: Administer Box, Slack, and Zoom environments
* Automation \& Tooling: Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts and automation initiatives to reduce manual workload
* Documentation: Create and maintain runbooks, standard operating procedures, and architecture documentation; close gaps left by legacy Managed Service Provider environments
* Platform Governance: Mature operational processes and platform governance
* After-Hours Support: Participate in after-hours, weekend, and holiday coverage rotation to reduce burden on internal engineers
* Onboarding \& Standards: Establish and enforce endpoint build standards and configuration baselines

Required Skills and Qualifications:

* Minimum 7 years of practical, hands-on experience supporting and administering enterprise endpoints, including endpoint management, desktop engineering, technical support, device provisioning, software deployment, patch management, and workplace technology services
* Proven hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune and -preferably- Kandji MDM platforms
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft 365 administration and optimization
* Working knowledge in Cisco Meraki and foundational networking concepts
* Experience with collaboration tools: Box, Slack, Zoom, Jira
* Proficiency in PowerShell scripting and automation
* Experience creating technical documentation and runbooks
* Ability to work independently as an embedded team member
* Strong communication skills in English (written and verbal)
* Ability to travel to the United States approximately 10% of the time
* Knowledge of AI capabilities and practical business applications is a plus

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

 About the Role

We are seeking a dedicated IT professional to join our San Mateo team. The ideal candidate will provide technical and operational support to employees in the San Mateo office while working with our HQ IT team to maintain high standards across the company. This role requires strong technical skills, a customer-centric approach and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment solving both technical and operational challenges.

The IT team is dedicated to delivering excellent customer service and helping our company grow. Our goal is to make work easier and more efficient for everyone by fixing problems, improving processes, and supporting the business with all its IT needs.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires that you be on-site at our HQ in San Mateo, CA 5 days a week.

 What You’ll Do

The ideal candidate should have both technical and operational experience, supporting a regional and diverse team in an IT support role. They should understand the daily aspects of IT operations in a fast-growing and dynamic company.

- Provide high level end user support

- Troubleshoot IT-related issues, including:

  - Hardware

  - Systems

  - Networking

  - Audio & Video

  - Asset Management

- Administer a wide variety of SaaS applications , including provisioning, modifying, and removing access.

- Partner with business units and collaborate on IT-related projects.

- Communicate effectively across all levels of the organization.

- Support a global workforce by partnering with overseas team members, employees, and consultants

- Analyze existing IT processes, suggest improvements, and implement business processes where needed

- Take on responsibilities beyond this job description as the company grows

 What You’ll Bring

- Prior IT/helpdesk/customer service experience

- A 5-star customer service mindset

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

- Strong teamwork and collaboration skills

- Familiarity with macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android devices

- Ability to administer Google Workspace (G-Suite)

- Experience working with SSO platforms (Okta, OneLogin, etc.)

- Capability to manage AV hardware and software , including Zoom and other video conferencing tools

- Familiarity with our technology stack including:

  - Jira, Okta, Slack, Salesforce, Zoom & Zoom Rooms, Kandji, VoIP telephony, among others

- Flexible work schedule — mornings, nights, and unexpected calls/messages may be required to ensure coverage

 US Employee Benefits

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

- Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans

- Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage

- Starting January 2027, Verkada will match a portion of an employee’s 401(k) contributions based on eligible earnings. Match vests on 2 year anniversary

- Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options

- Expanded mental health support

- Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits

- Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time

- Professional development stipend

- Wellness/fitness benefits

- Healthy lunches provided daily

- Commuter benefits

 Additional Information

- You must be independently authorized to work in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role, at this time.

   Annual Pay Range

At Verkada, we want to attract and retain the best employees, and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate's skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. A Verkada employee may be eligible for additional forms of compensation, depending on their role, including sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and/or equity in the company in the form of restricted stock units (RSUs)

Satellite, internal patch and software repositories, and the NEST-managed Linux Unified Key Setup (LUKS) disk encryption system.Manage software licensing and registration for NEST-supported RHEL Level Agreements (SLAs) for incident resolution, request fulfillment, and service availability.Provide regular written and verbal status updates on operational activities, system performance, deployment progress, and technical issues.

U.S. Citizenship is required.Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust.

ITIL Foundation certificationA current certification in a relevant field or technology.

jobs.description:
ABSOLUTELY NO H1S OR 3RD PARTIES.

THIS ROLE WILL BE ONSITE 4 DAYS PER WEEK DURING TRAINING, THEN 3 DAYS PER WEEK AFTER THAT.

Fast-paced internet client seeks an Associate Systems Engineer to help provide a

  great technical experience for all of our employees. As an Associate Systems Engineer, you will be

  responsible for providing excellent customer service and day to day technical support for all aspects of

  our corporate technology portfolio. This includes troubleshooting hardware and software issues related to

  local machines, network connectivity, SaaS apps, workstation VM’s, Google Workspace, Slack, etc. You

  will perform the technical onboarding for new employees and have a large contribution to team project

  work.

  What we are looking for:

  We are looking for technical individuals who are motivated, self-starters and always eager to help while

  providing excellent customer service to our users. You’ll need to be a team player with excellent attention

  to detail and communication skills as we work together to solve daily challenges.

  What You’ll Do:

  - Provide responsive, high-quality technical support for hardware, software, connectivity and

  access issues across the corporate environment.

  - Troubleshoot routine and moderately complex issues, documenting investigation steps and

  escalating issues that require additional expertise or access.

  - Perform technical onboarding for new employees, including hardware preparation, software

  installation, account & application readiness and delivery of a consistent first-day experience.

  - Support user offboarding by following established procedures for account and access

  deprovisioning, equipment recovery, application & device cleanup and inventory updates.

  - Hardware deployment, software installation, maintenance of user workstations (including macOS

  & Windows) and mobile devices (including iOS & Android).

  - Track technology assets and maintain accurate inventory records throughout the hardware

  lifecycle.

  - Communicate highly technical information to both technical and non-technical personnel.

  - Update and maintain computer management policies in Jamf/Workspace One.

  - Discover and deploy ways to improve processes, workflows and automation of current tasks.

  - Deploy and decommission user workstation VM’s.

  - Google Workstation and Okta end user support.

  - Recommend new software and hardware solutions as needed.

  - Inform team members and org users on new processes and technologies.

  What You’ll Need:

  - The ability to work a hybrid schedule 3 days a week (4 days a week during training period).

  - Up to 4 years of experience in end user IT.

  - User admin level experience with Okta, Google Workspace & Slack.

  - Basic understanding of SaaS.

  - Good documentation and communication skills via Email, Tickets and Office Communications

  both over Slack and in-person.

  - Attention to detail and ability to follow directions.

  - Team focused, customer service mentality with a resourceful nature that can dig to solve

  problems.

  - OS Experience: MacOS, Windows 11, iOS, Android.

  - Software Skills: Atlassian Suite, Cloudflare, JAMF, Workspace One, Zoom, and Windows Active

  Directory.

  Things that will help:

  - Experience with Jira Service Desk.

  - Working knowledge of Notion, Claude & Glean.

  - Training or certifications: Microsoft operating systems, A+ certification, MacOS support training.

  - Experience working projects

Pay: $45.00 - $50.00 per hour

Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10014

jobs.description:
Description

 The NASA IT portfolio within the Digital sector at Leidos currently has an opening for a Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) Endpoint Administrator. This is a telework position, but applicants must reside within reasonable commute distance from a NASA operating center and have flexibility to go on-site when needed for specific activities. This is an exciting opportunity to use your experience supporting the NASA End-user Services and Technologies (NEST) mission. In this mission, we serve as an agile, trusted partner to transform, integrate, simplify, modernize, and safeguard NASA IT systems and data. And, above all else, continuously enhance the end-user experience.

Note:

This position is remote; however, candidates must reside within 50 miles of a NASA facility or within a reasonable commuting distance, as the customer may require onsite support at any time based on program needs.

Ames Research Center: Mountain View, CA
Armstrong Flight Research Center: Edwards, CA
Glenn Research Center: Cleveland, OH
Goddard Space Flight Center: Greenbelt, MDNASA Headquarters: Washington, DC
Johnson Space Center: Houston, TX
Kennedy Space Center: Merritt Island, FL
Langley Research Center: Hampton, VA
Marshall Space Flight Center: Huntsville, AL
Stennis Space Center: Bay St. Louis, MS
Wallops Flight Facility, Wallops Island, VA
White Sands Complex: Las Cruces, NM
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

This role provides tier 3 support and management of Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) workstations on the NEST contract. RHEL server administration is not a part of this role, except for RHEL servers used to manage RHEL workstations.

Create, maintain, test, and deploy software packages for Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) client applications, including managing application configurations and software lifecycle requirements.Develop and maintain automation scripts using RHEL-supported languages, including Bash, Python, and YAML, to streamline application installations, system configurations, and software deployments.Build, test, deploy, and maintain RHEL operating system images, ensuring compatibility with NEST-supported hardware and compliance with required applications, drivers, security patches, software versions, and system configurations.Develop and execute test plans for client applications, new endpoint hardware, operating system deployments, and software updates.Utilize and maintain endpoint management tools, including Red Hat Satellite and HCL BigFix, to deploy applications and updates, monitor deployment status, and maintain software inventory across RHEL clients.Manage operating system and software patching activities, including packaging, testing, deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting to ensure NEST-managed RHEL endpoints remain current and compliant.Monitor and maintain Red Hat Satellite, internal patch and software repositories, and the NEST-managed Linux Unified Key Setup (LUKS) disk encryption system.Manage software licensing and registration for NEST-supported RHEL clients and Red Hat Satellite servers, ensuring compliance with applicable licensing requirements.Provide Tier 3 technical support for complex RHEL operating system, application, and endpoint management issues, including installation failures, patching errors, and system configuration problems.Collaborate with vendors to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, monitor product roadmaps, and implement approved product changes and enhancements.Develop and maintain technical documentation, including software packaging procedures, as-built configurations, testing results, knowledge articles, and operational processes.Provide technical guidance and process training to NEST Tier 2 technicians, end users, and other relevant stakeholders.Participate in cross-functional project teams to implement new services and service enhancements aligned with the NEST innovation roadmap.Resolve incidents and fulfill service requests in accordance with established program processes and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for incident resolution, request fulfillment, and service availability.Provide regular written and verbal status updates on operational activities, system performance, deployment progress, and technical issues.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

High school diploma or equivalent and 6+ years of relevant experience.Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to audiences with varying levels of technical expertise.Experience administering and managing Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) operating systems and software.Experience creating, maintaining, and deploying RHEL operating system images and software packages.Experience administering and supporting Linux Unified Key Setup (LUKS) disk encryption.Experience using HCL BigFix to deploy Linux software updates and security patches.Experience developing scripts to automate Linux system management tasks.Ability to work effectively in a remote environment while maintaining strong communication and collaboration with peers, leadership, customers, vendors, and project stakeholders.Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote workspace conducive to complex technical assignments and virtual meetings.Must reside within a reasonable commuting distance of a NASA operating center and be available to provide onsite support as required.
CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:

U.S. Citizenship is required.Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

ITIL Foundation certificationA current certification in a relevant field or technology.

jobs.description:
INFRASTRUCTURE ENGINEER (STARLINK)

Starlink is the world's largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We've only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink's potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help develop the systems that enable providing service in new markets and even greater system performance and growth potential.

As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will engage in hardware design initiatives, travel to develop antenna infrastructure build-out plans with international partners, and own global antenna site roll-out plans that support Starlink system-level performance and growth goals. Expect broad scope, diverse engineering challenges, and a great adventure - one day you could be designing a new way to mount an antenna to a roof, and the next day traveling to a new country to develop a solution to power and connect the sites you're responsible for activating there.

We are looking for people who excel at solving complex problems, managing large projects, are ready to learn new things, and want to work in a dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative environment to engineer solutions with real global impact.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Design antenna sites and site hardware to support, connect, and power the antennas all over the world that backhaul the Starlink network
Travel abroad to create infrastructure development plans with international partners to establish antenna sites that maximize the Starlink constellation effectivity and expand customer access
Develop new processes and methods that enable rapid deployment of antennas
Engage cross-functionally to align technical roadmaps with other contributors to Starlink, like business growth, regulatory, or network engineering teams
Review antenna site reliability over time to develop robust solutions that ensure overall system health
Demonstrate extreme ownership of product and business outcomes at every stage of conceptualization and implementation BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelor's degree in engineering or science discipline1+ years of professional experience in an engineering rolePREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience with electrical, mechanical, or structural design and analysis
Experience with build, production, or integration of components into an assembly, structure, vehicle, or site
Demonstrated success in multidisciplinary project execution
Experience with any of the following is a bonus:Producing construction drawings or plansSQL, Matlab, Python, C++, or similar
Producing dashboards or analytical and statistical models (Ex: Tableau, PowerBI)
Physical network infrastructure design or planningADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

Willingness to travel to domestic and international ground station sites
Must be willing to work long hours and occasional weekends when necessary to support launch and critical project timelinesCOMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $105,000.00 - $122,500.00
Level 2: $120,000.00 - $150,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

Why You’ll Love This Role

We are seeking a talented and experienced Sr Information Systems Engineer to join Cribl 's IT Engineering team. In this role, you will be the technical owner of the core systems that power how Cribl operates every day — from identity and access to endpoints, cloud infrastructure, and the automations that tie it all together. This is a high-impact, high-ownership role on a team that treats reliability, security, and employee experience as equally important outcomes.

You'll partner closely with Security, Enterprise Applications, and People teams to design and run the services Cribl depends on at scale: Okta, AWS, ServiceNow, MDM, and a growing stack of SaaS integrations and AI-powered workflows. Whether you're building joiner/mover/leaver automations, hardening endpoint baselines, or governing the next generation of MCP-connected AI tools, your work will be foundational to how a fast-moving, remote-first company stays secure and operational.

This role reports to IT Engineering leadership and will serve as a senior peer and escalation point across the IT & Security organization.

As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

As the Sr Information Systems Engineer, you will be the technical owner of Cribl 's core corporate systems — keeping identity, endpoints, cloud infrastructure, and IT automation healthy, secure, and scalable. Your key responsibilities will include:

-
 Identity, Access & Lifecycle: Own administration of our primary identity provider (Okta or equivalent) and design joiner/mover/leaver automations (e.g., Workday → Okta → SaaS) with a focus on least privilege, auditability, and contractor and elevated-access workflows.

-
 AWS, Cloud & Core Infrastructure: Administer AWS accounts used for corporate IT, VPN, and supporting infrastructure, including secure networking patterns, logging, monitoring, and alerting across IT-owned cloud resources.

-
 Endpoint Management & MDM: Own endpoint management for macOS and Windows via MDM (e.g., Jamf, Intune), including zero-touch provisioning, patch management, security baselines, and compliance reporting for the fleet.

-
 ServiceNow & IT Service Management: Serve as primary ServiceNow administrator for IT & Security — core data model, catalog, workflows, SLAs, and integrations — and partner with Security, Finance, and Compliance to support ITGC, SOX/IT controls, access reviews, and change management.

-
 Automation, Integrations & Tooling: Design and maintain automation workflows across IT systems (e.g., Okta Workflows, Serval, Zapier, PowerShell/Python, APIs) and serve as SME for SaaS integrations across Okta, ServiceNow, Google Workspace, Slack, and Azure/AWS.

-
 AI Tools & MCP Governance: Evaluate, configure, and govern AI tools and MCP-based agent frameworks in partnership with IT and Security, ensuring safe usage patterns, appropriate access controls, and clear documentation and runbooks.

-
 Operations, Support & On-Call: Serve as Tier 3 escalation for complex incidents across identity, MDM, ServiceNow, and core platforms; participate in the IT on-call rotation; and contribute to IT metrics, fleet reporting, and knowledge base content.

We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones - you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours.

If You’ve Got It - We Want It

-
 Corporate IT Systems Experience: 5+ years in corporate IT roles with significant responsibility for systems administration across identity, SaaS, and/or infrastructure in a cloud-first environment, with a proven track record balancing project work and operational/on-call responsibilities.

-
 AWS Administration (Required): Hands-on, production experience with AWS (IAM, VPCs, EC2/ECS or similar, basic networking, tagging/governance) supporting internal IT or SaaS platforms.

-
 ServiceNow Administration: Hands-on administration of ServiceNow or a similar enterprise ITSM platform, including workflow configuration, catalog items, change/incident processes, and basic reporting.

-
 Enterprise Identity Provider Experience: Direct, production experience with at least one enterprise identity provider — Okta strongly preferred; Azure AD/Entra ID or similar acceptable — including SSO, lifecycle management, and access policies.

-
 Endpoint Management Ownership: Demonstrated ownership of macOS and/or Windows endpoint management in a mid-to-large fleet, including baseline configs, software distribution, and patch management.

-
 Scripting & Automation: Experience with at least one scripting language (Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar) and comfort working with REST APIs and JSON.

-
 Remote-First Operator: Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-moving, distributed environment — you manage your own priorities, communicate proactively, and know when to escalate.

-
 Preferred Qualifications

  - Experience with Jamf (macOS), Intune (Windows/mobile), and/or device posture tooling such as Kolide or similar.

  - Experience managing core SaaS tools such as Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Atlassian, or Glean.

  - Background designing or maintaining automations with tools like Serval, Zapier, or equivalent orchestration platforms.

  - Experience evaluating, configuring, and governing AI tools and agents (e.g., Claude, Gemini, Glean) and MCP-based agent frameworks in an enterprise environment.

  - Working knowledge of Azure (subscriptions, RBAC, group-based access) and/or other major cloud providers alongside AWS.

  - Prior experience supporting a rapidly scaling, distributed engineering organization.

The salary for this role is dependent on geographic location and will be based on the individual candidate's job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.

In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.

Base Salary Range

$99,000—$156,000 USD

 Bring Your Whole Self
Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We’re building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

 Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.

 The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.

Pay and Benefits:

 Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
 Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
 Pension / Retirement benefits
 Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
 DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact you will have in this role:

 Being a member of IT Cybersecurity & Platform Strategy team, the Cyber Security Endpoint Security Engineer will support the design, deployment, operation, and maintenance of Endpoint Security solutions within DTCC's Cybersecurity Infrastructure. This role is ideal for someone passionate about cybersecurity and eager to contribute to minimizing risks and strengthening the security posture of DTCC's digital assets (workstations, servers, etc.).

Your Primary Responsibilities:

 Assist in deploying and maintaining advanced Endpoint Security solutions, including CrowdStrike, Sky High Web Gateways, and other ICAP scanning tools.
 Design, deploy, and operate the CrowdStrike Falcon ecosystem (EDR, NGAV, Firewall, Identity Protection, Falcon for Mobile), ensuring full endpoint coverage, policy consistency, and sensor health across endpoints, servers, VDI, and eligible mobile devices
 Plan and execute upgrades, migrations, and decommissioning initiatives (e.g., legacy proxy/DLP tools to modern Zscaler or CrowdStrike capabilities), ensuring production stability and minimal user impact
 Monitor and troubleshoot technical issues related to endpoint protection tools and calls out sophisticated problems as needed.
 Operate and maintain Symantec DLP Prevent infrastructure (endpoint, web, and inline), including policy enforcement, upgrades, health checks, and coordination with identity and email/web channels
 Collaborate with senior engineers and multi-functional teams to implement security improvements and ensure alignment with organizational standards.
 Ensure high-fidelity telemetry flows from CrowdStrike, Skyhigh, Zscaler, and Symantec into SIEM/SOAR platforms, supporting detection correlation, incident response, and audit evidence requirements
 Support the execution of the endpoint security roadmap and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
 Participate in the evaluation of new technologies and provide recommendations on solution design and implementation.
 Ensure malware detection coverage across CrowdStrike EDR Agent-capable devices.
 Find opportunities for automation and assist in implementing automation within Endpoint Security operations.
 Maintain documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing across the team.

**NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above. **

Qualifications:

 Minimum of 4 years of related experience
 Bachelor's degree preferred and/or equivalent experienc

Talents Needed for Success:

 Strong hands-on expertise with CrowdStrike Falcon modules (EDR, NGAV, Firewall, Identity Protection) including sensor lifecycle management, policy tuning, detection analysis, and exception handling
 Strong knowledge of Windows, macOS, Linux, endpoint networking, TLS flows, proxy behavior, and how security controls interact across endpoint, network, and cloud layers
 Familiarity with cybersecurity controls for SaaS solutions, Entra ID, and AWS/Azure environments.
 Deep critical-thinking skills to analyze detections, diagnose complex endpoint issues, distinguish real threats from false positives, and drive root-cause resolution under pressure.
 Ability to identify repeatable operational work and drive automation using scripting, APIs, workflows, and infrastructure-as-code concepts to improve consistency, auditability, and scale
 Experience with endpoint firewall products and basic network security principles.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
 Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 Industry certifications such CISSP or other cybersecurity domain coverage are preferred

About Us

With over 50 years of experience, DTCC is the premier post-trade market infrastructure for the global financial services industry. From 20 locations around the world, DTCC, through its subsidiaries, automates, centralizes, and standardizes the processing of financial transactions, mitigating risk, increasing transparency, enhancing performance and driving efficiency for thousands of broker/dealers, custodian banks and asset managers. Industry owned and governed, the firm innovates purposefully, simplifying the complexities of clearing, settlement, asset servicing, transaction processing, trade reporting and data services across asset classes, bringing enhanced resilience and soundness to existing financial markets while advancing the digital asset ecosystem. In 2024, DTCC's subsidiaries processed securities transactions valued at U.S. $3.7 quadrillion and its depository subsidiary provided custody and asset servicing for securities issues from over 150 countries and territories valued at U.S. $99 trillion. DTCC's Global Trade Repository service, through locally registered, licensed, or approved trade repositories, processes more than 25 billion messages annually. To learn more, please visit us at www.dtcc.com or connect with us on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Facebook and Instagram.

DTCC proudly supports Flexible Work Arrangements favoring openness and gives people freedom to do their jobs well, by encouraging diverse opinions and emphasizing teamwork. When you join our team, you'll have an opportunity to make meaningful contributions at a company that is recognized as a thought leader in both the financial services and technology industries. A DTCC career is more than a good way to earn a living. It's the chance to make a difference at a company that's truly one of a kind.

Experiencia en entornos corporativos multi-país o empresas del sector industrial / manufacturero.Experiencia en proyectos de arquitectura híbrida On-Premise + Cloud.Conocimiento de otras plataformas Cloud como GCP, Azure u otras.Experiencia implementando MDM en organizaciones con múltiples países, empresas o ERPs.Experiencia en arquitecturas orientadas a integración de múltiples sistemas legacy.Experiencia diseñando frameworks o motores MDM reutilizables y parametrizables.Experiencia liderando técnicamente o realizando coaching a equipos de Data Engineering.Experiencia diseñando Semantic Layers o plataformas de Self-Service Analytics.Familiaridad con arquitecturas orientadas a AI/ML, Generative AI o Agentic AI.

Senior Systems Engineer / Solutions Architect (Remote) Why Digacore?

Senior Systems Engineer / Solutions Architect (Remote)

Why Digacore ?

We’re a fast-paced, people-first MSP with:

- Real career growth

- A collaborative culture (we back each other up, no egos)

About the Role:

Are you the go-to engineer who handles the toughest issues and loves designing smarter infrastructure? We’re looking for a senior-level engineer with a builder’s mindset — someone ready to design cloud-first environments and lead escalations while working directly with clients to create solutions that best fit their needs. This role combines high-level systems engineering with solution architecture. You’ll handle critical escalations, run client assessments, and architect end-to-end solutions — particularly around Azure, networking, server building and advanced troubleshooting.

What You’ll Do:

- Lead technical assessments and translate business needs into secure, scalable infrastructure designs.

- Design and implement solutions in Azure, Microsoft 365, and Intune/Endpoint Manager, including Autopilot deployments, compliance/conditional access policies, and application packaging.

- Advanced networking – redesign and optimize networks (firewalls, switching, routing, VLANs) for performance, security, and cost efficiency.

- Comfortable using the CLI for common network tasks.

- Experience troubleshooting loops, configuring switches, and supporting HP/Dell switch environments and SonicWall/Fortinet firewalls.

- Support and administer Microsoft’s core stack: Windows Server roles, Office 365, Azure services.

- Build and harden servers/workstations to ensure reliability, security, and lifecycle longevity.

- Create accurate, detailed SOWs and scopes that define deliverables, timelines, and technical requirements.

- Own and resolve complex Level 3+ escalations — performing deep-dive troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and long-term remediation.

- Deliver clean, repeatable documentation for architectures, deployments, and operational processes.

- Mentor junior and mid-level techs and elevate team-wide technical capability.

- Partner with sales department by reviewing proposals, validating technical scope, and identifying potential pitfalls.

- Coordinate account managers, PMs, and clients to ensure clear communication and smooth project execution.

- Help drive best practices in cloud security, automation, monitoring, and MSP tooling — always bringing a figure-it-out and outside-the-box problem-solving mindset.

What you Bring:

- 5+ years in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) or high-volume IT support environment

- Strong experience with:

  - Windows Server (2016/2019/2022), Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS

  - Microsoft 365 administration and security

  - Azure infrastructure and virtual networks (AZ-104 or higher preferred)

  - Virtualization tools: VMware, Hyper-V, AVD

  - Networking: Layer 2/3, VPNs, firewalls (SonicWall, Meraki, etc.)

  - Scripting & automation (PowerShell preferred)

  - Strong documentation habits and familiarity with ConnectWise

- Confident communication with the ability to explain solutions to non-technical users

- Bonus if you have: AZ-305, CCNA/CCNP, or any cybersecurity-related certs

Perks & Benefits

- Nationwide medical, dental, life, and LTD insurance (we cover LTD + life 100%)

- Generous PTO + Mental Health Days

- 401(k) with company match

- HSA & FSA options

- Paid training & certification assistance

- $500 sign-on bonus

- Quarterly team events and career coaching

- Equal opportunity employer — veterans encouraged to apply

jobs.description:
Company Overview:Arctiq is a global, intelligence-driven technology services company delivering professional and managed services across Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, Networking & Connected Experiences, Cybersecurity, Data & AI, Autonomous Operations & Intelligence, and Enterprise Service Management.

Company Overview:

 Arctiq is a global, intelligence-driven technology services company delivering professional and managed services across Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, Networking & Connected Experiences, Cybersecurity, Data & AI, Autonomous Operations & Intelligence, and Enterprise Service Management. We help organizations operate, secure, and modernize complex environments by unifying infrastructure, networking, data, security, automation, and observability under a single, integrated operating model. Our work focuses on helping customers reduce operational friction, improve resilience, and make better, faster decisions as their environments evolve. Arctiq builds on decades of industry expertise and a customer-centric ethos to deliver exceptional value to clients across diverse industries.

Position Overview:

The Senior Project Consultant – Modern Work & Endpoint delivers Microsoft 365, Intune, and Purview projects for mid-market and enterprise clients in Arctiq 's Microsoft practice. The role is hands-on and customer-facing: you assess the current state, write the design, get the customer's sign-off, and then build and hand over endpoint management, information protection, and Microsoft 365 workloads across cloud and hybrid environments.

You will be the practice's second deep resource on Intune and Purview, working alongside senior consultants who cover Active Directory, Exchange, and tenant migrations. Most engagements are delivered remotely, with occasional travel for kickoffs, critical milestones, or customer workshop

Responsibilities:

- Lead the assessment and design phase of each engagement, produce the design document, and obtain customer sign-off before build or cutover

- Design and implement Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot: enrollment, configuration and compliance policies, application deployment, update rings, and migration from Group Policy or Configuration Manager

- Implement Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels, data loss prevention, and retention, and prepare tenants for Microsoft 365 Copilot (oversharing and access review, licensing prerequisites, pilot design)

- Configure the Microsoft 365 security baseline: Entra ID Conditional Access and MFA, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365, and Secure Score improvements

- Deliver projects to the approved Statement of Work; identify scope changes early and support the change-order process with the Project Manager

- Estimate level of effort and review proposed scope for Modern Work opportunities so that what Arctiq sells is what it can deliver

- Produce assessment reports, designs, runbooks, and as-built documentation the customer can operate from; mentor other consultants on endpoint management and Purview

- Report status to the Project Manager and practice leadership; enter time, expenses, and project activities accurately and on time

Required Qualifications:

- 6+ years delivering Microsoft 365 and endpoint management solutions, including 3+ years in a consulting or professional-services role

- At least one current certification: Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102), Microsoft Certified: Information Security Administrator Associate (SC-401), or Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS-102)

- Led an Intune and Autopilot deployment of 500+ devices, including at least one Group Policy or Configuration Manager to Intune migration

- Implemented Microsoft Purview (labels, DLP, retention) for a regulated or multi-entity customer

- Rolled out Entra ID Conditional Access and MFA in production tenants, including hybrid-joined devices

- Microsoft 365 licensing knowledge (E3, E5, F1 and F3, Business plans, add-ons) and experience with license reviews or renewal planning

- PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automation for tenant and endpoint administration

- Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders; design documents that customers signed off on

Preferred Qualifications

- Azure fundamentals applied to Microsoft 365 and endpoint work: virtual networks, VPN and ExpressRoute connectivity, network security groups, and Azure Virtual Desktop or Windows 365 (AZ-104, AZ-700, or AZ-140)

- macOS, iOS, and Android management in Intune, including Apple Business Manager

- Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 migrations

- Microsoft 365 Copilot pilots or readiness assessments, and Microsoft Copilot or AI credentials

- SC-300 Identity and Access Administrator or SC-100 Cybersecurity Architect

- Experience in a Microsoft partner, Microsoft Consulting Services, or FastTrack delivery role

 Arctiq is an equal opportunity employer. If you need any accommodations or adjustments throughout the interview process and beyond, please let us know. We celebrate our inclusive work environment and welcome members of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply.

 We thank you for your interest in joining the Arctiq team! While we welcome all applicants, only those who are selected for an interview will be contacted.

**Data Engineer (MDM + AWS)**

**Location: Brazil - 100% Remote**

**Duration: 3+ month Contract - Likely extension**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Elios is hiring a Data Engineer in Brazil for a data governance and Master Data Management (MDM) engagement with one of our clients. You will work alongside a Business Strategist to understand how product and master data moves across the client's systems, find the gaps, and recommend the architecture and roadmap to fix them.

This phase is discovery and design, not implementation. You will lead the technical side of the work and present what you find directly to client stakeholders.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* Lead technical discovery across the client's systems and map how product and master data flows between them
* Identify where data is duplicated, inconsistent, or missing, and define the sources of truth
* Work with business owners to turn findings into data rules, ownership, and quality controls
* Recommend the target MDM and data architecture on AWS
* Build a prioritized, practical roadmap with the Business Strategist
* Present findings and recommendations to client stakeholders in English

**WHY THIS ROLE**

You will set the data architecture direction before any build begins, with a Business Strategist as your partner. Early in the process, you will speak with an Elios engineer who has done this work, so you know exactly what the engagement involves.

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE**

* **Hands on MDM:**you have built or implemented master data solutions such as golden records, match and merge rules, or customer, product, or material master data, with or without a dedicated MDM tool
* **AWS data engineering:**hands on work with services such as S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, or Lambda, plus strong SQL
* **Consulting background:**client facing delivery at a consultancy or as an independent consultant
* **Professional English:**comfortable leading workshops and calls with US stakeholders

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Infor SyteLine (CloudSuite Industrial) or other ERP data experience
* Consumer goods, retail, or manufacturing clients
* Product data or PIM work, including content syndication tools such as 1WorldSync
* SQL Server and Tableau

DV is the leader in digital performance solutions, helping our advertiser and agency partners Verify the quality of their digital campaigns, Optimise to improve performance and Prove that they’re achieving their business outcomes, through unbiased 3rd party data and analytics. About The Role

Reporting to the IT Operations Manager, located in New York, the Corporate Systems IT Specialist is a NYC-based role responsible for providing advanced (Tier 3) technical support to DoubleVerify's global workforce and serving as the highest point of escalation for the remote IT support team. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to mentor and guide remote team members.Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.Self-motivated individual with a proactive, service-first mindset.

Travel Requirements

jobs.description:
About Ditto:

Ditto is redefining how data moves at the edge. Our mission is to make it seamless for developers to build resilient, real-time applications, regardless of network conditions. Whether you're in a stadium, airplane, or remote military base, Ditto's peer-to-peer sync engine ensures devices stay connected and data stays consistent, even without internet. With more than $145 million in funding and trusted by organizations like Chick-fil-A, Delta Airlines, and the U.S. military, Ditto powers mission-critical experiences across aviation, retail, travel, hospitality, defense, and more. As a globally distributed, fast-growing startup, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that reflects the wide range of perspectives needed to solve the world’s hardest connectivity problems.

About the PositionThe Senior IT Systems Engineer will be focused on increasing automation across Ditto’s IT operations. They will be responsible for building infrastructure as code, monitoring and managing core IT services.

This role will require approximately 30% of their time in help desk support, but the goal is to automate that away. Ditto is a highly technical and sophisticated work force capable of self helping if given the systems to do so. One of the main goals of this role is to build the automations to enable this.

While this is a remote position, it is only for the Atlanta area. There will be an expectation to make trips to the office for special projects or troubleshooting, but there is no expectation for regularly working out of the office.

Key ResponsibilitiesOwn converting the configuration management for key services to infrastructure as code. This will mean understanding the business needs and processes around the service, required approvers and approval workflows and how to capture these requirements in technical controls.

One of the first big projects will be converting a GitHub instance to use Enterprise Managed Users with a Terraform driven configuration workflow.

Triaging and prioritizing automation projects based on statistics gathered through our ITSM.

Working with the security team to implement new security controls, apply system hardening and monitoring.

Documenting system run books and inventory.

What You'll Need6+ years of relevant experience

US Citizenship and the ability to get clearance

An eye for quality, correctness, scale and consistency

Interested in the process and procedures on how things get done, not just getting it done

Strong experience in Terraform with the ability to implement new workflows and train others

Experience with FleetDM and building policies and reports to detect and prevent issues

Experience in macOS and Linux desktop support and troubleshooting

A history of defining and automating manual IT processes

Strong understanding of identity management including SAML, OIDC, and SCIM

Nice to HavesExperience in Okta administration

Strong scripting skills in at least one common programming language such as Python

Experience working in government or defense under CMMC, FedRAMP or similar regulatory environments

Datadog experience and the ability to build dashboards and alerts

Background in managing AWS, GCP or similar cloud provider

Experience in Nix

Experience with Tracecat or an equivalent SOAR

The Benefits of Building with UsWe offer competitive salaries and meaningful equity. We believe everyone on the team should have a stake in what we’re building. Benefits vary by region to make sure you're covered in the ways that matter most. In the US, that includes health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, plus a 401(k) and flexible spending accounts.

Regardless of where you live, everyone at Ditto can utilize flexible time off. And while we work remotely, our Atlanta office is always open if you ever want a place to work or meet up with teammates.

Apply AnywayAt Ditto, we know game-changers don’t always come wrapped in a “perfect” resume. Years of experience? Every single bullet point checked? Meh. That’s not what drives us.

What does matter?

Grit.

Curiosity.

Adaptability.

And a genuine spark for what we’re building.

So if you’re fired up about our mission but not sure you tick every box - hit that apply button anyway. Use your application to show us how you’ll make an impact here.

We’re always on the lookout for exceptional humans who want to grow, stretch, and build something meaningful with us.

Ditto is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let us know.

jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Procurement team makes working with the world easy, fast, and safe. We connect supplier readiness, purchasing, invoicing, and payment so teams can move with confidence as OpenAI scales. Accounts Payable and Supplier Master Data Operations provide the trusted data, dependable execution, and financial discipline behind that experience.

About the Role

The Senior Manager, Supplier MDM Operations will own the end-to-end supplier operation that makes data accurate, verified, and ready for purchasing and payment. Reporting to the Supplier MDM Lead, you will set operating priorities, lead delivery, and be accountable for service, data quality, sensitive-change controls, and capacity. You will build an operation that scales across procurement and financial systems while creating protected capacity for the lead’s governance and transformation work.

We’re looking for a hands-on senior leader who turns ambiguous problems into clear decisions, develops people, and delivers lasting improvements. You will balance supplier readiness, risk, and capacity; resolve complex escalations; and use practical automation to help teams move faster with reliable data.

Location: San Francisco, CA. This role follows a hybrid work model, with three days per week in the office (Monday–Wednesday). Recruiting to confirm relocation and travel requirements.

In this role, you will:

 - Own supplier onboarding and maintenance across identity, legal entities, sites, tax documentation, authorized contacts, payment methods, and banking information; set service standards and take accountability for results.

 - Set the operating and capacity plan across demand, handling effort, backlog, and coverage. Prioritize work, quantify tradeoffs, and assign qualified owners and backups based on skills, access, confidentiality, and independent verification responsibilities.

 - Own operational execution of sensitive-change controls, including independent identity and authority verification, documented evidence, qualified employee review, and backup coverage. Maintain segregation of duties across preparation, approval, implementation, invoice processing, and payment approval.

 - Lead and develop the operating team and eligible service partners through clear goals, coaching, performance management, cross-training, and quality review. Use contractors for surge capacity and match assignments to approved access and scope.

 - Lead resolution of complex supplier-data and synchronization failures with AP, Procurement Operations, Tax, Treasury, Security, and Finance Systems. Establish the accountable owner, verify the fix across systems, and remove recurring causes.

 - Direct supplier-data remediation, including hierarchies, entity/site relationships, duplicates, holds, inactivation, and reactivation. Reconcile open obligations and validate downstream effects before changes take effect.

 - Own the operating scorecard for first-pass readiness, critical-field completeness, queue aging, supplier wait time, rework, control evidence, and change-related payment exceptions. Use trends to set priorities and demonstrate sustained improvement.

 - Establish an operating cadence and decision framework with the Supplier MDM Lead that protects transformation time, maintains reliable coverage, and turns recurring operational issues into prioritized improvement requirements.

 - Deliver measured improvements through AI and automation for validation, duplicate detection, queue monitoring, and evidence preparation. Define quality thresholds, access boundaries, human approvals, monitoring, and fallback procedures; count capacity gains after they are demonstrated.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Bring substantial supplier master data, P2P, or finance operations experience, with a track record of independently leading a complex operation and developing people or managing service delivery at scale.

jobs.summary: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the...
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Systems Administrator to independently administer, troubleshoot, maintain, and secure enterprise Windows and Linux systems in classified environments. Senior Systems Administrators are expected to perform nearly all routine and advanced administration with little to no assistance, serve as a technical escalation point, mentor other administrators, and lead operational work. Assistance should generally be limited to unfamiliar technologies, high-risk changes, architecture decisions, or issues requiring specialized engineering expertise.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Independently administer and troubleshoot Windows Server/desktop and Linux systems, Active Directory, enterprise authentication, permissions, services, applications, and domain-connected systems.

- Administer and troubleshoot enterprise Windows services including Group Policy (GPO), WSUS/patch management, DNS, DHCP, file services, certificates/PKI dependencies, and related system components.

- Create, modify, test, validate, and troubleshoot GPOs, including inheritance, precedence, OU targeting, security filtering, gpresult, and Resultant Set of Policy (RSoP).

- Administer WSUS or equivalent patching solutions, including synchronization, targeting, approvals, deployment status, failed updates, reporting, and patch-compliance remediation.

- Interpret DISA STIG requirements; use applicable STIG tools/checklists; implement and validate remediations, including GPO-based security configurations; document findings; and troubleshoot operational impacts.

- Independently administer and troubleshoot existing VMware, Hyper-V, or similar virtualization environments and virtual machines.

- Troubleshoot complex issues across operating systems, identity, applications, virtualization, storage, certificates, and network dependencies using logs and diagnostic tooling.

- Use PowerShell, Bash, and other scripting/automation methods for administration, bulk changes, data collection, troubleshooting, and repeatable tasks.

- Research and resolve unfamiliar issues using vendor documentation, technical references, logs, DISA guidance, and available tooling before requiring escalation.

- Plan and lead system changes, maintenance, upgrades, and migrations with implementation, validation, rollback, documentation, and change-control considerations.

- Serve as an escalation point and mentor for Junior Systems Administrators and Systems Administrators; provide peer review and technical guidance.

- Identify recurring problems, technical debt, security/configuration gaps, and process deficiencies and lead practical improvements within established architecture.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Active TS/SCI security clearance.

- Active CompTIA Security+ certification or higher DoD 8140/8570-aligned certification.

- Strong hands-on Windows and Linux systems administration experience with demonstrated ability to work independently.

- Hands-on experience with Active Directory, GPO administration/troubleshooting, enterprise patch management/WSUS, and domain-connected systems.

- Experience interpreting and remediating DISA STIG findings within secure or regulated environments.

- Working knowledge of VMware, Hyper-V, or comparable virtualization technologies.

- Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, IP addressing, subnetting, and network troubleshooting.

- Experience with PowerShell, Bash, or similar administrative scripting.

- Demonstrated ability to independently research and resolve complex technical problems, lead technical work, mentor others, and produce effective documentation.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Advanced Microsoft, Linux, VMware, networking, or cybersecurity certifications.

- Experience supporting engineering, manufacturing, or specialized technical applications.

- Experience leading infrastructure upgrades, migrations, maintenance events, or cross-functional technical efforts.

US Salary Range

 $147,000 - $196,000 USD

 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

 Benefits

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits .

 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

-

 No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

- Please always verify communications:

  - Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

  - Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com .

-

 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

-

 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 Data Privacy

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. jobs.description:
**About Us**

Machines will make decisions, move value, and coordinate on behalf of organizations, instantly, autonomously, and at unprecedented scale. But the systems that govern today’s economy weren’t designed for that world. Turnkey is building the infrastructure for this future: programmable guardrails that enable autonomy without sacrificing control.

Founded by the team who scaled Coinbase Custody to $100M+ ARR and secured over $100B in crypto assets, we know how to move at pace without ever compromising on security.

Our mission is to help the world operate an economy on autopilot, safely. We're low-ego, high-agency, and deeply technical. Our team consists of experts in cryptography, security, and systems who believe great infrastructure is invisible. We're building the trustless, programmable foundation for the autonomous economy, and we're hiring people who understand what that requires.

### **Your role**

You’ll join a small platform team that works with nearly every engineering team at Turnkey. Your job is to help the whole org build faster, scale more confidently, and make better decisions, through the tooling you build, the practices you establish, and the systemic problems you find and fix before they become incidents.

You’ll work independently across product and infrastructure teams on scaling and performance, gathering requirements and constraints from each team and turning them into shared solutions. This is a role for someone who has lived through what breaks between 1 and 10, and who gets energy from stepping outside their own domain to solve problems wherever they sit.

- Build tooling for performance analysis and observability so teams can see how their systems behave and decide from data rather than intuition
- Partner with product, infrastructure, and security teams to understand their requirements and constraints, translate technical tradeoffs for non-technical stakeholders, and build shared understanding of priorities to develop solutions that work across team boundaries
- Identify systemic issues across infrastructure and product, and drive them to resolution
- Anticipate scaling bottlenecks and take systems from X to Y scale (e.g., [throughput / latency / tenant count targets]) before they become incidents
- Level up other teams by introducing better tooling and practices and helping them build habits around measurement, SLOs, and data-driven decisions
- Translate technical tradeoffs for non-technical stakeholders and build shared understanding of priorities
- Raise the technical bar through design reviews, documentation, and mentorship

### **What we’re looking for**

- 5+ years of experience in platform engineering, infrastructure, or SRE, with substantial distributed systems experience
- Experience designing, building, scaling, and operating robust, reliable distributed systems in production
- Working experience with Golang, AWS, Postgres, and Kubernetes.
- Experience building tooling for performance and observability (metrics, tracing, profiling, logging, alerting, or similar)
- A data-driven approach: you define the metrics, instrument the system, and can tell the story of how a system or team moved from X to Y
- A record of leveling up teams beyond your own, through tooling, practices, or decision-making habits
- Clear communication and collaboration with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Intellectual curiosity and a willingness to step outside your own domain to understand how other teams work and what they need

### **Style points**

- Infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform or similar)
- Experience in security-sensitive or high-assurance environments (TEE’s, secure enclaves, key management, regulated infrastructure).
- Fluency in Go
- Experience with incident management and post-incident learning programs
- Open source contributions or public technical writing

### **What We Offer**

- Full benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, HSA/FSA, 401(k)
- Paid parental leave
- Unlimited PTO
- $3,000/yr learning and development budget to attend industry conferences
- Multiple team offsites per year
- Lunch stipend

Please note that while the team is remote, we are only considering candidates who are physically based in the United States and Canada at the current time.

_Turnkey is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply._

Compensation range

$180,000—$250,000 USD

jobs.description:
Company Overview

Nova Biomedical is a global leader in advanced analytical and diagnostic technologies supporting healthcare, biotechnology, and life sciences organizations worldwide. Nova relies on secure, reliable, and scalable technology capabilities to support employees, manufacturing operations, research and development, commercial teams, and corporate functions across a global environment.

Position Summary

The Digital Workplace Experience Engineer is a senior individual contributor responsible for engineering the workflows, platform integrations, automation patterns, and experience capabilities that reduce employee technology friction and remove repetitive human work from service operations.

This is not a senior help desk or escalation role. The position is accountable for redesigning how employee technology services are delivered across identity, endpoint, collaboration, onboarding, device lifecycle, software fulfillment, and workplace services. Complex exceptions may be handled when engineering judgment is required, but the expected result is a reusable pattern, automated workflow, platform correction, or control improvement rather than a single resolved case.

The role supports Project Aurora by engineering the Service Desk & End User Experience function into an orchestration layer within Platform Engineering. It supports Project Catalyst by converting validated recurring signals into durable remediation, process redesign, standardization, and automation. It advances Project Zero by increasing zero-touch fulfillment, automation-led resolution, proactive remediation, and human-by-exception operations.

Role Mission

Engineer scalable employee technology services that prevent avoidable demand, automate repeatable work, orchestrate cross-platform workflows, improve experience by design, and allow Nova to grow without proportional increases in manual service effort.

Work Architecture View

This role is designed around capability ownership and measurable business outcomes rather than individual service requests. It connects employee technology services across systems, teams, providers, approvals, controls, and lifecycle events.

The role redesigns work so employees and service teams can focus on complex exceptions, experience improvement, and engineering decisions while automation and intelligent tools support fulfillment, routing, remediation, validation, evidence collection, and recurring operational tasks.

Core Outcomes

Remove repetitive fulfillment, triage, remediation, evidence, and coordination activities through automation or process elimination.Reduce service demand by correcting root causes, recurring platform conditions, and ineffective workflow designs.Improve employee readiness by reducing handoffs, delays, and exceptions across onboarding, access, device, software, and workplace services.Establish consistent global execution through standard patterns, shared platforms, explicit controls, and measurable outcomes.Enable human-by-exception operations so people can focus on ambiguity, high-impact exceptions, experience problems, and engineering improvements.Support operational scalability through reusable platforms and automation rather than proportional increases in manual service capacity. Primary Workstreams
