jobs.description: About the Company In the coming decades, demand for critical minerals such as copper, lithium, and cobalt will continue to grow. These minerals are needed to build electric infrastructure, vehicles, data centers, and electronics. However, the mining industry is making 10x fewer discoveries per dollar spent on exploration compared to 30 years ago because the easy-to-find, near surface deposits have largely been discovered. KoBold was founded to be the first AI native mineral exploration, mine development, and technology development company. Our goal is to turn mineral exploration into a repeatable science to discover the minerals the world needs—by integrating artificial intelligence, human intelligence, and new technology. Our multidisciplinary teams of data scientists, engineers, and geologists work together to build data systems, design new sensors, and establish industry-leading workflows to develop and test subsurface predictions on our exploration projects. Our first discovery, Mingomba, is a high-grade copper deposit in Zambia, found after spending materially less than industry average. We are developing Mingomba with the same technical rigor that we apply to exploration. The Mingomba team brings together mine and processing engineers, geologists, data scientists, software engineers, and community, health & safety, construction, and operations specialists. By combining industry knowledge and cutting edge technology, we are developing Mingomba into a world class project that has safer and more predictable outcomes for ourselves, partners, and communities. It is expected to create thousands of good jobs for generations. KoBold runs exploration programs in eight countries, all with the potential for another discovery. KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi. About the Role KoBold's ~280 geoscientists, data scientists, and engineers work remote-first across North America, Zambia, the DRC, Sweden, and field exploration sites around the world. As we scale, we are moving IT from reactive, break/fix support toward proactive, automated operations that work seamlessly across geographies — including field sites with limited connectivity. As our Staff Client Platform Engineer, you are the senior-most hands-on engineer for KoBold's client platform: the endpoint fleet (macOS via Jamf, Windows via Intune), the identity layer (Okta, Google Workspace), and the SaaS application portfolio that connects to it. You will build zero-touch provisioning, treat configuration as code, instrument the fleet so we find problems before employees do, and automate the employee lifecycle so new hires are fully productive on day one — whether they sit in Denver or at a drill camp in Zambia. This is a builder's role with technical leadership attached. You will set technical direction for endpoint and fleet tooling, mentor our global IT support staff, and raise the bar for what world-class IT operations looks like at a fast-moving exploration technology company — while spending most of your time engineering: writing Okta workflows, managing Jamf and Intune policy in Terraform, and scripting away repetitive work. Responsibilities Endpoint Platform & Fleet Automation Design and implement zero-touch provisioning and automated reimaging workflows for macOS (Jamf) and Windows (Intune) endpoints Apply DevOps principles to IT operations: configuration-as-code (e.g., managing Jamf and Intune policy via Terraform), version-controlled policies, and repeatable processes Build endpoint monitoring, alerting, and fleet health dashboards to shift IT from reactive to proactive support Drive device lifecycle management: EoL/EoS tracking, hardware refresh planning, and inventory management across Jamf, Intune, CrowdStrike, and related tooling Create self-service application deployment and access workflows that reduce helpdesk volume and empower employees Help build the IT roadmap with the Head of Infrastructure Engineering, setting technical direction for endpoint management and fleet automation across all KoBold offices and field sites in 10+ countries Identity & Access Engineering Own Okta administration: SSO integrations, SCIM provisioning, group management, access request workflows, and lifecycle automation Manage Google Workspace administration, including license management, security settings, and break-glass super-admin governance Build automation for minimal-touch employee onboarding and offboarding — new hires fully provisioned on day one, departures cleanly deprovisioned Support AI tooling rollout (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and related tools) across the endpoint fleet, including deployment, configuration, and employee enablement SaaS Lifecycle & License Automation Run the software procurement lifecycle — new purchases, renewals, expansions, and cancellations — and build the renewal pipeline tooling so user access is never disrupted by a lapsed license Instrument license utilization across the SaaS portfolio: track usage, right-size seat counts, consolidate redundant tools, and support vendor pricing negotiations with data Onboard new SaaS applications with proper Okta integration (SSO, SCIM) before launch, and manage decommissioning of deprecated tools Partner with finance on software budget tracking, invoice approvals, and AFE submissions; give legal and finance proactive visibility into the renewal pipeline Technical Leadership & Enablement Provide technical mentorship and coaching to KoBold's global IT support staff; set the standard for automation-first problem solving Develop and maintain IT documentation and training for new hires and ongoing employee enablement Provide helpdesk backup on high-volume days, modeling the standard of responsiveness and quality you expect from the platform you build Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with infrastructure engineering and security on observability, access controls, endpoint security posture, incident response, and connectivity standards for remote field sites Partner across the company on specification, vendor selection, and change management for new software requests Learn about mineral exploration by working closely with exploration teams, including time in the field at remote operations Qualifications 7+ years in client platform engineering, IT engineering, or similar roles combining hands-on technical depth with operational ownership Deep experience with MDM platforms, particularly Jamf (macOS) and Microsoft Intune (Windows): policy configuration, automated enrollment, compliance enforcement, and ideally infrastructure-as-code approaches (e.g., Terraform) Strong experience with identity and access management (Okta strongly preferred): SSO integration, SCIM provisioning, access request workflows, and lifecycle automation Hands-on experience building zero-touch provisioning, automated reimaging, and self-service deployment workflows at scale Experience with endpoint monitoring and fleet management at scale, including remote/distributed environments Strong scripting skills (Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar) for building automation and tooling Experience managing or building tooling for SaaS licensing and renewals: utilization tracking, right-sizing, renewal pipelines, and vendor coordination Technical leadership experience: you have mentored engineers or support staff and led projects end-to-end without formal authority Proven ability to take ownership: you build the roadmap, do the research, implement the solution, write the documentation, and communicate the rollout Strong prioritization instincts — you can look at a long list of IT initiatives and distinguish what actually matters from nice-to-haves, and explain why Excellent communication and collaboration skills — comfortable working across disciplines with engineers, scientists, legal, finance, and leadership in a remote-first environment Intellectually curious; eager to learn about the substance of mineral exploration and exploration technology Comfort with ambiguity and a dynamic work environment; eagerness to take on an evolving range of responsibilities at a fast-growing company Experience supporting global teams across multiple time zones is a strong plus Familiarity with Google Workspace administration, CrowdStrike, Datadog, or the MacAdmins open-source ecosystem (osquery, Santa, Nudge, AutoPkg) is a plus What to Expect Joining KoBold means getting the opportunity for hands-on exposure to our exploration projects around the world. All employees are expected to travel to project sites, with a minimum of one week per year. Field-facing and technical roles spend significantly more time in the field. KoBold Metals is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity for people of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, citizenship, disability, or veteran status. This position is full-time, exempt. The US base salary range for this full-time exempt position is $150,000 – $180,000 USD, plus equity and benefits including 401k matching. Location: KoBold is a remote-first workplace. We are open to candidates currently residing anywhere in the United States or Canada. CST or EST time zone preferred. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States or Canada. Compensation ranges are listed in USD. If you are based outside the US, the range may not translate directly: US pay reflects a different market with different competitive dynamics, so we benchmark roles against the local market rather than converting the listed figure.

jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Solutions Engineer, US Enterprise (West)

 San Francisco, CA; Los Angeles, CA; San Diego, CA; Seattle, WA

Get to know Okta

Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology, anywhere, on any device or app. Our flexible and neutral products, Okta Platform and Auth0 Platform, provide secure access, authentication, and automation, placing identity at the core of business security and growth.

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences.

Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

The Solutions Engineering Team

We believe Solutions Engineers at Okta are involved in all stages of the customer’s digital transformation. Solutions Engineers are experienced using presentations, email, phone and social media to connect with customers virtually and in-person. We are looking for great teammates who can build and deliver sales presentations and customized product demonstrations to help educate Okta’s Customers (everyone from developers to product managers to C-level executives) on best practices during their cloud security technology journey. We believe Okta’s Solutions Engineers empathize with Customers and quickly discern their true technical needs by asking detailed, clarifying questions while presenting solutions that specifically address those needs. Okta Solution Engineers have the rare combination of technical acumen and business insight; in a career where you can utilize both. As a Solutions Engineer at Okta, you will further develop each of these skills by advising a diverse set of customers on the value they will gain by using Okta’s Identity Platform.

The Solutions Engineer Opportunity

Reporting to the Senior Manager Solutions Engineering, Okta the Solutions Engineer is a functional business consultant, with a passion for technology and the advanced ability to develop, position and demonstrate product-specific solutions during sales cycles, while achieving quarterly and annual sales goals for an assigned territory.

What you’ll be doing

- Work alongside the sales team as the technical and domain expert of a customer-facing sales team to help Customers understand the value of Okta’s solutions

- Understand customer challenges and business issues and provide product demonstrations to align our solutions with customer needs

- Answer product feature and technical questions from customers, partners and Okta colleagues

- Plan and deliver Proof Of Concepts for customers who have more complex use cases, collaborating with other Okta engineering teams as needed

- Provide feedback to product management about product enhancements that can address customer needs and provide additional value

- Share and learn best practices and re-usable assets with other Solutions Engineers to enhance the quality and efficiency of the team

- Stay current on competitive analysis and market differentiation

- Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows

- At times, be asked to learn and lead your team as a subject matter expert (SME) with various product solutions and/or competitive knowledge

What you’ll bring to the role

- 4+ years pre-sales engineering experience and solution selling.

- A passion to serve the Customer, demonstrated in a customer-facing role, such as presales or professional services, but ideally in a pre-sales capacity.

- An ability to quickly communicate complex ideas around a technical topic, ideally on the fly, using a whiteboard.

- Deployed apps in cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP, Vercel, etc.

- Experience with at least one standard network security protocol. (eg. OAuth, OAuth2, SAML, LDAP)

- Experience working with REST APIs and SDKs

- Hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas: web (JavaScript, HTML, frontend frameworks) development, backend (Java, C#, Node.js, Python) development, scripting (Bash, Powershell, Perl)

- An understanding of core security concerns within a typical application. (password hashing, SSL/TLS, encryption at rest, XSS, XSRF)

- You're an exceptional communicator, adept at simplifying complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, including highly skilled experts in large group settings.

- A confident and articulate presenter, you excel at sharing knowledge and insights with experienced technical professionals and large expert audiences.

- Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate complex technical information to highly skilled and experienced audiences, whether one-on-one or in large presentations.

- Territory management skills, including pipeline building and working with Sales counterparts to guide execution excellence

- Diagramming experience for user journey flows, complex architecture diagrams, etc.

- Typically 25% travel.

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, MIS or equivalent experience

You ideally have

- Proven experience designing, implementing, and managing Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions in enterprise environments.

- Deep understanding of the challenges and best practices associated with securing privileged accounts, including just-in-time (JIT) access, session recording, credential vaulting, and secrets management.

- Practical experience managing Windows Server, Active Directory, LDAP, and Federation services.

- Proficiency in UNIX/Linux, database security, network security, scripting, and DevOps practices preferred.

- Relevant experience with enterprise applications, security management, systems management, identity management, and/or policy management solutions, particularly in the areas of Identity and Privileged Access

jobs.description:
Category: Technology Location: Jacksonville Florida United States Senior Tanium Architect / Engineer - RemoteAs a senior Tanium Architect / Engineer you are going to support the enterprise implementation and operationalization of the Tanium Autonomous IT Platform on Tanium Cloud, including Tanium Core, Endpoint Management, and Exposure Management.

Category: Technology

Location: Jacksonville Florida United States

 Senior Tanium Architect / Engineer - Remote
 As a senior Tanium Architect / Engineer you are going to support the enterprise implementation and operationalization of the Tanium Autonomous IT Platform on Tanium Cloud, including Tanium Core, Endpoint Management, and Exposure Management.

 This is a highly hands-on senior technical role requiring an individual who can provide architectural guidance while actively building, configuring, integrating, and troubleshooting the platform. The ideal candidate has successfully implemented Tanium at enterprise scale across tens of thousands of endpoints and can drive technical decisions, recommend best practices, identify risks, and translate architecture into a stable, scalable production environment.

 The engineer will work closely with Tanium professional services and customer security, infrastructure, network, ITSM, endpoint engineering, and automation teams. This individual will serve as a technical leader within the team while remaining deeply involved in implementation.

 The goal is to maintain a native, standards-based Tanium environment with minimal unnecessary customization , establish strong automation and operational guardrails, and enable the customer's internal team to become self-sufficient.

  Responsibilities

  Tanium Architecture & Implementation

- Lead the hands-on implementation and build-out of Tanium Core, Endpoint Management, and Exposure Management within Tanium Cloud.

- Translate vendor-provided architectural direction into a scalable enterprise implementation.

- Review architecture against network segmentation, endpoint populations, bandwidth requirements, security requirements, change processes, and existing tooling.

- Identify technical gaps, risks, dependencies, and potential conflicts and recommend appropriate solutions.

- Provide technical leadership and drive architecture and implementation discussions across participating teams.

- Apply Tanium architecture, agent communication, module dependency, content, and scaling knowledge to implementation decisions.

- Maintain a native and standardized Tanium architecture wherever possible, avoiding unnecessary customization.

  Endpoint Deployment & Management

- Deploy, configure, and troubleshoot Tanium agents across Windows, Linux, and macOS environments.

- Support data center, cloud, server, workstation, and end-user endpoint populations.

- Drive pilot and production deployment waves.

- Monitor and remediate endpoint coverage, health, connectivity, and performance issues.

- Support post-deployment stabilization and hypercare activities.

- Establish automated and scalable agent lifecycle processes.

- Build dynamic endpoint groups rather than static groups to support scalable targeting and administration.

  Tanium Core

- Configure and maintain sensors, saved questions, packages, actions, computer groups, RBAC, and related platform components.

- Develop and test custom Tanium content using PowerShell, Python, and/or Bash .

- Build endpoint inventory, coverage, and operational reporting.

- Establish role-based access controls and technical guardrails designed to reduce the risk of unintended large-scale endpoint actions.

- Configure Tanium Connect and other required platform integrations.

  Endpoint Management

- Configure automated operating system and third-party application patching.

- Establish maintenance windows, deployment rings, endpoint targeting, and approval workflows.

- Build, package, test, and deploy enterprise software and update workflows.

- Troubleshoot patching, software deployment, and endpoint-management failures.

- Configure policy enforcement and endpoint performance functionality as applicable.

- Support initial inventory and software/license-management use cases, followed by expanded patch-management capabilities.

- Drive rapid platform adoption, including early agent deployment and patching proof-of-concept activities.

  Exposure Management

- Configure vulnerability and compliance scanning against applicable security benchmarks, including CIS, NIST, STIG, and internal standards .

- Connect vulnerability findings with remediation workflows.

- Build security, compliance, operational, and remediation dashboards and reporting.

- Develop workflows connecting findings to automated remediation where appropriate.

  ServiceNow Integration

- Design, implement, and validate robust Tanium and ServiceNow integrations .

- Integrate Tanium endpoint and asset information with the ServiceNow CMDB .

- Support CMDB-driven and two-way integration patterns between Tanium and ServiceNow.

- Enable CI and tag lifecycle changes to drive appropriate endpoint actions.

- Align business application, service, environment, ownership, and related endpoint tagging with ServiceNow data.

- Connect patching and software-deployment activities with ServiceNow change-management processes.

- Route vulnerability and incident information into appropriate ServiceNow workflows.

- Monitor and troubleshoot data synchronization and integration issues.

  Automation & API Integration

- Develop integrations using Tanium APIs and automation frameworks .

- Use Ansible for Tanium agent deployment and lifecycle management across Linux and server environments.

This role is four days on-site at our Seneca One Buffalo, NY location, with the flexibility to work from home one day per week

Overview

M&T Bank is seeking a skilled Desktop Engineer to join our Endpoint Engineering team, with a primary focus on Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), Windows endpoint management, and enterprise device deployment. This role will play a key part in supporting and expanding the Bank's ATM/TCR imaging and endpoint management initiatives while partnering closely with the ATM Engineering team.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong desktop engineering background, advanced troubleshooting skills, and hands-on experience managing Windows operating systems at enterprise scale. Experience supporting ATM/TCR platforms is beneficial but not required. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to learn the ATM/TCR environment while leveraging their endpoint engineering expertise to drive operational efficiency, stability, and innovation.

Primary Responsibilities

SCCM / Endpoint Management

Administer and support Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), including operating system deployment, software distribution, patch management, compliance reporting, and application lifecycle management.

Design, build, and maintain Windows device images and deployment methodologies for enterprise endpoints and ATM/TCR platforms.

Develop and maintain endpoint standards, configurations, and deployment processes to ensure secure, reliable, and consistent device experiences.

ATM Imaging & Platform Support

Partner with the ATM/TCR Engineering team to build, maintain, and support ATM/TCR imaging solutions.

Assist with operating system upgrades, software deployments, hardware refresh initiatives, and endpoint management activities within the ATM/TCR environment.

Participate in testing, validation, and rollout activities for ATM/TCR hardware and software changes.

Troubleshooting & Problem Resolution

Serve as a senior technical resource for complex endpoint issues involving operating systems, applications, deployment systems, drivers, networking, and hardware.

Perform root cause analysis and drive resolution of recurring technical problems.

Collaborate with support teams and vendors to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve enterprise endpoint and ATM/TCR-related issues.

Automation & Process Improvement

Utilize PowerShell and other automation tools to improve operational efficiency, deployment processes, and reporting capabilities.

Identify opportunities to streamline engineering and support processes through automation and tooling enhancements.

Collaboration & Documentation

Work closely with Desktop Engineering, Security Engineering, Infrastructure, ATM/TCR Engineering, and Service Desk teams.

Create and maintain technical documentation, standards, knowledge articles, and operational procedures.

Participate in project planning, implementation, testing, and support activities across endpoint technology initiatives.

Education and Experience Required:

Combined minimum of 6 years' higher education and/or work experience in systems design, management and/or architecture

Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), including:

Operating System Deployment (OSD)

Software Packaging and Deployment

Patch Management

Task Sequences

Device Compliance and Reporting

Deep knowledge of Windows desktop operating systems and endpoint lifecycle management.

Advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across operating systems, applications, hardware, drivers, networking, and deployment technologies.

Experience creating and supporting enterprise device images.

Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation.

Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across multiple technology teams.

Experience managing incidents, problem investigations, and root cause analysis efforts.

Education and Experience Preferred:

5+ years of experience in Desktop Engineering, Endpoint Engineering, or Systems Engineering in a medium-to-large enterprise environment.

Experience supporting ATM/TCR platforms, kiosk devices, retail technology, or other specialized endpoint systems.

Experience with Microsoft Intune and modern device management technologies.

Familiarity with endpoint security controls and enterprise device compliance requirements.

Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, or similar IT service management platforms.

Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, Active Directory, Group Policy, and endpoint security practices.

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to play a significant role in modernizing and supporting M&T Bank's endpoint and ATM/TCR deployment environment. You'll work on highly visible initiatives, solve complex technical challenges, and help deliver secure and reliable technology solutions across the enterprise.

Job Overview

 The Endpoint Engineer will play a critical role as a technology service owner within the Department of Digital Information Infrastructure and Engineering team. An Endpoint Engineer is a jack-of-all-trades in regard to endpoint management and utilizes their skills, experience, and talent to recommend, design, implement, and support next generation technologies across the enterprise. The position serves as the primary technology service owner responsible for enterprise endpoint management practices including software distribution, OS and Application patching, antivirus, application deployments, desktop virtualization, device provisioning, application testing, license management, and device configuration. These technologies support a dynamic learning environment that empowers 15,000 staff to deliver a world class education for 80,000+ students.

    Roles and Responsibilities

  The following information is intended to describe the overall nature and scope of the work being performed. This is not a comprehensive listing of all responsibilities or tasks; work may differ and other work may be assigned when deemed appropriate.

  Participates in a dynamic team with shared responsibilities to maintain critical IT services
  Escalates information to Endpoint Specialists
  Documents processes and procedures as related to the mission of Endpoint Management
  Develops strategies and collaborates with technical and non-technical staff on core infrastructure projects

  Provides guidance to other technical staff
  Solves complex engineering issues while working collaboratively with other departments in a team first approach

Education

 Three (3) years of full-time work experience in information technology

Ware Workstation, Dizzion FRAME, Active Directory, BeyondTrust, Radix MDM

Script, or Command Shell

jobs.description:
Job Title: Microsoft 365, Identity & Endpoint Administrator

  Job Type: Full-time, Exempt

  Location: Minneapolis, MN (Hybrid)

  Own Identify, Support People, Secure the Environment
 Plus Relocation is looking for a hands-on Microsoft administrator with deep Active Directory and Group Policy experience who enjoys solving technical problems, helping colleagues locally and around the world, and making technology work better. This is more than a help desk role: you will own the full identity lifecycle across Active Directory and Entra ID, manage our Windows endpoints, and help us improve automation, security and the employee experience.

  What You Will Do

  Own the full identity lifecycle across on-prem Active Directory and Entra ID: set up new-hire accounts ahead of start dates and keep them disabled until Day 1, process internal transfers by removing old access as well as adding new, and fully deprovision departing employees within 24 hours
  Design and maintain role-based access using security groups and the AGDLP model, applying least privilege to file shares, applications, and admin roles
  Administer Group Policy, OU structure, and delegation of control
  Run regular access reviews and cleanup of stale and orphaned accounts, unowned groups, nested-group sprawl, and privileged role membership, and produce audit-ready evidence
  Administer Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint) and manage Windows endpoints through Intune, Autopilot, configuration policies, updates, and application deployment
  Provide excellent hands-on support for local employees, and remote support for US and global employees as needed, across devices, Microsoft 365, and business applications
  Build PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automations that run under dedicated service accounts, gMSAs, or app registrations, with documented permissions, ownership, and change control
  Partner with Security and Compliance on MFA, Conditional Access, data deletion, audits, and the responsible use of approved AI tools

  What You Bring

  3+ years of hands-on Active Directory administration in a production domain: users, groups, OUs, delegation, DNS, and replication basics
  Demonstrated Group Policy experience: authoring, precedence and inheritance, security and WMI filtering, and troubleshooting with gpresult and RSOP
  Hybrid identity experience with Entra Connect or Cloud Sync, including sync scope, source of authority, and the difference between disabling a user on-prem and in the cloud
  Practical knowledge of role-based access and least privilege, including Entra admin roles, the tiered admin model, and separate admin accounts for privileged work
  Working PowerShell skills (ActiveDirectory module and Microsoft Graph PowerShell) for bulk and scheduled identity tasks
  The ability to walk us through a complete offboarding from start to finish: disabling the account and resetting the password, revoking sessions and MFA methods, removing groups and licenses, handling the mailbox and OneDrive, removing device access, and capturing evidence of each step
  Experience with NTFS and share permissions on Windows file servers
  Hands-on Microsoft 365 administration, confident Windows troubleshooting, and solid networking fundamentals
  Clear communication, strong service instincts, sound security judgment, and ownership

  Nice to Have

  Intune and Autopilot, Microsoft Defender, Purview, Conditional Access, SaaS administration, and compliance or audit experience
  Certifications such as AZ-802 (Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate), SC-300 (Identity and Access Administrator), or MD-102 (Endpoint Administrator). Demonstrated, practical experience matters more to us than certifications.

  Room to Grow
 We envision a progression from identity, Microsoft administration, and endpoint ownership in Year 1, to automation and technical project leadership in Year 2, with a potential Senior Systems and Automation Engineer path in Year 3. Progression depends on demonstrated capability and business needs.

  Compensation and Benefits Summary
 This role offers an annual base salary range of $84,000 - $105,000, depending on qualifications. This is a hybrid role based in Minneapolis, MN.

 In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for:

  Annual discretionary profit-sharing bonus
  Paid floating holiday
  401(k) retirement contributions

 Salary Range Note: This is a good faith estimate based on current benchmarks. Final compensation will be based on skills, experience, and internal equity.

  General Benefits

  Multiple medical plan options with a significant portion of premiums paid by the company
  Dental and vision coverage
  Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contributions
  Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid volunteer hours
  Company-paid life, AD&D, short- and long-term disability insurance
  Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  Wellness incentives and strengths-based development culture
  Hybrid work arrangement

  Why Plus Relocation?
 Our mission is simple: Deliver Delight. That starts with how we treat our own team. At Plus, you'll join a values-driven group of people who believe in the power of team, hold themselves to a standard of no excuses accountability, and genuinely care about doing right by our clients and each other. We invest in your growth, recognize your contributions, and support you with benefits that go beyond the basics.

 Ready to join us? Apply today or reach out to learn more.

  Plus Relocation is an equal opportunity employer. This is a hybrid position based in Minneapolis, MN. In accordance with applicable state pay transparency laws, the full salary range for this role is disclosed above.

jobs.description:
SENIOR IT SYSTEMS ENGINEER

 Freeform builds AI-native manufacturing systems that unify software, hardware, and physics to produce industrial-scale parts at the speed of human ideation. By treating manufacturing as a single integrated system, we unlock a new era of innovation where complex hardware is designed, built, and scaled without limits.

 As a Senior IT Systems Engineer, you will build the systems that connect our people, our factory, and our data: identity and endpoints, servers and storage, cloud and Kubernetes, the network, and the security layer over all of it. IT here is part of the technology we build, so it gets the same appetite for custom solutions to problems nobody has solved yet. Freeform is scaling rapidly across headcount, locations, and new technology coming online, so we're looking for someone who's excited to move fast and build the plane as we fly it. We want someone with broad skills, a "no job too big or small" mentality, and a taste for building.

 Responsibilities:

  Run Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and Azure in a hybrid setup with on-prem Active Directory, including Entra Connect, conditional access, RBAC, and licensing
  Manage the device fleet in Intune: enrollment, compliance, app deployment, Autopilot, and patching
  Build and maintain Windows Server (AD DS, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, RADIUS/NPS) and hardened Ubuntu and Red Hat servers
  Run virtualization and SAN storage (Pure Storage, HPE 3PAR over iSCSI and NFS), from provisioning and replication to capacity planning
  Run and manage AWS infrastructure, including EKS, S3, IAM and VPC networking, with ownership of access control, monitoring and cost.
  Administer Kubernetes both on-prem and in EKS: cluster builds and upgrades, networking and ingress, storage, RBAC, and troubleshooting workloads.
  Design and maintain the Layer 2/3 network and own segmentation across user, server, management, OT, and guest zones
  Operate Defender XDR, Sentinel, and pf
Sense firewalls: tune detections, investigate incidents, and drive vulnerability remediation and least-privilege access
  Design and build custom solutions where off-the-shelf tools fall short, and automate repetitive work
  Act as the senior escalation point for infrastructure incidents and lead root-cause analysis
  Document what you build in runbooks and diagrams, and mentor junior IT staff
  Join the on-call rotation and planned after-hours maintenance windows

 Basic Qualifications:

  7+ years in systems administration or infrastructure engineering, 3+ in a senior or lead role, owning a mixed Windows, Linux, cloud, and network environment
  Experience with the below technologies including administering and troubleshooting

    Hybrid Microsoft 365, Intune, and Azure: on-prem AD synced to Entra ID, hybrid join, co-existence, and migration
    Windows Server DNS, DHCP, and RADIUS/NPS in production
    Ubuntu and Red Hat: systemd, storage, networking, hardening, and command-line troubleshooting
    vSphere, Hyper-V, or OpenShift, plus SAN storage over iSCSI and NFS (hands-on with Pure Storage and HPE 3PAR)
    AWS (EKS, S3, IAM) / Azure / GCP
    Kubernetes (on-prem and in the cloud)
    Layer 2/3 networking: VLANs, ACLs, segmentation, MLAG, and LACP
    Defender XDR, Sentinel, and pf
Sense administration

  PowerShell and Bash scripting experience
  Clear written communication with technical and non-technical audiences

 Nice to Have:

  Experience with HashiCorp Vault and Argo CD
  Experience with Ansible
  Python scripting experience
  Experience administering Siemens Teamcenter
  Experience with Microsoft SQL Server administration
  Hands-on experience deploying physical security systems (DVR/NVR, CCTV, access control)
  AI fluency: practical use of AI tools for scripting, troubleshooting, and documentation, with sound judgment on data handling
  Degree in computer information systems, computer science, or computer engineering

 Location:

  Based in Hawthorne, our vertically integrated facility brings technology development, R&D, and production together under one roof. We operate at the center of LA's deep tech ecosystem, surrounded by some of the most ambitious hardware innovation happening anywhere in the country.
  Our fast-paced, cross-functional environment is built on close collaboration, and as such, this role requires full-time onsite presence (five days a week), with very limited exceptions.

 Why Freeform?

  We have an inclusive and diverse culture that values collaboration, learning, and making deliberate data-driven decisions
  We offer a unique opportunity to be an early and integral member of a rapidly growing company that is scaling a world-changing technology
  Benefits

    Significant stock option packages
    100% employer-paid Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance (premium PPO and HMO options)
    Life insurance

    Paid vacation, sick leave, and company holidays
    Generous Paid Parental Leave and extended transition back to work for the birthing parent
    Free daily catered lunch and dinner, and fully stocked kitchenette
    Casual dress, flexible work hours, and regular catered team building events

  Compensation

    As a growing company, the salary range is intentionally wide as we determine the most appropriate package for each individual taking into consideration years of experience, educational background, and unique skills and abilities as demonstrated throughout the interview process. Our intent is to offer a salary that is commensurate for the company's current stage of development and allows the employee to grow and develop within a role.

The upper end of the range is reserved for individuals who demonstrate exceptional experience, deep domain mastery, and a proven history of high performance and impact.

In this role, you will build and empower a talented team of engineers, partner cross-functionally to shape the product roadmap, establish technical foundations, and deliver a superlative user experience.

This role is based in our Warsaw office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

 What you’ll achieve

- Hire and support a talented team of engineers to build a new product from the ground up.

- Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Design, and Data Science to define roadmap priorities and deliver intuitive product capabilities.

- Guide architectural and technical decisions to ensure system reliability, performance, and long-term scalability.

- Drive operational excellence and continuous delivery processes, enabling the team to iterate quickly and ship value continuously.

- Champion accountability for key outcomes, linking your team's everyday work to Asana's broader strategic goals.

jobs.summary: Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide. Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to...
jobs.description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.

The Desktop Systems Administrator II serves as an advanced Tier II escalation point, responsible for deploying, maintaining, and supporting enterprise endpoint hardware, operating systems, and core productivity applications. This role partners closely with Service Desk and Infrastructure teams to ensure high availability, streamline standard operating procedures, and deliver white-glove technical support to on-site, remote, and executive personnel. This position requires being in the office 5 days per week at our Dallas, TX location.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Support & VIP Services

- Tier II Incident Resolution: Act as an escalation point for complex incidents and service requests from the Service Desk, troubleshooting hardware, software, VPN, mobile devices, peripherals, and network connectivity across Windows and macOS environments.
- Executive & VIP Support: Deliver high-touch, urgent technical support for senior leadership and administrative staff with minimal business disruption.
- Incident & Outage Management: Monitor, prioritize, and resolve ticketing queues within established SLAs; participate in an on-call rotation to resolve critical after-hours incidents and outages.
- Event & AV Support: Configure, test, and facilitate audio/video conferencing solutions (e.g., Zoom Rooms, Microsoft Teams, etc.) for executive presentations and company-wide meetings.
- Working with IT Engineering teams, act as “smart hands and eyes” for in-office infrastructure including networking equipment and servers

Endpoint & Systems Administration

- Endpoint Provisioning & Deployment: Deploy, configure, and maintain laptops, desktops, and mobile devices using enterprise management tooling (e.g., Intune, Jamf, SCCM).
- Identity & Access Management: Administer user accounts, groups, and device policies within Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Okta.
- Task Automation: Familiarity with technologies to automate repetitive administrative workflows and system maintenance tasks through scripting or AI.
- Infrastructure Relocations: Coordinate and execute IT workspace setups, office reconfigurations, and moves/adds/changes.

IT Asset Lifecycle Management (ITAM)

- Hardware Lifecycle Operations: Maintain the end-to-end hardware lifecycle, including procurement staging, bench testing, provisioning, secure data sanitization/wiping, and e-waste disposal.
- Inventory Control: Monitor and maintain stock levels for hardware, peripherals, and accessories across local depots in alignment with organizational standards.

Process Improvement & Knowledge Management

- SOP Development: Document standardize operating procedures, knowledge base articles, and end-user self-service guides to increase First Contact Resolution (FCR) rates.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Infrastructure, Security, and Desktop Engineering teams to identify operational gaps, rollout technology updates, and enforce IT standards.

Qualifications & Requirements

Required Experience & Education

- Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience with 5+ years of progressive end-user computing / desktop support experience.
- Executive Support: Minimum 2 years of experience providing dedicated VIP / executive-level technical support.
- Operating Systems & Software: Deep administration knowledge of Windows and macOS, along with enterprise suites (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Adobe Creative Cloud, Slack, Zoom).
- Endpoint Management: Comprehensive knowledge administering devices via MDM/UEM platforms (e.g., Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Manager, Jamf Pro, or SCCM).
- Identity & Directory Services: Practical experience managing users, access permissions, and device compliance in Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Okta.
- Networking Fundamentals: Strong comprehension of enterprise network protocols and services (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi 802.1x).
- Communication & Professionalism: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, accessible language for non-technical stakeholders.
- Physical Requirement: Ability to physically lift, rack, move, and deploy hardware weighing up to 50 lbs.

Preferred Additional Qualifications

- Certifications: CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, or Jamf Certified Associate.
- Scripting Skills: Working knowledge of PowerShell, Bash, or Python for desktop administration and deployment automation.
- AI fundamentals of Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or other AI platforms.
- ITIL Familiarity: Understanding of ITIL framework and ticketing workflows (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira Service Management).

Work Location: This role is hybrid. 3 days a week (T, W, TH) in our Dallas office is required.

* * *

As part of our continued commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, Five9 supports pay transparency during the entire recruitment process. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate including, but not limited to: skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the job across the United States. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation package during your hiring process.

Additionally, the total compensation package for this position may also include an annual performance bonus, stock, and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans.

Our total reward package also includes:

- Health, dental, and vision coverage, beginning on the first day of employment. Five9 covers 100% of the employee portion of the health, dental and vision coverage and shares a high portion of the dependent cost. We also offer Short & Long-Term Disability, Basic Life Insurance, and a 401k saving plan with employer matching.
- Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.
- Generous employee stock purchase plan.
- Paid Time Off, Company paid holidays, paid volunteer hours and 12 weeks paid parental leave.

All compensation and benefits are subject to the requirements and restrictions set forth in the applicable plan documents and any written agreements between the parties.

The US base salary range for this role is below.

$72,100—$200,200 USD

Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better we are. Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.

Five9 is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@five9.com to request an accommodation. Requests will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable law.

View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: [https://www.five9.com/pt-pt/legal](https://www.five9.com/pt-pt/legal).

jobs.description:
About the RoleWe are seeking an experienced Senior Microsoft Engineer (Level 3) to serve as a technical authority within a high-performing operations team, supporting complex Microsoft cloud environments across multiple commercial customers.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Microsoft Engineer (Level 3) to serve as a technical authority within a high-performing operations team, supporting complex Microsoft cloud environments across multiple commercial customers.

This is a hands-on senior engineering role focused on resolving complex technical escalations, strengthening security standards, driving technology modernisation, and improving operational efficiency. You will leverage your expertise across Microsoft 365, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Defender, and Microsoft Azure to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable technology solutions.

Beyond reactive support, you will proactively identify opportunities to optimise customer environments, enhance security, improve licensing efficiency, and reduce operational complexity. You will also play a key role in mentoring engineers, establishing technical standards, and driving continuous improvement across the wider technical team.

About the Client

You will be working with an established technology services provider that delivers managed IT services and Microsoft cloud solutions to commercial customers. The organisation prioritises security, operational excellence, and proactive technology management, empowering its technical teams to deliver reliable solutions while continuously improving customer environments.

Ideal Profile

Professional Experience

-

At least 7 years of experience in systems engineering, cloud engineering, or managed IT services, including significant experience in senior technical support or Level 3 engineering.

-

Proven experience working within a Managed Service Provider (MSP), supporting multiple commercial customer environments.

-

Strong understanding of managed services operations, incident management, problem management, and change management.

-

Demonstrated ability to own complex technical issues, conduct root-cause analysis, and deliver sustainable solutions.

Microsoft Intune & Endpoint Management

-

Advanced hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Endpoint Manager.

-

Strong knowledge of Windows Autopilot, device enrolment, configuration profiles, compliance policies, application deployment, and Windows 10/11 administration.

-

Experience with endpoint security, device lifecycle management, update management, and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint integration.

Microsoft 365

-

Advanced administration and troubleshooting experience across Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, and Microsoft Teams.

-

Knowledge of Microsoft 365 licensing, including Business Premium, E3, and E5, and their associated security and compliance capabilities.

-

Understanding of Microsoft Purview, including Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies and sensitivity labels.

Microsoft Entra ID & Identity Security

-

Deep expertise in identity and access management, authentication, identity protection, and access governance.

-

Advanced experience implementing and troubleshooting Conditional Access, multifactor authentication (MFA), and Single Sign-On (SSO).

-

Knowledge of hybrid identity, Entra Connect, directory synchronisation, authentication protocols, role-based access control, and least-privilege security models.

-

Familiarity with Granular Delegated Admin Privileges (GDAP) and delegated administration across multiple customer tenants.

Microsoft Defender & Cybersecurity

-

Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and the broader Microsoft Defender security ecosystem.

-

Experience implementing endpoint protection, attack surface reduction, vulnerability management, and security policies.

-

Knowledge of Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Microsoft Defender XDR, Zero Trust principles, and Microsoft security best practices.

-

Ability to review Microsoft Secure Score and implement recommendations to strengthen security posture.

Microsoft Azure

-

Strong experience administering and troubleshooting Azure environments, including virtual machines, networking, storage, backup, monitoring, and resource management.

-

Knowledge of Azure role-based access control, Azure Policy, security configuration, governance, and cost management.

-

Familiarity with Azure Lighthouse and multi-tenant Azure administration.

Scripting & Automation

-

Advanced PowerShell scripting skills for automating Microsoft 365, Intune, Entra ID, and Azure administration.

-

Strong experience with Microsoft Graph API for automation, reporting, and configuration management.

-

Ability to develop, troubleshoot, and maintain secure, reusable, and well-documented scripts and automated processes.

Security Frameworks & Additional Technical Knowledge

-

Familiarity with the Australian Signals Directorate (ASD) Essential Eight framework and its application to commercial environments.

-

Experience implementing Microsoft security controls to support Essential Eight maturity improvements.

-

Exposure to Microsoft Sentinel, Log Analytics, advanced security monitoring, and broader Microsoft Purview compliance capabilities.

-

Familiarity with multi-tenant management platforms, including Microsoft 365 Lighthouse, Azure Lighthouse, and PSA/RMM tools such as ConnectWise, HaloPSA, Autotask, NinjaOne, or Datto RMM.

-

Experience contributing to customer technology roadmaps, security improvement plans, and Microsoft licensing reviews.

-

Understanding of ITIL-aligned service management practices.

Preferred Certifications

-

Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102).

-

Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS-102).

-

Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104).

Additional certifications in identity and access management, such as SC-300, and Azure security, such as SC-500, are advantageous. Equivalent practical experience and technical knowledge are also valued.

Key Competencies

-

Technical Expertise: Applies in-depth Microsoft technology knowledge to resolve complex engineering challenges independently.

-

Ownership & Accountability: Takes responsibility for issues from investigation through resolution and addresses recurring problems at their source.

-

Proactive Thinking: Identifies opportunities to modernise environments, improve security, and prevent recurring incidents.

-

Analytical Problem-Solving: Uses structured troubleshooting and evidence-based analysis to develop sustainable solutions.

-

Security-Focused Mindset: Maintains secure, consistent, and well-governed Microsoft environments.

-

Communication & Collaboration: Communicates technical concepts, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

-

Mentoring & Knowledge Sharing: Supports the development of junior engineers and contributes to a collaborative technical culture.

-

Documentation & Continuous Improvement: Maintains high-quality documentation and continually improves technical standards, processes, and automation.

1. Level 3 Technical Escalation & Problem Management

2. Microsoft Security & Configuration Standards

-

-

6. Technical Leadership & Knowledge Development

* 4 years of experience in Endpoint Management, IT Operations, or advanced IT Support
* Experience with Microsoft Intune and endpoint management solutions
* Knowledge of software packaging and application deployment
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
* Understanding of endpoint security and compliance concepts
* Basic PowerShell knowledge is an advantage

* We promote your professional and personal development through individual training and further education at the Drees \& Sommer Academy
* We support your health with a bonus for sports enthusiasts. We offer the possibility of subscribing to a private health insurance policy
* Employees benefit from tax advantages related to their commuting expenses for the office
* Fiscal advantages for employees expenses in meal costs during worktime. Employee referral program with attractive bonus scheme
* Supporting career and family by receiving tax benefits for kindergarten expenses

jobs.description:
**Life tastes better with ice cream**

With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall's, Cornetto and Ben \& Jerry's, loved in 76 countries, we are the world's largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.

We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world's biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.

What truly sets us apart is how we work.

We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.

We're curious and ready for what's next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.

Scope: Regional Americas
Location: Mexico, Tultitlan - Tepalcapa
T\&C: Project role, end of nov 27

The Role
- -------

We are seeking a highly experienced **Data Lead Americas** to play a critical role in one of the most significant transformation programs in our company's history: the implementation of **SAP S/4HANA** and the creation of a new standalone organization through the carve-out from Unilever.

This is a unique opportunity to help design and establish the future data foundation of a new company. The role will lead Master Data Management strategy and deployment across the Americas, with a strong focus on **Material and Product Domain Management, Customer Master Data, Data Governance, and S/4HANA data transformation**.

The successful candidate will combine deep Master Data expertise with a strong consulting mindset, influencing senior stakeholders, driving strategic decisions, and ensuring data is fit for purpose to enable business operations from Day 1.

What You Will Be Responsible For
- -------------------------------

* Lead Master Data Management deployment and governance for the Americas within the SAP S/4HANA transformation program.
* Serve as the regional SME for Material, Product, and Customer Master Data, ensuring alignment with global standards and business needs.
* Partner with global process owners, business teams, data owners, and system integrators to design and implement target-state master data processes.
* Drive data readiness activities, including cleansing, enrichment, validation, and migration to support successful deployments.
* Establish and enhance data governance frameworks, data quality controls, and master data lifecycle management practices.
* Influence stakeholders and promote standardization through adoption of best-in-class data management processes.
* Lead senior stakeholder discussions, manage data-related risks, and provide recommendations, escalation, and mitigation plans.
* Coordinate testing, business validation, cutover, go-live readiness, and post-go-live hypercare and stabilization activities while supporting the future data operating model.

What We Are Looking For
- ----------------------

* Extensive Master Data Management (MDM) experience within large-scale SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
* Strong expertise in Material, Product, and Customer Master Data, including governance, quality, and lifecycle management.
* Proven track record leading data migration, data governance, and data quality initiatives for ERP implementations.
* Deep understanding of master data processes, governance models, hierarchies, and business rules.
* Ability to influence senior business and technology stakeholders and drive decision-making in complex environments.
* Experience working across global, matrixed organizations with diverse stakeholder groups.
* Strong consulting, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* SAP S/4HANA deployment experience required; carve-out, M\&A, or business separation experience is a plus.

What You Can Expect
- ------------------

* A unique opportunity to help build the data foundations of a newly established company following a major carve-out from Unilever.
* A highly visible leadership role with direct exposure to senior business and transformation leaders.
* The chance to shape Master Data strategy, governance, and operating models from the ground up.
* Participation in a complex, enterprise-wide SAP S/4HANA transformation across the Americas.
* Collaboration with global teams, external partners, and industry experts.
* A dynamic environment where you can combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
* Significant opportunity to leave a lasting impact on how the new organization operates and grows.

**Why join us?**

This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!

You'll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you're excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact

* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done

* Continuous learning and development as the business grows

* Reward linked to performance and contribution.

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.

**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?**

If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.

If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.

**Additional information**

The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

Job Overview

The Endpoint Administrator will manage and support the organization's endpoint computing environment. This role is responsible for the administration, security, deployment, and lifecycle management of Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android devices across branch, corporate, and remote locations. The Endpoint Administrator will play a key role in delivering a secure and modern digital workplace through technologies such as Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Group Policy, mobile device management (MDM), endpoint security, automation, and application deployment. The successful candidate will work closely with Infrastructure, IT Security, Service Support Desk, and business stakeholders to ensure endpoint services meet operational, security, and regulatory requirements.

Role

Endpoint Management

Administer and support enterprise Windows 11 and macOS devices.Manage and maintain corporate iPhone, iPad, and Android devices.Oversee the full endpoint lifecycle, including procurement, provisioning, deployment, upgrades, refreshes, and decommissioning.Develop and maintain standard operating system images and endpoint configuration standards.

Microsoft Endpoint Ecosystem

Administer Microsoft Intune for device management, application deployment, compliance, and configuration management.Design and maintain Windows Autopilot processes for zero-touch device deployment.Manage Microsoft Entra ID device registration and compliance integration.Implement and support Conditional Access and device-based security controls.

Application Deployment & Automation

Package, test, deploy, and support enterprise applications using Intune and related management platforms.Develop and maintain PowerShell and scripting solutions to automate operational tasks and improve service delivery.Maintain software inventories and ensure application currency across the enterprise.Troubleshoot application deployment and compatibility issues.

Active Directory & Policy Management

Create, manage, and troubleshoot Group Policy Objects (GPOs).Support Active Directory administration related to endpoints and user computing.Implement endpoint configuration standards and security baselines.

Security & Compliance

Maintain endpoint security controls including Microsoft Defender, BitLocker, FileVault, antivirus, and device compliance policies.Support regulatory, audit, and cybersecurity initiatives including ISO 27001 and financial industry security requirements.Investigate and remediate endpoint security vulnerabilities and compliance issues.Participate in security incident response activities involving endpoint devices.

Operational Support

Act as a senior escalation point for endpoint-related incidents and service requests.Monitor endpoint health, patch compliance, and service performance metrics.Collaborate with Infrastructure, IT Security, and Service Support Desk teams on projects and operational initiatives.Create and maintain technical documentation, standards, procedures, and knowledge articles.

jobs.description:
Looking for a career where hard work is valued, and your ideas and feedback are part of the way we operate daily? Want to bring your skills to a company that encourages teamwork and champions continued education and process improvement?

Atlas Tech, a veteran-owned IT company serving multiple DoD customers in support of America's warfighters, s looking for a senior, hands-on Cloud Engineer who thinks like an enterprise architect. You'll help our customer transition and compute critical data workloads from traditional 3-tier virtual machines to an automated, resilient, and secure Infrastructure-As-Code system hosted on AWS GovCloud. You’ll own the solutions in production and clearly communicate your plans and designs to developers, cybersecurity, and senior leaders using diagrams, presentations, and documentation. This role expects a wide range of technical expertise. Besides the general cloud service expertise, you'll need to understand the fundamental compute and networking concepts that those cloud services rely on. You'll be able to build and test ideas and concepts in the console, but real deployments will be code-first. Strong CLI and scripting skills will be expected, able to select and work with the best tool for a given task, including PowerShell, Bash, Python, and/or TypeScript.

Strong candidates will have extensive experience across many IT domains, working as a Systems Admin, Engineer, and Technical Architects.

Fully remote position available to residents in AL, CA, CT, FL, GA, KS, KY, LA, ME, MD, MA, NC, OR, RI, SC, TX, VA, DC, WV, NJ.

You Will:

Design cloud infrastructure to support compute, network, and data services on AWS GovCloud, focusing on security, cost, availability, and operability.
Build your designs using code-first and DevSecOps principles. Write and review infrastructure-as-code, automation, and CI/CD pipelines (Primarily CloudFormation).
Administer and automate within the cloud-hosted compute platforms (Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Containers, a few standalone Windows instances) to ensure performant application delivery.
Prototype and validate approaches in code before recommending them.
Take technical lead during difficult (tier 4+) outages and incidents, troubleshooting from application behavior down through app logs, CloudWatch, DNS, TLS, routing, and packet captures.
Work with enterprise services, including cross-cloud services to ensure that your designs meet enterprise requirements.
Produce actionable architecture artifacts: engineering diagrams, DoDAF views, and cybersecurity documentation.
Brief senior leaders on technical options, risks, and recommendations in plain language. Support your designs by contributing to roadmaps and business cases for major technology shifts.
Partner with cybersecurity and accreditation teams to build security and RMF/ATO requirements into designs from the start.
Review existing environments and develop dashboards that will allow data and metrics to drive improvements in reliability, security, cost, and automation.
Mentor engineers and help set technical standards for the team.

You Have:

An active Secret clearance or eligibility.
Deep, hands-on experience building and operating production infrastructure on AWS or Azure. We care more about how well you understand the underlying systems than which cloud you learned on, and we expect strong engineers to move between platforms.
A strong command of IT fundamentals:
TCP/IP and the OSI model
Common network services such as HTTP, LDAP, and DNS
TLS/PKI and certificate management
Load balancing and reverse proxies
Linux (and some limited Windows) system administration, networking, and engineering
Backup, high availability, and disaster recovery
Multifactor authentication, OIDC, Oauth2, and related services
The ability to explain the why behind your decisions, as well as "how" the solution works.
Comfort writing code in Python, PowerShell, Bash, or CDK/TypeScript, alongside infrastructure-as-code.
Experience integrating enterprise capabilities from multiple vendors:
Virtualization
Software-defined networking
VDI and VPN
Security monitoring
Server and desktop OS management
Clear written and verbal communication, at every level from an engineer's ticket to a leadership decision brief.
The judgment to work independently and prioritize by mission impact.
Education/Experience
10+ years of hands-on infrastructure, systems, or virtual datacenter engineering experience, or a bachelor's degree in a technical field plus 6+ years.
DoD 8140 qualification (Security+ CE required, CISSP preferred), or the ability to obtain it within 6 months of hire.
A professional-level relevant certification (AWS Solutions Architect - Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, RHCE), or demonstrated equivalent experience.
Experience with AWS GovCloud or Azure Government is preferred.
DoD experience is a plus, including classified networks, DDIL, or SATCOM environments.
Familiarity with enterprise architecture such as DoDAF or TOGAF, and experience delivering artifacts to EA and cybersecurity audiences.
Experience with DevOps toolchains such as Git, CodePipeline, Ansible, Jenkins, Artifactory, Harbor, and Selenium.

Want to hear more? Read on to see what our Team Members say about their experience:

“Atlas Tech has the culture, trust, and fairness that you expect of the best of communities. I feel lucky to be part of their amazing journey of growth as a standout organization.” - Syed

“You are not just a number here at Atlas. I have been with Atlas for over 13 years now I can say that Atlas displays a genuine interest in its employees. This is evidenced in its commitment to mentoring every employee and providing educational paths for each employee’s personal and professional growth within the company.” - Ian

Atlas Tech is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, genetic information, or protected veteran status. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives are valued and respected.

Accessibility & Accommodations

Atlas Tech strives to make our website, www.atlas-tech.com, accessible to all users. If you need assistance completing the application process or require a reasonable accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at hr.recruiter@atlas-tech.com.

This contact information is designated for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of an application. Atlas Tech is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA).

Atlas Tech offers a competitive salary, generous benefits package, and an opportunity to make a positive impact in your own community.
