jobs.description:
About Us

Wellington Management offers comprehensive investment management capabilities that span nearly all segments of the global capital markets. Our investment solutions, tailored to the unique return and risk objectives of institutional clients in more than 60 countries, draw on a robust body of proprietary research and a collaborative culture that encourages independent thought and healthy debate. As a private partnership, we believe our ownership structure fosters a long-term view that aligns our perspectives with those of our clients.

About The Role

Job Abstract:

Wellington has a long history of delivering exceptional client service. As we drive more self‑service within our institutional offering, expand into Wealth, and scale Global Distribution, it is increasingly important to deliver world‑class digital tools that are easy to use and provide a competitive edge in relevant markets. It is equally important to scale service operations and account for regional variations with a clear focus on administrative efficiency and employee experience. This is a perfectly timed, high‑visibility role for a value‑focused creative problem solver who is passionate about client experience, has strong business and technical aptitude, and is an effective consensus builder.

As a senior member of the Client Platform Technology team, this individual will head client and employee experience for all products and solutions across the Marketing, Sales, Onboarding, and Servicing stages of the client lifecycle. This includes digital tools used globally by prospects and clients—Public Website, Client Portal, Campaigns, and third‑party digital destinations—as well as the tools used by Wellington employees to serve them. The individual will partner with business teams to align on the intended experience, prioritize requirements, and serve as a shared resource across product development teams, supporting end‑to‑end development from invention and design through rollout.

Within the Client Platform, we view Client Experience and Employee Experience as two sides of the same coin. This role will pioneer Service Design as a formal practice at Wellington, partnering with business leads, operations, product, and technology teams to analyze the current state and define the future‑state client and distributor journey, including required business processes, workflows, and tools.

Responsibilities

Research and Insights

 Monitor usage of client and employee‑facing digital tools to inform experience strategy and design; conduct client research to understand current practices, unmet needs, motivations, and pain points. Conduct service design workshops and stakeholder interviews across Marketing, Sales, and Servicing to understand current workflows, collaboration models, pain points, strategic priorities, and KPIs.

Analysis and Opportunity Identification

 Analyze, synthesize, and present insights through current‑state journeys, service blueprints, and executive presentations. Triangulate data and insights to identify opportunities that deliver value and improve the client and employee experience.

Define Experience Strategy And Design

 Define future‑state client journeys, business processes, digital tools, and solutions using service blueprints. Facilitate the Client Platform vision by creating conceptual designs and testing them with clients and internal stakeholders. Produce high‑fidelity wireframes and prototypes with annotations; gather inputs to refine and socialize them with stakeholders.  Build service design and experience design practices for the enterprise. Coach Client Platform team members and champion experience strategy and design across sister platforms.

Nacimos para provocar un cambio real a través de la innovación y el desarrollo sostenible, con la misión de aportar valor a los clientes e impulsar nuestro talento.* *Formado por más de 3.000 personas creativas, digitales e innovadoras conectadas a un propósito y capaces de generar conexiones con personas de todo el mundo. * Proactiva y con iniciativa.
* Con capacidad de trabajo en equipo.
* Con interés por seguir aprendiendo y evolucionando técnicamente

* Certificación Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102) valorable.

jobs.title: Commercial Data Consultant (MDM / Data Platforms)
jobs.summary: Why this role We are a consulting firm that helps life sciences companies, locally and globally, get their commercial data right, from master data and data platforms to customer engagement programmes. In this role, you'll be the person clients and project...
jobs.description:
Why this role

We are a consulting firm that helps life sciences companies, locally and globally, get their commercial data right, from master data and data platforms to customer engagement programmes. In this role, you'll be the person clients and project teams turn to when the data questions get hard.

We welcome people from two backgrounds: master data management (MDM) or data platforms. You don't need to cover both. We're looking for real depth in one.

What you'll do

* Act as the subject matter expert on MDM or data platform pre-implementation or implementations for life sciences clients, depending on your background
* Tackle the data challenges typical of customer engagement, such as HCP/HCO data quality, CRM master and reference data
* Bring third-party reference data (IQVIA, Veeva) together with client data
* Work with architects, functional consultants and client stakeholders to turn requirements into working data solutions

What you bring

* A proven track record as a subject matter expert in either:

* MDM implementations (e.g. Informatica MDM, Reltio MDM), or

* data platform implementations (e.g. Databricks, Snowflake, Informatica IDMC)
* A solid understanding of data management and its typical challenges in the customer engagement (CE) domain
* A general understanding of CE processes within CRM, marketing automation, consent management, and event and engagement management
* Good knowledge of the data models of at least one key data provider: IQVIA OneKey, IQVIA sales and prescription data, or Veeva OpenData
* Clear communication, spoken and written
* Excellent English

A plus if you have

* Deep knowledge of one or more CE processes
* A certification in an MDM solution (Informatica MDM, Reltio MDM) or a data platform (Databricks, Snowflake, Informatica)
* GAMP 5 training or hands-on experience

This position is offered in Denmark and Spain.

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2007, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting enterprise working exclusively in the life sciences industry.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Europe and the United States, we support clients globally. We work closely with our customers to identify, develop, and implement initiatives that drive growth, efficiency, and meaningful change. Through partnerships with leading solution providers such as Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Benchling, and MediSpend, we help our clients unlock the full potential of modern technologies.

Why join BASE Life Science?

At BASE, you work on meaningful, complex challenges at the intersection of technology, science, and business. We trust our people with real responsibility and support them in turning ambition into impact.

You will be part of a collaborative, high‑performing environment where:

* Ambition is encouraged through ownership and continuous learning
* Execution matters --- we focus on delivering solutions that work in practice
* Team spirit and trust guide collaboration across roles, countries, and disciplines
* Openness means your ideas are heard, you are challenged constructively, and supported as you grow

Alongside this, we offer:

* Support for health and wellbeing, covering physical, mental, and social needs
* Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance
* Ongoing learning and professional development throughout your career
* A modern work setup, with the tools and equipment needed to do great work
* Recognition of performance and impact, linked to contribution and results
* The opportunity to work on challenges that make a meaningful difference for patients and healthcare systems worldwide

Explore our work, values, and people at www.baselifescience.com

Interested?

If you find this position intriguing, don't delay---++submit your application in English++ at your earliest convenience. We are continuously reviewing and assessing all incoming candidates and eagerly await your application.

At BASE Life Science, we value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Employment decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs

By submitting your application, you consent to the processing of your personal data by BASE life science for the purposes of recruitment and selection. This includes the collection, storage, and use of your personal data as outlined in our Privacy Policy++.++

jobs.title: Solution Engineer - AI Business Solutions (Cloud Endpoint)
jobs.summary: **Overview** As a Solution Engineer -- AI Business Solutions (Cloud Endpoint), you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to enterprise customers, helping them modernize their endpoint and virtual desktop environments for secure, cloud-native,...
jobs.description:
**Overview**

As a Solution Engineer -- AI Business Solutions (Cloud Endpoint), you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to enterprise customers, helping them modernize their endpoint and virtual desktop environments for secure, cloud-native, AI-enabled work.

You will lead technical engagements across the Cloud Endpoint portfolio, including Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender, and Microsoft Entra ID, translating customer business and technical requirements into scalable solution architectures. You will drive technical wins through discovery, architectural design, demonstrations, workshops, and proofs of concept, while partnering closely with sales, security, identity, engineering, and partner teams.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead technical discovery and customer conversations to understand business, security, endpoint management, virtualization, and AI-related requirements and translate them into solution strategies.

* Design and present secure, scalable Cloud Endpoint architectures leveraging technologies such as Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender, and Microsoft Entra ID.

* Drive technical wins by delivering architectural design sessions, demonstrations, hands-on workshops, Proofs of Concept (POCs), and technical close plans that demonstrate solution value and integration with customer environments.

* Act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers modernize legacy VDI and endpoint management environments and adopt cloud-native, identity-first, and Zero Trust approaches.

* Partner with account teams, specialists, Cloud Solution Architects, security and identity teams, partners, and engineering to develop strategic win plans, resolve technical blockers, and accelerate customer adoption.

* Apply competitive, industry, partner, and technical knowledge to position Microsoft solutions effectively, identify competitive opportunities, and provide feedback to product and engineering teams.

* Continuously develop technical expertise across Cloud Endpoint, security, identity, virtualization, and emerging AI technologies while sharing knowledge and best practices with customers, partners, and internal teams.

**Qualifications**

**Required/minimum qualifications**

· Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 3+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 4+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR 5+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR equivalent experience.

· Professional proficiency in English, with the ability to lead technical discussions, presentations, demonstrations, and architecture conversations with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders in both written and verbal interactions.

**Additional or preferred qualifications**

· 6+ years technical pre-sales, technical consulting, or technology delivery, or related experience OR equivalent experience.

· 4+ years experience with cloud and hybrid, or on premises infrastructures, architecture designs, migrations, industry standards, and/or technology management.

· Certification in relevant technologies or disciplines (e.g., Office 365, Power BI, Azure Architect and Development exams, Cloud Platform Technologies, Information Security, Architecture).

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about requesting accommodations. (https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/accessibility.html)

jobs.summary: 🛡️ ¡Únete a Accenture como SentinelOne Security Specialist! ¿Tienes experiencia en **Endpoint Security, EDR/XDR y respuesta ante incidentes** ? Buscamos un/a especialista para administrar y optimizar la protección de endpoints con **SentinelOne** ,...
jobs.description:
🛡️ ¡Únete a Accenture como SentinelOne Security Specialist!

¿Tienes experiencia en **Endpoint Security, EDR/XDR y respuesta ante incidentes** ? Buscamos un/a especialista para administrar y optimizar la protección de endpoints con **SentinelOne** , fortaleciendo la detección, investigación y respuesta frente a amenazas.

🔐 ¿Qué harás?

* Administrar la consola, tenants, sites, grupos, agentes y políticas de SentinelOne Singularity.
* Monitorear alertas, investigar amenazas y ejecutar acciones de contención, aislamiento, kill, quarantine, remediation y rollback según los procedimientos establecidos.
* Gestionar el despliegue, actualización, salud y cobertura de agentes en Windows, Linux y macOS.
* Analizar exclusiones y falsos positivos, evaluando su impacto y documentando las excepciones.
* Integrar la telemetría de SentinelOne con soluciones SIEM/SOAR.
* Colaborar con equipos de Threat Hunting, Incident Response y Vulnerability Management.
* Generar reportes de cobertura, detecciones, tendencias y cumplimiento operativo.
* Coordinar investigaciones e incidentes con equipos de SOC, infraestructura y soporte.

📍 Condiciones

* Rol: SentinelOne Security Specialist
* Especialidad: Cybersecurity / Endpoint Security / EDR
* Ubicación: Colombia

🌟 **Buscamos un perfil técnico, autónomo y orientado a la respuesta** , capaz de mantener una alta cobertura de endpoints, investigar amenazas y tomar decisiones efectivas frente a incidentes de seguridad.

📩 Si tienes experiencia en **SentinelOne, EDR/XDR y Endpoint Security** , ¡postúlate y sé parte de Accenture!

🔎 ¿Qué buscamos?

* 4 años de experiencia en Endpoint Security, SOC, Incident Response o áreas relacionadas.
* Experiencia hands-on con SentinelOne Singularity o plataformas EDR/XDR equivalentes.
* Conocimientos sólidos de seguridad en Windows y Linux, malware, comportamiento de procesos, persistencia y respuesta a incidentes.
* Experiencia investigando alertas y ejecutando acciones de contención y remediación.
* Capacidad para documentar investigaciones y coordinar incidentes con equipos técnicos.
* Autonomía operativa y buen criterio para escalar incidentes de acuerdo con su criticidad.

⭐ Será un plus

* Certificación SentinelOne o formación específica en la plataforma.
* Experiencia con SIEM/SOAR, scripting, Threat Hunting y MITRE ATT\&CK.
* Experiencia en administración masiva de endpoints.
* Conocimientos de IAM/PAM y Cloud Workload Security.

jobs.description:
Job Description

We''re looking for a talented infrastructure engineer who thrives on solving complex challenges at scale. This is an opportunity to shape the future of our technology landscape while growing your career alongside some of the best minds in the industry.

As a Lead Infrastructure Engineer at JPMorganChase within the Infrastructure Platform Network Services team, you will play a critical role in building, and optimizing the infrastructure platforms that support our global operations. You will drive technical strategy, mentor fellow engineers, and partner with cross-functional teams to deliver highly available, secure, and performant systems. Your expertise will directly influence how we scale our technology to meet evolving business demands.

The Connectivity Implementation Engineer will be responsible for leading delivery of network and connectivity services, globally. jobs.description:
IT SECURITY ENGINEER

Edinburgh

Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we're growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We're built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com http://Trip.com, Canva, Starling and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe and others, we're building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

Why this role is different

We treat internal IT as a product and our employees as its users, not as tickets. If your answer to a repeated problem is to do it faster by hand, this isn't the seat — and it isn't a back-room coding role either.

You'll be the engineer who builds the platform that provisions, supports and secures every Wordsmith employee, end to end. The goal is for the function to get more automated as we grow, not need more people.

The Role

You'll own onboarding, access, devices and offboarding as one connected system, and build the tooling — including coding agent workflows — that removes the manual steps at every stage. You'll be hands-on with the physical side of the job too, in the Edinburgh office.

What you'll do

 - Build a joiner pipeline that reads a new hire from Humaans, creates their identity in Okta, assigns app access by group rule, and triggers zero-touch laptop enrolment in Jamf — no manual steps

 - Build a Slack assistant, backed by a coding agent, that handles requests like “I need access to X” or “my laptop is slow” and either fixes them or routes them, resolving most without a human

 - Build a hardware vending machine for the Edinburgh office that dispenses chargers, dongles, headsets and loan laptops against an employee's identity, with stock reordered automatically

 - Write scripts and infrastructure as code that configure devices, enforce security baselines, and produce compliance evidence on their own

 - Build an offboarding flow that revokes access everywhere, wipes and reclaims the device, and files the record the moment someone is marked as a leaver

What good looks like in the first year

 - Zero-touch onboarding: within six months, a new hire's accounts, apps and access provision automatically from Humaans through Okta, and their laptop self-enrols — day one setup takes minutes, not hours

 - Self-service by default: within nine months, the top twenty employee IT requests — access, kit, resets, software — are self-served through automation, chat or a vending machine, not a ticket to a person

 - Automated joiner/mover/leaver: within twelve months, role changes and offboarding run automatically from the HRIS, with access removed same-day and hardware recovered

 - Build over buy: you ship internal tooling and coding agent workflows that remove manual steps, so the function scales on automation, not headcount

 - Secure and audit-ready: the fleet stays managed and SOC 2 evidence generates itself, rather than being assembled by hand before an audit

Who you might be

We're not hiring a traditional IT person — we're hiring someone who builds. That might mean you're:

 - a software engineer who likes owning systems end to end and wants a broad, high-ownership remit

 - a DevOps, SRE or platform engineer who automates infrastructure and wants to point that at people and devices

 - a strong IT or systems person who already codes and automates rather than clicking through consoles

 - someone from a smaller company or an MSP who has wired up tools, identity and devices and scripted the boring parts away

What matters is the instinct to automate anything you have to do twice, and to build the tool rather than do the task. We'll teach the IT domain to a strong builder — we won't teach someone to be a builder.

What we're looking for

 - You write real code and automate with APIs and scripts — Python, Bash or TypeScript. This isn't optional.

 - You think in systems: identity, access, data flows and lifecycle

 - You're comfortable using AI coding agents to build and ship tooling fast

 - You care about security and doing things properly, not just quickly

 - You're happy working on-site in Edinburgh and hands-on with real hardware

Bonus:

 - Exposure to identity and device tooling such as Okta, Google Workspace or Jamf

 - Experience with SOC 2 or security compliance

 - Having run or automated onboarding, end

jobs.description:
About Anthropic
  Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

   About the role
  The Endpoint team (Client Platform Engineering) treats Anthropic's device fleet as a platform we build and run. We run our own MDM as a production service and manage every piece of device configuration as code. Policies, configuration profiles, queries, remediation scripts, and software all ship through pull requests, CI, a staging environment, and a canary group before they reach the fleet. The fleet is mostly macOS, plus a small number of Linux machines and a growing mobile footprint.

  You'll own that platform end to end: the infrastructure underneath the MDM, the configuration on top of it, the patching and software pipelines that keep thousands of devices patched and secure, and the telemetry that tells us what is actually true on every device. You'll also build automation that cuts down on manual operational work. You'll work with Security teams on hardening, compliance controls, and detection and response, and with developer and infrastructure teams to make sure those controls don't get in the way of their work. Your work will let us base access decisions on whether a device can be trusted.

  We value people who double check a compliance report before they believe it. The team is deliberately lean and runs with high autonomy. You'll help define the endpoint roadmap, make architecture decisions, and own the platform every Anthropic employee's work runs on. You'll also help us meet the security standards our Responsible Scaling Policy requires as models advance.

   Responsibilities

   Own endpoint configuration as code: author, review, test, and progressively roll out MDM policies, configuration profiles, and remediation scripts across macOS and mobile, with canary stages and rollback built in
   Operate the MDM platform itself as a production service, including infrastructure as code, observability, upgrades, and incident response
   Build patch management automation with rapid enforcement timelines while maintaining good user experience
   Design zero touch provisioning that turns a sealed box into a productive machine on day one
   Support a small number of Linux machines alongside the Mac fleet
   Turn fleet telemetry into policy, dashboards, and early drift warnings, and use Claude to automate manual ops work
   Partner with Corporate Security on endpoint hardening, binary authorization, and compliance controls
   Take shifts on the team's rotation for incoming requests and escalations, and serve as the deep escalation tier for endpoint issues IT Operations can't resolve

  You may be a good fit if you

   Have 8+ years building secure IT systems in complex environments, including leading projects across multiple teams
   Have managed endpoint fleets of thousands of macOS devices through a modern MDM
   Treat endpoint configuration as code that is version controlled and peer reviewed, rather than clicking in consoles
   Go deep on macOS internals such as launchd, configuration profiles, TCC, and system extensions
   Write Python and shell scripts
   Write design docs and runbooks so teammates can review and support what you build

  Strong candidates may also have

   Have operated an MDM or device management platform as a service, not only consumed one as SaaS
   Have worked with open source endpoint and device management tooling (Munki, osquery, AutoPkg)
   Have built automated, progressive rollout systems with promotion gated on telemetry
   Have experience running infrastructure as code in a public cloud
   Have working knowledge of Linux administration (packaging, systems, config management)
   Have used LLMs to automate ops work

  Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

     The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

     For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

   Annual Salary:

   $285,000 - $325,000 USD

   Logistics
   Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

   Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

   Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

   Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

   Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

   We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

   How we're different
  We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

  The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

   Come work with us!
  Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

 IT INFRASTRUCTURE ENGINEER, VIRTUALIZATION & STORAGE

 As an IT Infrastructure Engineer on the infrastructure team, you will collaborate with internal teams to deliver innovative solutions for SpaceX’s growing infrastructure demands. You will ensure quality and reliability of systems across the software lifecycle while scaling and supporting data center infrastructure, virtualization, Kubernetes, and storage environments. You should have strong opinions on designing, testing, and operating virtualization platforms and multi-tier storage (enterprise + HPC) and be ready to build the next generation of SpaceX data center platforms.

 RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Implement and maintain a scalable, robust VMware environment and identify efficiencies supporting critical applications

- Design, implement, and maintain storage infrastructure across high-performance, capacity, archive, backup/recovery, and disaster recovery tiers

- Architect and operate high-throughput, low-latency storage and support exabyte scale file systems (e.g., VAST,) for simulation, telemetry, and high-concurrency workloads

- Administer enterprise storage platforms (NetApp, Pure FlashArray/FlashBlade, Cohesity, Scality) and manage access controls, permissions, and protocols (NFS, CIFS/SMB, iSCSI)

- Perform data center deployments, monitor performance, and troubleshoot production issues across virtualization, storage, transport (RDMA), and protocol layers

- Develop automation/tooling for monitoring, capacity planning, configuration management, and alerting; define standards for deployment and performance tuning

- Collaborate with compute, networking, and application teams to align virtualization and storage strategies with workload requirements

- Participate in on-call rotation, scheduled maintenance, and occasional physical installation support

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- Bachelor’s degree in information systems, computer science, engineering or related technical field and 3+ years of engineering experience in an enterprise environment; OR 5+ years of engineering experience in lieu of a degree

- 1+ years of professional experience managing virtualized server environments

- 5+ years of experience in IT storage engineering with enterprise platforms (NetApp, Pure Storage, Scality, Vast or similar)

 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Experience with full lifecycle management of large-scale VMware environments and supporting container infrastructure with Kubernetes

- Experience with data center infrastructure management (DCIM) tools

- Deep knowledge of RDMA, congestion control, lossless Ethernet, RoCEv2, and/or InfiniBand storage fabrics in HPC or latency-sensitive environments

- Experience automating infrastructure with Python, PowerShell, or Ansible

- Familiarity with HPC schedulers (Slurm, LFS) and how storage tiers interact with job scheduling

- Linux and Windows OS system administration experience

- Exceptional analytical and troubleshooting skills; strong written and verbal communication

- Willingness to respond to after-hours triage and operational support

- Strong understanding of storage protocols (NFS, CIFS/SMB, iSCSI) and experience with client/server systems, monitoring tools, enterprise networking, and virtualization

 ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Willingness to work extended hours and weekends as needed

 COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
IT Infrastructure Engineer: $130,000.00-$175,000.00/per year

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock, stock options, or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

 ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

- To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here .

You'll work with Security teams on hardening, compliance controls, and detection and response, and with developer and infrastructure teams to make sure those controls don't get in the way of their work. Your work will let us base access decisions on whether a device can be trusted.

- Build patch management automation with rapid enforcement timelines while maintaining good user experience

jobs.description:
#### **About the Company**

We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. Our focus is on capturing civilizational levels of ultra-low-cost renewable energy for applications including computing and affordable renewable fuels delivered to shore.

The company is a public benefit corporation headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and backed by leading venture capitalists, philanthropic investors, university endowments, and private investment offices. We operate as an idea meritocracy in which the best ideas change the company’s direction on a regular basis.

Our staff have worked at organizations such as SpaceX, Blue Origin, Boeing, Tesla, Apple, Virgin Orbit, Astra, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, New Relic, Bridgewater, Raytheon, Disney Imagineering, and the US Army and Air Force, as well as research universities, startups, and small companies across a range of industries.

#### **About the Job**

Our core technology is the node, a device that produces energy in the ocean’s harshest conditions for years at a time without human maintenance or intervention.

We're looking for an Endpoint Engineer to own how every laptop, phone, and piece of office technology at Panthalassa is deployed, secured, and kept healthy. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role sitting alongside our IT Support function. You'll lead the initiatives that let us scale device management without scaling headcount: zero touch deployment for Windows and macOS, BYOD support for mobile devices, endpoint security baselines, and the device compliance posture our access policies depend on. You'll also serve as an escalation point and mentor for our IT Support Specialists, and act as our subject matter expert in physical office technology, from access control to printers to patch panels.

Our IT Support team runs the day to day of the physical office: badge issuance, printer break/fix, conference room checks, and desk moves. You own the design, standards, and escalations behind all of it, and you get your hands dirty on build-outs and the hard problems. One day you're writing configuration profiles to automate workstation security, the next you're installing A/V equipment and running patch cables.

Candidates should have strong interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment in which the best ideas change the company’s direction on a regular basis.

#### **Responsibilities**

##### **Endpoint Management and Zero Touch Deployment**

- Administer our MDM platforms (Microsoft Intune, JumpCloud) for Windows and macOS devices, including enrollment, configuration profiles, compliance policies, and application delivery.
- Architect and execute our zero touch provisioning rollout (Windows Autopilot and Apple Business Manager / Automatic Device Enrollment), eliminating manual imaging for new device deployments.
- Drive device enrollment to full coverage and keep it there through regular audit.
- Design and implement BYOD policies and enrollment workflows that enable secure access from personal devices.
- Own the device lifecycle: procurement standards, refresh cadence, repair, and secure decommissioning.

##### **Endpoint Security and Compliance**

- Build and enforce endpoint security baselines, patch management cadences, and device health policies.
- Deliver the device compliance signals our Conditional Access policies rely on, working with our IAM Engineer to keep policy and posture in sync.
- Monitor and respond to endpoint telemetry and security alerts, driving remediation with the relevant owners.
- Translate compliance framework requirements (NIST or equivalent) into concrete endpoint controls and documentation.

##### **Escalation and Mentorship**

- Serve as the primary escalation point for our IT Support Specialists on complex hardware, OS, and device issues.
- Mentor the support team and transfer knowledge deliberately so fixes land at tier 1 the next time.
- Write and maintain runbooks and knowledge base content in Confluence.

#### **Required Qualifications**

- Experience administering endpoint management including MDM, device compliance, and application deployment.
- Experience building or running zero touch deployment at scale (Autopilot, Apple Business Manager / ADE, or equivalent).
- Ability to write clear documentation and turn written policy into enforceable technical controls.
- Comfort working across abstraction layers, designing systems one day and swapping hardware the next.

#### **Desired Qualifications**

- Experience administering a modern MDM solution such as Intune, Jamf, JumpCloud, or Kandji.
- Comfort with scripting for endpoint automation (PowerShell, bash, Python).
- Familiarity with zero trust concepts and how device posture feeds access decisions.
- Experience supporting or implementing a security or compliance framework (NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or equivalent).
- Experience with endpoint telemetry and security alert response, including triage, remediation, and root cause.

The above qualifications are desired, not required. We encourage you to apply if you are a strong candidate with only some of the desired skills and experience listed.

#### **Additional Requirements**

- Available for occasional evening and weekend work to support deployments, maintenance windows, and office moves.
- Travel to vendor sites and other company locations as needed.
- Intermittently able to work longer hours to support critical needs. While we expect a lot of each other, we also offer a high degree of autonomy and work-life balance, including flexible PTO and flexible working hours.

#### **Compensation and Benefits**

If hired for this full-time role, you will receive:

- Cash compensation of $120,000 - $180,000.
- Equity in the company. We’re all owners and if we’re successful, this equity should be far and away the most valuable component of your compensation.
- A benefits package that helps you take care of yourself and your family, including:
  - Flexible paid time off
  - Health insurance (the company pays 100% of gold-level PPO plan for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents)
  - Dental insurance (the company pays 100% for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents)
  - Vision insurance (the company pays 100% for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents)
  - Disability insurance (the company pays 100% for a policy to provide long-term financial support if you become disabled)
  - Ability to contribute to tax-advantaged accounts, including 401(k), health FSA, and dependent care FSA
- Relocation assistance to facilitate your move to Portland (if needed).

#### **Location**

This is an on-site position. Our offices, lab, and shop are located in
Portland, Oregon.

jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3.ai http://Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find, fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZero™ platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by IT Ops/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers & operators, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools and false positives, resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox" security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn-it-alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

As a remote first company, we require minimum 25Mbps consumer grade broadband connection.

What You'll Do

You will lead Client Platform — the team responsible for the software that lives in customer environments and makes NodeZero's autonomous pentests possible. Client Platform owns two sub-teams: Image Build & Release (the factory that produces and signs the NodeZero runner container image) and OTA Services (the system that keeps runners current across thousands of customer environments). Every pentest NodeZero runs depends on this team's work being reliable, secure, and fast.

 - Team Building & Culture: Build, mentor, and grow Client Platform to ~10 engineers across Image Build & Release and OTA Services. You will directly manage the Engineering Managers of both sub-teams and set the technical and cultural direction for the full org. Establish engineering norms and a culture of ownership for a team whose software runs in environments you cannot control.

 - Image Build & Release: Lead end-to-end CI/CD workflows to create, sign, and reliably publish the NodeZero runner container image. Own software supply chain security: reproducible builds, image signing, SBOM generation, and vulnerability scanning in CI.

 - OTA Services: Architect and operate the over-the-air update delivery system that keeps NodeZero runners current across thousands of customer environments — reliably, securely, and without requiring manual customer IT intervention.

 - Security Research Partnership: Collaborate closely with Security Research to ensure the runner seamlessly executes new autonomous pentest capabilities as they ship.

 - Act as a Product Owner: Partner with product managers, security researchers, and customer success to manage the client-side roadmap.

What You'll Bring

Platform Leadership & Architecture

 - Demonstrated expertise leading teams that design, build, and operate containerized software (Docker, VM images) deployed into on-premise or customer-managed environments.

 - Experience implementing robust software supply chain practices — secure builds, image signing (cosign, Notary), reproducible builds, and vulnerability scanning in CI.

 - Experience designing and operating OTA update mechanisms for distributed agents or edge software at scale — including staged rollouts, rollback, and delivery verification.

 - Ability to reason about correctness in opaque, customer-controlled environments where you cannot observe failure modes directly.

Team Building & Engineering Culture

 - Experience building or significantly growing an engineering team — including hiring, onboarding, and establishing engineering norms tailored for shipped software.

 - Proven ability to define and instill engineering culture: rigorous code review standards, robust testing across diverse customer environments, and a strong culture of ownership.

 - Drives high-impact architecture decisions rigorously — requires design documents, runs structured reviews, builds consensus, and ensures decisions account for customer environment variables.

Technical Expertise

 - Proficient in Go (preferred), Python, or C++.

 - Strong Linux OS-level operations: container runtimes, networking in corporate environments, systemd, process isolation.

 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines for building and signing container images (cosign, Notary v2, or equivalent).

 - Familiarity with OTA update protocols and frameworks: TUF (The Update Framework), Omaha, or custom mechanisms.

 - Understanding of TLS, certificate pinning, and secure software delivery in hostile network environments.

Nice to Haves

 - Exposure to cybersecurity, pentesting tools, or vulnerability remediation.

 - Experience with cross-platform agents (Windows/Linux) and endpoint

Working within this dynamic team, you will have the chance to learn from some of the best minds in the industry and work on cutting-edge projects that push the boundaries of technology.

- Deep understanding of APIs and extensive experience of APIs development.

- Familiarity with MS technology and its stack including Azure Cloud

- Knowledge of AI tools and its usage in SDLC process.

Honda has a clear vision for the future, and it's a joyful one. We are looking for individuals with the skills, courage, persistence, and dreams that will help us reach our future-focused goals. At our core is innovation. Honda is constantly innovating and developing solutions to drive our business with record success. To this end, Honda strives to realize "the joy and freedom of mobility" by developing new technologies and an innovative approach to achieve a "zero environmental footprint."

We are looking for qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds, experiences, continuous improvement values, and a strong work ethic to join our team.

If your goals and values align with Honda's, we want you to join our team to Bring the Future!

Job Purpose

The senior North America (NA) Digital Workplace Client Engineer is responsible for engineering, implementing, and managing the full spectrum of North America''s modern workplace endpoint platforms. Primary technologies include Microsoft Intune as the cloud-native Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) solution, Windows client platforms, iOS/iPadOS mobile devices via Apple Business Manager (ABM), and next-generation virtual endpoint solutions including Windows 365 Cloud PC and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD). This role partners closely with Microsoft and other key vendors, participates in product roadmap planning, and drives the transition from legacy on-premises management (SCCM, Group Policy) to a fully cloud-native endpoint model.This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Team Manager, NA Digital Workplace Client Engineering Services. The North America environment serves as the reference architecture and foundation for global endpoint standards adoption across the Honda enterprise.Key Accountabilities

Engineer, implement, and support Microsoft Intune as the primary Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) platform for Windows, iOS/iPadOS, MacOS and virtual endpoints. Manage device enrollment, configuration, compliance, application deployment, Windows Autopilot, and Apple Business Manager integration.Define endpoint architecture, standards, and multi-year technology roadmaps for Intune, Microsoft Entra ID Join, Hybrid Entra ID Join, Windows 365 Cloud PC, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), and mobile device management solutions.Serve as the highest-level technical escalation point for complex endpoint issues, leading root cause analysis, problem management, and long-term remediation while providing technical guidance to support teams.Lead the transition from SCCM and Group Policy-based management to cloud-native endpoint management through Intune, including migration planning, deployment strategy, and adoption of zero-touch provisioning technologies.Partner with Microsoft, Apple, and other technology providers to evaluate emerging solutions, conduct proof-of-concept initiatives, influence product direction, and recommend technology investments.Collaborate with security, identity, infrastructure, and business teams to ensure endpoint services align with compliance, governance, security, and digital workplace objectives.Develop and maintain engineering standards, operational procedures, runbooks, and technical documentation.Qualifications, Experience, and Skills

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Description

Empower AI is seeking a MECM / SCCM Engineer to engineer and operate the Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager infrastructure that manages thousands of endpoints for a Department of War agency across Pre-Production, NIPR
Net, SIPR
Net, and JWICS enclaves. The engineer designs and maintains the MECM hierarchy, distribution points, boundaries, collections, client health, and reporting; engineers automated patch and software deployment, task sequences, and PXE provisioning; and validates every significant change in pre-production and the Digital Twin environment before release. As a privileged user, the engineer is a Tier III escalation resource and a primary contributor to CAT I/II/III patch compliance and RMF evidence for the endpoint environment. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers.

THIS IS AN ONSITE ROLE IN QUANTICO, VA (RKB) WITH UP TO 10% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED.

JOB DUTIES:
Engineer, operate, and maintain the MECM/SCCM infrastructure across enclaves: hierarchy and site health, distribution points, boundaries and boundary groups, collections, client health remediation, role-based administration, and reporting.Design and maintain automated deployment mechanisms (software update deployments, application deployments, task sequences, PXE/OSD provisioning) and analyze deployment results to resolve failures and improve success rates.Plan and validate MECM upgrades, client updates, and configuration changes in pre-production and the Digital Twin environment, and implement them through formal Change Management with rollback plans.Produce MECM compliance and deployment reporting (patch compliance, image deployment cycle time, client health) for the Customer Support Metrics Dashboard and provide artifacts supporting the endpoint POA&M.Design, engineer, test, and implement endpoint infrastructure solutions including hardened image pipelines, automated provisioning, configuration baselines, endpoint management platform enhancements, and VDI integration across multiple security enclaves.Support the evaluation and phased implementation of a Digital Twin capability for network and system modeling, including building and maintaining the pre-production replica, defining test procedures, and validating significant changes before production deployment.Develop engineering artifacts for Government approval: requirements, design documents, test plans and results, implementation and rollback plans, change packages, and as-built documentation.Engineer and integrate automation, AI/ML, and analytics capabilities (e.g., predictive analytics on service data, automated remediation, ServiceNow integrations) that improve support across all tiers, upon Government approval.

jobs.description:
An iMPact Business Group client is seeking an experienced Windows Endpoint Engineer/Architect for a 6+ month part-time contract.
The ideal candidate is able to start out 3 days a week on contract and adjust their participation as project needs expand over time. This firm is growing and so are their Technical Support needs.
This is a hands-on Technology support role. This contract will start out reviewing current Endpoint support processes and then help define and deploy automation to improve those processes.
This role will involve the design, implementation, and maintenance of enterprise Endpoint systems. This role ensures that all Windows-based
devices remain secure, compliant, and optimized through effective patch management, imaging, software deployment, and automation practices.
Other titles for this role could include -- Windows Endpoint Support Engineer, Desktop Support Technician/Engineer, Software Packaging Technician/Engineer, Endpoint Deployment Technician/Engineer.
Duties can include:
Operating System and Patch Management
* Develop, schedule, and manage operating system patching processes across endpoint devices.
* Monitor patch deployment results and compliance metrics, to ensure endpoint security and consistency.
* Coordinate with the Security team to remediate identified vulnerabilities.
* Manage and maintain BIOS, firmware, and system driver updates to ensure hardware stability, compatibility, and security across endpoint devices.
Imaging and Deployment
* Design, build, and maintain standardized endpoint images for deployment across the organization.
* Streamline the imaging and provisioning process for new and replacement devices. * Ensure images include required baseline configurations, agents, applications, and security settings.
Software Deployment and Maintenance
* Create, test, and manage software deployment packages for enterprise applications.
* Oversee enterprise-level software updates and version control to ensure consistency across environments.
* Maintain configuration baselines and ensure endpoint software compliance with organizational standards.
Configuration and Policy Management
* Define and maintain endpoint configuration standards, including device policies and compliance rules.
* Implement and enforce endpoint security configurations, including encryption, update compliance, and access controls.
* Support the integration of configuration standards into automated management systems.
* Maintain endpoint device health (connectivity, compliance, drivers, and security tools).
Automation and Process Improvement
* Identify and implement improvements to reduce manual intervention and increase deployment efficiency.
* Maintain documentation of automated endpoint management procedures and configurations.
Collaboration and Strategic Projects
* Collaborate with Security, Service Desk, and business stakeholders to plan and implement endpoint-related initiatives (e.g., Windows version upgrades, hardware refresh, security enhancements).* Contribute to projects involving operating system lifecycle management, platform upgrades, or management tool enhancements.
* Provide subject-matter expertise in endpoint design, deployment strategy, and systems optimization.
* Participate in disaster recovery planning for endpoint systems.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience managing endpoint devices in an enterprise environment.
* Experience with ITSM systems such as Freshservice, Jira, or ServiceNow.
* Familiarity with remote endpoint management solutions such as NinjaOne or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of Windows operating systems, endpoint configuration, and patch management.
* Experience with imaging, provisioning, and deployment methodologies.
* Ability to develop automation scripts and workflows to improve efficiency.
* Solid understanding of system security principles, compliance standards, and endpoint hardening.
* Excellent problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
* Strong collaboration and project coordination abilities across technical and business teams.
* Experience creating and maintaining dashboards, metrics, and reporting on endpoint health and compliance.
Preferred items -
* Certifications such as ITIL 4 Foundations, CompTIA A+, Network+, or Microsoft Certified Professional (MCP).
* Experience working in hybrid or cloud-connected endpoint environments.* Knowledge of enterprise-level configuration management and automation frameworks.

About Northern Essex Community College:

Northern Essex Community College (NECC) serves more than 5,000 students annually across its campuses in Haverhill and Lawrence, Massachusetts, conveniently located within easy reach of Boston and the scenic beaches and state parks of New England's coastline. Recognized as one of the 2026 Most Promising Places to Work in Community Colleges by NISOD (National Institute for Staff and Organizational Development), NECC's success is driven by a mission-centered culture and a highly engaged workforce. As the first federally designated Hispanic-Serving Institution in New England, NECC remains committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace that reflects and supports the communities it serves.

Rooted in the Merrimack Valley, NECC plays a vital role in strengthening the region through workforce development, expanded access to affordable higher education, increased degree attainment, and strong partnerships with businesses.

NECC employees are united by a shared commitment expanding access to educational opportunities, supporting students in completing their academic journey in a timely and equitable manner, and preparing graduates for long-term success in the workforce. The college invests in its people through ongoing professional development opportunities, collaborative leadership, and a supportive work environment.

Job Description:

POSITION: Full-Time Endpoint Administrator (Staff Associate): Information Technology Client Computing; Haverhill Campus; 37.5 hours per week; Non-Unit Professional Position.

SUMMARY: The Endpoint Administrator is responsible for the administration, support, and security of the College's endpoint computing environment. This position manages enterprise endpoint platforms with a primary focus on Microsoft Intune, modern device management, endpoint security, and backup and recovery systems, including backup URI administration.

The Endpoint Administrator works closely with infrastructure, security, service desk, and academic technology teams to ensure the reliable, secure, and compliant delivery of endpoint services for faculty, staff, and students.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

The responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

 Administer and support endpoint management platforms with a primary focus on Microsoft Intune.
 Manage the full lifecycle of endpoint devices including provisioning, configuration, updates, compliance, and retirement.
 Design, implement, and maintain Intune configuration profiles, compliance policies, security baselines, and application deployments.
 Support endpoint environments across Windows, macOS, and mobile devices.
 Configure and manage integrations between Intune, Entra ID (Azure AD), Microsoft Defender, and other Microsoft 365 services.
 Implement and maintain conditional access and endpoint security policies in collaboration with IT Security.
 Monitor endpoint compliance, health, and reporting dashboards and remediate non-compliant devices.
 Troubleshoot complex endpoint issues escalated from the Service Desk.
 Administer endpoint backup solutions including backup URI administration.
 Develop, test, and document backup and recovery procedures.
 Participate in disaster recovery planning and recovery testing.
 Apply operating system patches, firmware updates, and security remediations.
 Develop scripts and automation to improve endpoint management efficiency.
 Maintain system documentation, configuration standards, and procedures.

jobs.description:
**About Us**

Machines will make decisions, move value, and coordinate on behalf of organizations, instantly, autonomously, and at unprecedented scale. But the systems that govern today’s economy weren’t designed for that world. Turnkey is building the infrastructure for this future: programmable guardrails that enable autonomy without sacrificing control.

Founded by the team who scaled Coinbase Custody to $100M+ ARR and secured over $100B in crypto assets, we know how to move at pace without ever compromising on security.

Our mission is to help the world operate an economy on autopilot, safely. We're low-ego, high-agency, and deeply technical. Our team consists of experts in cryptography, security, and systems who believe great infrastructure is invisible. We're building the trustless, programmable foundation for the autonomous economy, and we're hiring people who understand what that requires.

**Your role**

This is not a config-and-tickets DevOps role. We're looking for someone who treats infrastructure as a programming problem: writing real software (in Go) to automate, scale, and harden the systems that run a security-critical platform.

- Own best practices for managing production infrastructure, including provisioning, application scaling, configuration management, capacity planning, and monitoring
- Build and maintain our multi-region Kubernetes infrastructure at scale, along with the Terraform-provisioned cloud resources that sit underneath it
- Write custom automation and tooling in Go to reduce manual work and eliminate entire classes of operational risk
- Build infrastructure to manage and deploy applications in secure enclaves
- Improve operations across our infrastructure and systems, including deployment, logging, monitoring, and alerting
- Assist in scaling out a world-class engineering team

**What we're looking for**

- Strong multi-cloud infrastructure experience, AWS strongly preferred
- Real programming ability in Go. You should be comfortable writing production software, not just scripts or configuration
- Hands-on experience running Kubernetes at scale and managing infrastructure as code with Terraform
- A learning mindset and high agency. We care more about how fast you pick things up and how much ownership you take than about years of experience on paper
- An understanding of modern application architectures, with opinions on how they should be developed and deployed
- Experience working in extremely security conscious environments
- A healthy amount of paranoia :)
- People who think Web3/cryptocurrency has the potential to radically change the world for the better, and a sincere desire to help facilitate that change
- Based in the US

**Style points**

- Experience with trusted execution environments, secure enclaves, hardware security modules, or other attestable compute environments
- A deep understanding of Linux and how to reduce the surface area of applications deployed on top of it
- Expertise in threshold signing systems and a desire to stay on the cutting edge of production-grade cryptography
- Actively tracking developments in the crypto ecosystem and opinionated on where it's going

**What We Offer**

- Full benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, HSA/FSA, 401(k)
- Paid parental leave
- Unlimited PTO
- $3,000/yr learning and development budget to attend industry conferences
- Multiple team offsites per year
- Lunch stipend

Please note that while the team is remote, we are only considering candidates who are physically based in the United States and Canada at the current time.

_Turnkey is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply._

Compensation range

$200,000—$240,000 USD

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

 About the role

Data Center Security Engineering (DCSE) secures Anthropic's data center footprint; this role covers how the sites are designed and built to be secure. Much of that footprint is designed and built with partners, so a site's security is decided early: in what Anthropic hands the people who build it, and in how rigorously the delivered systems are tested against it.

You'll design and specify the physical security systems for a site: perimeter and vehicle barriers, intrusion detection, video, security lighting, and the site penetrations and utility entry points that bypass them. Design firms and integrators produce the site drawings and install; you specify, review, and verify. You'll write the performance requirement and verification method behind each control, review every site design against them at each stage with redlines a design team can act on, test in the field that what was built performs as specified, and re-verify post-acceptance changes.

This is a foundational role. You'll own Anthropic's physical security reference design package (typical details, reference drawings, schedules, and test procedures) in the form partners build from, and keep it current against each site's threat basis and the sites actually being built. You'll set the technical position for a site and decide what applies where; where a requirement can't be met as written, you'll engineer the compensating control and document the deviation. You'll work with the rest of DCSE, with Anthropic's design, construction, and real estate counterparts, and directly with the vendors who build to the package. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well.

The same seat covers the team's security operations control rooms. You'll set their design and operational requirements and accept delivered systems against them, working day to day alongside the team's platform engineers, who own the software and compute that run in them.

This role involves regular travel to data center sites. These are critical services, and this role participates in an on-call rotation for them.

 Key responsibilities

-

 Produce a vendor-ready design package for perimeter barriers and hostile vehicle mitigation, intrusion detection and its zoning, video coverage, security lighting matched to camera performance, and penetration protection: performance specifications, typical details and reference drawings, and device and zone schedules, written so a design firm can build to them and a test can prove them

-

 Define the per-site engineering basis: which requirements apply to a site based on its risk profile and the threats it faces, with compensating controls and documented deviations

-

 Write the acceptance criteria and test methods: the verification method behind each requirement and the evidence a site must produce to pass acceptance

-

 Set standoff, structural hardening, and site layout criteria for new designs, tied to the threat basis they derive from

-

 Run field verification: commissioning and acceptance testing of perimeter, detection, video, and lighting against performance criteria (detection coverage tests, photometric measurements, video quality checks)

-

 Write the operational and design requirements for security operations control rooms: console layout, wall versus workstation content, supervisor placement; room network, power, backup, and resilient communications to the team's segmentation and hardening baseline

-

 Own control room acceptance: factory and site acceptance criteria written before the build, then accept or reject delivered systems (video wall, consoles, cabling, fit-out) against them

 Minimum qualifications

-

Have designed or specified physical security systems (perimeter barriers, intrusion detection, video, security lighting) for campus-scale sites: multiple buildings, a secured perimeter, many detection zones

-

Read and produce construction documents (site plans, civil and electrical drawings, device schedules, submittals) using standard design and markup tools such as AutoCAD, Revit, or Bluebeam, and find what is missing as readily as what is wrong

-

Write performance requirements that are testable: each states what must be true, how it will be verified, and what evidence shows it

-

Have run commissioning and acceptance tests against performance criteria and rejected work that did not meet them

-

Derive requirements from a threat basis rather than a product catalog: you can say which adversary a control stops and where the next weakest point is

-

Have owned an engineering domain where you set the approach, chose what applied to each site, worked directly with vendors, and answered for the result

 Preferred qualifications

-

Experience carrying a physical security design from construction documents through construction to acceptance testing

-

Experience engineering the security scope of colocation or partner-delivered facilities

-

Working knowledge of published standards for standoff, hostile vehicle mitigation, and intrusion detection zoning

-

Photometric and video quality measurement experience

-

Control room, AV, or network design experience: console layouts, video wall systems, resilient communications

-

Experience using AI-assisted tooling for drafting and review as a core part of your workflow

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

 $320,000 - $405,000 USD

 Logistics

 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

 Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

 Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

 Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

 How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

 Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

 IT SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR, TEST OPERATIONS (2ND SHIFT)

SpaceX is looking for a highly skilled and knowledgeable IT Systems Administrator to support the networking, compute administration, and application support needs of our test operations environment. This role will be pivotal to the enablement of safe and sustained test operations cadence, directly supporting our goals of making humanity a multiplanetary species. Candidate must be comfortable working on mission-critical systems with a sense of urgency appropriate to the responsibilities while maintaining attention to detail and operational excellence.

 RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Augment and deploy new IT infrastructure, including networking, server, and desktop hardware directly supporting mission critical networks across the country.

- Perform periodic systems upgrades and patches in between critical operations, sometimes on weekends and evenings.

- Monitor IT services and respond aggressively to incidents to maintain systems performance.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to proactively identify and resolve potential technical issues with systems deployments.

- Author and maintain documentation for IT systems, from systems overview documents and design drawings to procedures.

- Leverage automation tools and contribute to IT systems engineering efforts.

- Ensure that systems are configured and maintained in compliance with industry and cybersecurity standards (e.g. ITAR, ISO, NIST).

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

- 3+ years of experience in IT systems administration.

- Hands-on experience with Linux or Windows server administration.

- Experience with enterprise network administration and deployment.

 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Working knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, NTP, PTP etc), firewalls administration and cybersecurity technologies.

- Proficiency in scripting (Bash/Powershell/Python) and automation frameworks (Terraform, Ansible, Puppet).

- Familiarity with Active Directory and multi-platform authentication/identification environments.

- Experience with virtualization platforms and tools.

- Understanding of Layer 1 configuration best practices and multiplexing technologies.

- Working knowledge, including the ability to setup, configure, upgrade, manage, and troubleshoot, Windows-based systems and services (i.e. SCCM, Active Directory).

- Exposure to real-time systems and industrial telemetry networks.

- Experience with configuration management, provisioning, infrastructure as code, and other DevOps concepts and tools.

- Excellent communications skills with the ability to communicate with internal/external customers, vendors, management etc. in both formal and informal situations.

 ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Ability to pass Air Force background checks for Cape Canaveral and Vandenberg.

- Must have valid driver's license.

- Ability to lift up to 30lbs.

- Ability to work at heights.

- Willing to be on after-hours on-call rotation.

- Willingness to work extended hours and weekends as needed.

- Must be available for the second shift beginning at 1:30pm.

 ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

- To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
